title: Abteilungsleitung Kundenservice / Kundendienst für E-Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind ein wachsender Onlinehandel, spezialisiert auf
Photovoltaikprodukte und erneuerbare Energielösungen. Unsere Mission ist
es, Kunden bei der nachhaltigen Energiewende zu unterstützen und ihnen
hochwertige Produkte sowie erstklassigen Service zu bieten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen engagierten Abteilungsleiter Kundendienst / Kundenservice (m/w/d), der unseren Kundenservice fachlich und organisatorisch führt, Prozesse weiterentwickelt und gleichzeitig im operativen Tagesgeschäft mit anpackt.

Aufgaben

  • Führung des Kundendienstteams: Sie sind zentrale
    Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden im Kundendienst, koordinieren
    das Tagesgeschäft und sorgen für klare Abläufe im Team.
  • Steuerung des operativen Service: Sie verteilen Tickets
    und Aufgaben sinnvoll, priorisieren Anfragen und stellen sicher, dass
    Kundenanliegen schnell, strukturiert und zuverlässig bearbeitet werden.
  • Aktive Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft: Sie arbeiten selbst
    operativ mit, übernehmen Kundenanfragen per E-Mail, Telefon und über
    Verkaufsplattformen und greifen insbesondere bei komplexen oder
    eskalierten Fällen ein.
  • Bearbeitung schwieriger Kundenfälle: Sie übernehmen
    herausfordernde Reklamationen, Garantie- und Sonderfälle und sorgen auch
    in kritischen Situationen für professionelle und lösungsorientierte
    Kommunikation.
  • Schulung und Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden: Sie
    arbeiten neue Mitarbeitende ein, unterstützen das Team im Tagesgeschäft
    und sorgen durch Schulungen und klare Vorgaben für einen einheitlich
    hohen Servicestandard.
  • Prozess- und Systementwicklung: Sie etablieren
    effiziente Strukturen, verbessern bestehende Abläufe und schaffen
    Systeme, mit denen der Kundendienst auch bei wachsendem Auftragsvolumen
    zuverlässig funktioniert.
  • Schnittstelle zu anderen Abteilungen: Sie arbeiten eng
    mit Vertrieb, Lager, Einkauf, Marketing und Produktmanagement zusammen,
    um Kundenanliegen schnell zu lösen und interne Abläufe zu verbessern.
  • Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit: Sie behalten
    jederzeit den Überblick, erkennen Engpässe frühzeitig und sorgen dafür,
    dass kein Kunde unnötig warten muss und Anliegen sauber abgeschlossen
    werden.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Sie verfügen über Erfahrung im
    Kundendienst, Kundenservice, E-Commerce, Versandhandel oder in einer
    vergleichbaren Position. Idealerweise haben Sie bereits erste
    Führungserfahrung gesammelt.
  • Führungskompetenz: Sie können Mitarbeitende anleiten,
    Aufgaben delegieren, Prioritäten setzen und auch in stressigen
    Situationen souverän Entscheidungen treffen.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Sie sind technisch affin und
    haben Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien, insbesondere Photovoltaik. Sie
    sind in der Lage, sich in technische Produkte und Zusammenhänge zügig
    einzuarbeiten.
  • Organisationsstärke: Sie arbeiten strukturiert,
    behalten Fristen, offene Fälle und Teamkapazitäten im Blick und schaffen
    Ordnung auch bei hohem Arbeitsaufkommen.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Sie führen nicht nur, sondern arbeiten aktiv mit und übernehmen Verantwortung, wenn es darauf ankommt.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sie kommunizieren klar,
    serviceorientiert und lösungsorientiert – sowohl mit Kunden als auch
    intern mit Ihrem Team und anderen Abteilungen.
  • IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen
    Office-Anwendungen; Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, CRM-Systemen oder
    E-Commerce-Prozessen ist von Vorteil.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum in einer zukunftsorientierten Branche.
  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit operativer und organisatorischer Verantwortung.
  • Ein dynamisches, motiviertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Die Möglichkeit, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und Strukturen nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten.
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte.
  • Einen Fitnessraum für Kraft- und Ausdauertraining.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Zelara

Most CRM marketing still sends the same message to everyone and calls it personalization. Zelara fixes that with agentic lifecycle marketing that improves with every interaction. It runs on the CRM stack a company already has and gets every customer the right message at the right time.

With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers.

The Role

You work for Björn, our Co-CEO & Founder. At Uber he was responsible for hundreds of billion customer touchpoints a year. He has seen our buyers' problem from the inside.

You are a hands-on senior AE. You close your own deals and help build our sales motion, turning early traction into something repeatable. Most buyers have no budget line for this yet, so you shape how they think about the problem rather than answer a request that already exists.

You sell to CRM, lifecycle and marketing leaders at mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe. Contracts are six figures a year, cycles two to four months. You run each account with our Solutions Architect: you own the deal, they own the technical plan.

What You Will Do

  • Own every deal from first conversation to signed contract: discovery, workshops, proposal and close

  • Close your first deals side by side with a founder, and soon on your own

  • Make the case for buying over building, with our Solutions Architect at your side

  • Learn what wins, and shape it into the way we sell as we grow

  • Open new doors yourself, testing which channels and messages land

  • Take what customers tell you back to product and engineering, so it changes what we build

  • Negotiate pricing and terms, and grow your accounts through expansion and renewal

Within 90 days you close your first customer on your own and can tell us which deals are worth chasing.

Who You Are

  • A senior AE with several years of closing complex B2B deals yourself, ideally SaaS, against your own sales target

  • You have closed mid-market and enterprise deals of our size (six figures a year) through a buying committee, and can say what made each buyer say yes.

  • Domain experience: you have sold to CRM, lifecycle or marketing teams at B2C companies, or sold martech (Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, Customer.io and similar).

  • Start-up experience: you have built a sales motion from scratch as a founder, an early sales hire or the owner of a blank page, without a playbook or inbound pipeline

  • You judge a customer's business first: the metric their leadership is held to, and what we are worth to them in numbers

  • You are credible with a CMO, a Head of CRM and their data engineer, and hold your own when the engineers say they could build it, without dismissing what they built

  • You think in funnel metrics and say the uncomfortable thing early

  • Ideally, you have led a small sales team while still closing deals yourself

  • AI-native, fluent in English. German is a strong advantage.

Bonus

  • You have run a CRM or lifecycle programme in-house

  • You have turned pilots into multi-year contracts

What We Offer

  • Work directly with founders who have built and sold an AI SaaS business and run large-scale B2C from the customer's side

  • A founding role, hands-on from day one, with room to lead

  • A technical counterpart in every account

  • A competitive salary and a meaningful equity stake

  • Berlin, with regular travel across Europe

  • A Deutschlandticket or bike subscription, plus a gym membership

Our Compass

We are guided by four core values:

  • Seek Truth: We ground decisions in evidence. When the facts change, we change our mind.

  • Act with Integrity: We build trust through transparency, reliability, and ownership.

  • Put Customers First: We succeed only when they succeed.

title: Account Executive DACH
descriptionHtml:
Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and creating new opportunities and closing complex deals? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that's transforming how some of the world's largest industrial companies operate? That's a different story.

Peripass is a tech company at heart. We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and ArcelorMittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks loading and unloading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments.

Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive Germany within the Sales Team, you will have a front-row seat to the growth of an international SaaS scale-up and play a key role in expanding our presence in the German market.

  • Own the full sales cycle: You will be responsible for selling our SaaS solution and independently managing qualified sales opportunities from initial engagement through signed contract. This includes identifying and qualifying prospects, conducting discovery conversations, developing business cases, managing stakeholders, negotiating and closing deals.

  • Build our presence in Germany: Identify target accounts and create new business opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting and personalised outreach across relevant industries. Work closely with our BDR team to open conversations with new prospects and build awareness of Peripass in the German market.

  • Pipeline momentum and sales velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals.

  • Existing customer growth: Identify opportunities for cross-selling and selling to additional sites within existing customer accounts, in close collaboration with Customer Success and other relevant teams.

  • Deal negotiation and closing: Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect's needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalising contracts.

  • Travel across Germany: the role involves travelling approximately two to three days per week within Germany to meet prospects and customers.

  • Work from our new German office: We are soon opening a new office in Hamburg.

  • Visit our Ghent HQ approximately every six weeks to connect with your colleagues. To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first two weeks.

  • You will report directly to our GTM Lead, who is looking forward to coaching you extensively as you build the German market and grow your career at Peripass.

What we offer

  • Front-row seat to scale-up growth: Be part of the next growth phase of Peripass in the German and have a direct impact on building our market presence.

  • Opportunity in a growing market: Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionising yard management in logistics, with the opportunity to make an impact in Germany.

  • Uncapped earning potential: A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn.

  • Ownership and freedom: Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best.

  • Backed by a strong team: From BDR and marketing to pre-sales and Customer Success, you'll have a strong team behind you, helping you create, close and grow opportunities.

  • A role with real impact: Help shape our German sales approach, market strategy and way of working as the team and market continue to grow.

  • Awesome office in the heart of Hamburg with a dedicated team, combined with travel to clients and the option to work from home.


Come on, blow us away with your credentials! 💥 You will if you have:

  • At least five years of work experience, including two years of relevant experience owning a full sales cycle.

  • Experience working in a high-growth environment, preferably in SaaS or a similar context.

  • Experience managing complex decision-making units and closing deals of a comparable size.

  • Hunter mindset: You are not afraid of outbound sales or creating opportunities from scratch. Working in a scale-up means that you are willing to hunt, generate leads and actively open doors with new prospects. Of course, you will be supported by our BDR team, but mindset is key!

  • Strong stakeholder management skills for complex decision-making units and sales processes in international corporate environments.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English.

title: Account Executive, Digital Natives
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across DACH. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English and German

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Account Executive, Partnerships – SME & Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

How you'll make impact

You'll help turn partner-referred opportunities into successful customer relationships across the UK SME market. By combining consultative selling with strong partner collaboration, you'll help growing businesses solve their cross-border financial challenges with Airwallex.

  • Own the full sales cycle for partner-referred SME opportunities, from qualification and consultative discovery through commercial negotiation, closing and initial onboarding.

  • Convert high-intent referrals into active, growing Airwallex customers by understanding each business's cross-border financial setup, operational challenges and growth plans.

  • Build deep product expertise across multi-currency business accounts, global transfers, corporate cards, treasury management, spend management and payment processing.

  • Partner closely with GTM Partner Managers and referral partners to communicate Airwallex's value proposition, strengthen referral relationships and move opportunities forward.

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Revenue Operations and Onboarding to execute commercial agreements and deliver a smooth customer experience.

  • Exceed revenue and account activation targets through effective, value-based selling, while sharing best practices that improve partner-sales conversion.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience in fintech, commercial banking or B2B SaaS.

  • Demonstrated experience selling financial solutions such as cross-border FX, treasury, business banking, payments or corporate cards to SME customers.

  • A track record of consistently meeting or exceeding OKRs or KPIs in a consultative selling environment.

  • Strong commercial and strategic instincts, with the ability to understand customer needs and recommend tailored solutions.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and standard sales enablement technology.

  • Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience working directly with referral partners, ecosystem partners or strategic alliances to drive sales pipeline.

  • A solid working understanding of API integrations.

  • Experience managing complex pipelines and multi-stakeholder deals in a fast-paced environment.

  • A strong track record of cross-functional alignment with Risk, Legal and Onboarding teams.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you're motivated by stretch goals.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | Field Sales Bayern, München
descriptionHtml:
Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 München/Süddeutschland: Homeoffice plus Kundentermine in deiner Region, monatliche Teamtage in Berlin.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Job Title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector

Reporting to: Director of Sales, UK & Ireland

Direct Reports: None

Location: UK (remote)

Travel expectations: Approximately 50%

Your Impact

As an Account Executive at Axon, you will play a key role in helping police forces across the UK adopt technology that saves lives, reduces risk to officers and the public, and enhances transparency and public trust. You will be supporting the adoption of Axon's ecosystem of products - including body-worn and in-car cameras, TASER devices, and cloud-based software platforms including our digital evidence management system - across forces in the UK. Your success will be measured by your ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships, drive large, complex opportunities through public sector procurement, and align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK policing. This is a quota-carrying, external field position.

At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for their contribution to the company's mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

What You'll Do

Develop and Execute Account Strategies: Create comprehensive account strategies that align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK police forces, focusing on officer safety, operational efficiency and digital transformation. This will require close collaboration with other internal members of the account team(s).

Drive Complex Sales Engagements: Manage long sales cycles, leading to high-value, multi-year agreements with forces and police-led collaboratives. Facilitate discovery meetings, present Axon's value propositions, and lead customer negotiations.

Help increase market share and achieve Axon's strategic objectives by maximising revenue and customer satisfaction within your designated forces and regions.

Support Public Safety Innovation: Partner with internal teams to present Axon's innovative public safety technologies - such as TASER 10, Axon Body 4, Axon Fleet, Axon Evidence, Axon Respond, Axon Fusus and Axon VR training - demonstrating how these solutions transform force operations and support national productivity and efficiency priorities.

Manage Customer Relationships: Cultivate relationships with both executive and operational leaders within police forces - including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners and their offices, Chief Finance Officers, Heads of Digital/IT and operational commanders. Ensure seamless customer experiences through proactive engagement and problem-solving.

Champion Public Safety Outcomes: Position Axon as a key enabler of UK policing priorities, helping forces meet their operational and safety goals while enhancing transparency, accountability and public confidence.

Collaborate with Internal Teams: Work closely with Axon's customer success, engineering and programme management teams to ensure that customer projects are delivered on time and that forces derive measurable value from Axon's solutions.

Navigate UK Public Sector Procurement: Work with force commercial and procurement teams, national frameworks and police-owned commercial routes to structure compliant, competitive routes to market, and manage the associated governance and approvals.

Accurate CRM Management: Maintain up-to-date records of customer interactions, opportunities and forecasts in Salesforce. Use this data to drive proactive sales strategies and ensure visibility for internal stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators

Revenue Growth: Achieve or exceed annual revenue targets by closing high-value opportunities with UK police forces.

Market Penetration: Lead the expansion of Axon's solutions across UK policing.

Strategic Solution Selling: Collaborate with forces to identify and address their pain points through Axon's full suite of products, including Axon Records, Fleet and Evidence.com. Develop tailored solutions that result in improved officer safety, enhanced force transparency and streamlined workflows.

Executive Relationships: In conjunction with Axon UK leadership and other team members, establish and maintain high-trust relationships with senior leaders (Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, PCCs, CFOs, CIOs, etc.) within assigned forces, positioning Axon as a long-term partner in public safety technology.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Collaboration: Lead a cross-functional Axon team, including product, engineering and sales engineers, to ensure customer success and satisfaction, delivering 100% on all project commitments for assigned accounts. Develop strong relationships within the UK team and across other divisions throughout Axon to serve as an advocate for our UK customers.

Contract & Negotiation Leadership: Lead the proposal and negotiation process for contracts, ensuring competitive positioning and successful long-term engagements, including through framework call-offs and direct award processes where applicable.

Customer Feedback Loop: Gather actionable insights from assigned forces to inform Axon's product development and ensure that Axon's solutions meet UK policing needs. Contribute at least 5 pieces of actionable product feedback per quarter in partnership with our Customer Success team.

Forecasting Accuracy: Deliver accurate, data-driven forecasts with a 90%+ accuracy rate, maintaining transparency and proactive communication with senior management about your pipeline and expected deal closure.

What You'll Bring

Track Record of Success: Proven experience exceeding sales targets in a complex, consultative sales environment, particularly in public safety, SaaS or cloud-based solutions.

Public Sector Sales Experience: Deep understanding of UK public sector procurement and the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

Solution-Oriented Mindset: Ability to translate complex customer needs into innovative Axon solutions, helping forces enhance public safety, officer accountability and efficiency.

Technical Acumen: Familiarity with cloud computing, SaaS solutions and (preferably) digital evidence management systems. Experience working with police IT and digital leaders to drive cloud and digital transformation initiatives.

Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to work cross-functionally within an organisation to deliver comprehensive, high-impact customer solutions. Leadership experience in managing multi-stakeholder projects is a plus.

Law Enforcement/Public Safety Knowledge: Experience working with UK police forces or wider public safety agencies is a strong plus. Ability to connect Axon's mission and products to the unique challenges of UK policing - including the regulatory, ethical and data protection scrutiny that surrounds police technology.

Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 50% to meet with key customers and stakeholders across the UK.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
descriptionHtml:
Overview

We're looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology.

Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).

Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.

What you'll be doing:

  • AI System Architecture: Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.
  • Infrastructure & Production Engineering: Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.
  • Rapid Client Prototyping: Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, while maintaining the engineering standards required for production deployment.
  • Domain Translation & Integration: Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.
  • Agent Evaluation & Optimisation: Developing frameworks to measure, monitor and improve agent performance. You will design evaluation strategies, identify failure modes, and apply systematic testing to ensure agents are reliable, predictable and effective in real-world environments.

What you need to succeed:

  • Applied AI Expertise: You have hands-on experience building LLM-based agentic systems, with a solid grasp of the fundamentals: planning, reasoning, tool use, memory and orchestration. You know how to evaluate and monitor agents so you can measure how they perform in production.
  • Core Software Fluency: You possess strong programming skills, good testing and deployment practices, and practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You can design scalable, resilient systems, and you know that great agents still require excellent software engineering foundations.
  • Navigating Ambiguity: You are comfortable working with uncertainty and evolving requirements. You break complex, ill-defined problems into clear, logical steps. You recognise that requirements evolve as new information emerges and can make sound engineering judgements about when rapid experimentation is appropriate and when a more rigorous approach is required.
  • Communication: You communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently, adapting your style to different audiences. You are comfortable engaging with clients, engineers, scientists and business leaders, ensuring technical insights translate into meaningful decisions and outcomes.
  • Collaboration and Influence: You know how to challenge constructively, influence through evidence and insight, and help others navigate trade-offs in fast-moving environments.

title: AI & Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AI & Data Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a polyglot engineer who is comfortable across the data stack. This is someone who can build AI-powered tools and data infrastructure that make our platform smarter, our people more effective, and our operations more scalable.

This is not a research role. You'll build real systems that people use every day — Slack bots that investigate production incidents, data pipelines that surface anomalies before clients notice them, and AI agents that turn hours of manual trawling into seconds of guided investigation. You'll work across the full stack: Python and TypeScript for AI tooling and integrations, Go for backend services, and SQL for data analysis and pipeline work.

The person we're looking for ships working software, cares about making people's lives easier, and is energised by the pace of the AI landscape. You don't need to have built LLM applications before — but you should be curious, practical, and comfortable learning fast.

You'll work closely with our TechOps, Connectivity, and Data teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and knowledge gaps — then build the tools and infrastructure that solve them. This is a high-leverage role: the systems you build will multiply the effectiveness of every engineer and operator in the company.

What You'll Work On

  • AI-powered investigation tools — Slack-based bots and agents that automatically analyse support tickets, query production logs, and surface relevant context for incident response

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — authenticated access to ClickHouse, Kubernetes, Atlassian, and GitHub, enabling AI agents to interact with real systems safely

  • Data infrastructure — ClickHouse analytics pipelines, real-time anomaly detection, and platform health monitoring (our "Radar" initiative)

  • AI agent development — constrained, repeatable diagnosis agents that follow investigation playbooks, produce structured outputs, and operate with appropriate guardrails

  • Knowledge engineering — building and curating the corpus that makes our AI tools accurate: documentation, training material, structured metadata, and feedback loops

  • Internal tooling — full-stack applications that bridge the gap between data, AI, and the people who need answers

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong Python — your primary language for AI tooling, data pipelines, and backend services

  • Systems design – you have extensive experience building data-intensive systems. You can consider tradeoffs and manage system complexity

  • TypeScript / JavaScript — for Slack integrations, web interfaces, and full-stack tooling

  • Go experience is a bonus — we use Go extensively for backend services and CLI tooling

  • SQL — comfortable writing analytical queries against large datasets (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, or similar)

  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and tooling — Claude, OpenAI, or similar; prompt engineering, function calling, tool use

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS — your tools will run in production infrastructure

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; engineering instinct cannot

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate quickly, you get things in front of users, you improve based on feedback

  • You bridge domains. You're comfortable moving between AI, data, infrastructure, and product. You don't wait for someone else to define the interface — you go and understand the problem yourself

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You monitor it, you fix it, you make it better

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. Good documentation also makes our AI tools better — every well-written page becomes training material

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication is essential

  • You embrace AI as a tool. You use AI to amplify your own productivity — and you build tools that do the same for others

What You Get

  • Growth — this role sits at the intersection of AI, data, and platform engineering. As the company scales, so does the opportunity. This is a new pod with an exciting remit

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Greenfield AI work — you're not maintaining legacy systems; you're building the next generation of intelligent tooling for a trading platform

  • Real impact — the tools you build will be used daily by engineers, operators, and eventually clients. This is not a side project

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our people

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Technical Interview with a member of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session. ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CTO
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: AI Engineer AivyCare

Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare: een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen.

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg.

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare.

  • Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows.

  • Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen.

  • Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen.

  • Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid.

  • Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden.

  • Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare.


Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. We zoeken iemand die initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en graag werkt aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is.

Jij past waarschijnlijk goed als je:

  • Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur in informatica, AI, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Ervaring hebt met softwareontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld in backend development, integraties of platformontwikkeling.

  • Affiniteit hebt met AI-toepassingen en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe je die inzet in echte producten.

  • Pragmatisch bent en goed functioneert in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

  • Kunt meedenken van concept tot realisatie en verder kijkt dan alleen je eigen code.

  • Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en begrijpt dat betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid in de zorg essentieel zijn.

  • Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines.

  • Enthousiast wordt van onze technologie stack: Java 25, Spring Boot Modulith, FHIR R4, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, React/Vite, Azure Cloud Provider.

  • Enthousiast bent over agentic development met Claude Code.

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel, maar ligt je kracht meer in fullstack, frontend development of operations? Reageer dan gerust. We zoeken bouwers met de juiste mindset; de exacte invulling van de rol bepalen we samen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. Je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, productontwikkeling en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen.

Wij bieden jou onder andere:

  • Een marktconform salaris: tussen €2972 en €5507 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en niveau als Developer.

  • 26 vakantiedagen + 8,33% vakantiegeld: o.b.v. een fulltime (40 uur p/w) dienstverband.

  • Hybride werken: hybride werken betekent bij ons dat je minimaal 3 á 4 dagen per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen interactie en flexibiliteit.

Enthousiast?

Wenn ein Kunde im Workshop sagt „Unsere Produktdaten sind ein Chaos“, willst du kein Konzept schreiben, das in drei Wochen fertig ist. Du willst ihm am Nachmittag zeigen, wie es aussehen könnte.

Wenn du bei „Workshop“ an Moderationskarten und Flipchart denkst, wird das hier nichts. Wenn du dabei an deinen Laptop mit Claude Code denkst: lies weiter.

Wer wir sind

creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Beratung und Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie NKD, Mövenpick, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell und Bergzeit.

Dieses Jahr haben wir richtig abgeräumt: Agentur des Jahres, dazu zwei Auszeichnungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – Best Customer Experience mit benuta, Best Mobile Experience mit Bergzeit.

Was das im Alltag bedeutet:

  • Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.

  • 50 % Freiheit, 50 % Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.

  • Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.

  • Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht.

  • Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben.

Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt schaffen

Zwei Gründe, beide ehrlich:

1. Unsere Kunden wollen keine Shops mehr. Sie wollen Lösungen. Produktdaten, ERP, Schnittstellen, Automatisierung, KI – die spannenden Fragen liegen heute zwischen den Systemen. Dafür brauchen wir Leute, die im Workshop zuhören, verstehen, wo es wirklich weh tut, und einen Vorschlag auf den Tisch legen, den man anfassen kann.

2. KI verändert, wie Beratung funktioniert. Ein Prototyp dauert heute Stunden statt Wochen. Wir wollen Kunden nicht erklären, was möglich wäre – wir wollen es ihnen zeigen. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest sie von Anfang an mit.

Deine Mission

Verstehen, bevor du löst. Du führst Discovery-Workshops mit unseren Kunden: Prozesse, Datenflüsse, Systemlandschaft. Du fragst so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt – und das steht selten im Briefing.

Nie mit leeren Händen kommen. Vor dem Workshop baust du eine erste Version. Im Workshop diskutiert ihr am konkreten Beispiel statt an abstrakten Folien. Manchmal iterierst du live, während alle zuschauen.

Vibe-Coding als Werkzeug, nicht als Spielerei. Vor allem mit Claude Code baust du in Stunden einen klickbaren Prototyp: ein PIM-Datenmodell, einen Schnittstellen-Mock, einen KI-Agenten, der Produkttexte schreibt. Produktionscode schreiben unsere Devs in Polen. Dein Job ist zu zeigen, was möglich ist.

Lösungen skizzieren, die halten. Shop, PIM, ERP, KI – du zeichnest, wer was macht, wo die Daten leben und wie die Systeme miteinander reden. Und du kannst begründen, warum.

Die Brücke ins Team. Nach dem Workshop übergibst du an Projektleitung und Entwicklung so, dass alle wissen, was gebaut wird und warum. Bei Pitches bist du dabei, wenn es technisch konkret wird.

Du bist unser Mensch, wenn

  • Du verstehst, wie ein Händler tickt: Produktdaten, Bestellungen, Bestände, Kanäle. Ob du aus Beratung, Pre-Sales, Projektleitung oder Entwicklung kommst, ist uns egal.

  • Du technisch wirklich mitreden kannst: Datenmodelle, APIs, Schnittstellen, Systemarchitektur. Produktionscode musst du nicht schreiben. Aber du kannst erklären, warum eine Variante kein eigenes Produkt ist und wann ein Webhook besser ist als der nächtliche CSV-Export.

  • KI-Tools dein Alltag sind, nicht dein Vorsatz fürs nächste Jahr. Du hast damit schon Dinge gebaut, die funktionieren – und zeigst sie uns gern.

  • Du einen Raum führen kannst: acht Leute aus Einkauf, IT und Marketing, drei Meinungen pro Person, und am Ende trotzdem ein Ergebnis.

  • Du Fragen stellst, bevor du Antworten gibst.

  • Es dich nicht nervös macht, Unfertiges zu zeigen. Ein Prototyp ist zum Kaputtmachen da.

  • Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.

Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Shopware, Magento oder Shopify, mit PIM- oder ERP-Erfahrung (Pimcore, Akeneo, Odoo, SAP, Business Central) und mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite.

Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst.

Was du bei uns bekommst

  • Gehalt: abhängig von deiner Erfahrung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde.

  • Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten.

  • Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt.

  • Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst.

  • MacBook Pro und iPhone, ordentliche Peripherie inklusive.

  • Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn.

  • Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann bewirb dich über unser Bewerbungsformular oder schick deine Unterlagen inklusive CV an ----- Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Viel lieber: ein Link zu etwas, das du mit KI gebaut hast. Darf ruhig unfertig sein.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: AIT Test & Assembly Technician
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit and that can carry cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are looking for a hands-on and rigorous AIT Test Technician (proto) to support the preparation, integration, execution, and reporting of environmental and functional test activities for spacecraft sub-systems and hardware.

This role is critical to ensuring that all testing activities are executed safely, accurately, and according to procedures and quality standards. The ideal candidate is meticulous, structured, technically skilled, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced aerospace development environment.


Key Responsibilities

Environmental Test Preparation & Execution

  • Supportthe setup, integration, and execution of environmental tests including:

    • Vibration testing

    • Shock testing

    • Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing

    • Ancillary testing activities

  • Support the preparation and execution of experimental campaigns for the qualification of prototypes of components developed internally, such as valves

    • MGSE machining (milling, drilling, helicoil installation, ...)

    • FGSE preparation (valves, pressure controllers, ...)

  • Prepare hardware, tooling, instrumentation, and Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for test campaigns taking ownership of their readiness.

  • Perform assembly and integration activities of prototypes. Provide feedback to the engineering team relative to the lessons learnt during the assembly execution.

  • Install thermocouples, accelerometers, harnessing, and instrumentation according to test procedures and engineering requirements.

  • Operate environmental test equipment including vibration shaker, shock test facility, TVAC facility, and associated monitoring systems.

  • Perform pre-test and post-test inspections of test setups.

  • Support testing at external test facilities.

  • Support assembly activities at external facilities and different TEC locations.

Procedures, Documentation & Reporting

  • Prepare and execute test procedures with adherence to safety, cleanliness, and quality standards.

  • Ensure all operations are properly documented and traceable.

  • Report anomalies, and observations during operations.

  • Verify that tools, instrumentation, and measurement equipment comply with calibration requirements before use.

Tooling, Equipment & Facility Support

  • Maintain and organize tooling, sensors, adapters, cables, and test equipment.

  • Monitor the condition and calibration status of test assets and measurement equipment.

  • Perform first-level maintenance and troubleshooting on test equipment and support systems.

  • Support the integration and validation of new tooling and test setups.

  • Assist engineers in defining and improving test processes, setups, and operational workflows.

  • Ensure laboratory and test areas remain organized, safe, and operationally ready.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Technical degree or vocational training in aerospace, electronics, mechatronics, industrial systems, or a related technical field.

  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, defense, industrial testing, or other high-reliability technical environments.

  • Hands-on experience with environmental testing equipment such as vibration tables, thermal chambers, or instrumentation systems is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with laboratory operations, instrumentation installation, and mechanical integration activities.

  • Experience working with calibrated equipment, controlled procedures, and technical documentation is a strong plus.


Expected Technical Skills

  • Ability to read and follow technical procedures and engineering drawings.

  • Experience with mechanical assembly and test setups.

  • Basic understanding of sensors and instrumentation systems.

  • Familiarity with torque tools, measurement equipment, and laboratory/test equipment.

  • Knowledge of safety procedures related to environmental testing activities.

  • Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in technical environments.


Personal Qualities

  • Strong rigor and attention to detail.

  • Structured and disciplined way of working.

  • Hands-on mindset with a proactive attitude.

  • Ability to identify and communicate anomalies clearly and accurately.

  • Team player with good communication skills.

  • Reliable, organized, and accountable.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced and evolving environments.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

title: Android Engineer
descriptionHtml:
📍London / UK Remote | Engineer III💰 £85,000 - £110,000 base salary per year + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology 

About our Mobile Engineering discipline

Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds

There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.

 Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams

We have around 600 engineers out of roughly 5,000 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

Your day-to-day

We’re searching for product-focused Android engineers to evolve our native mobile app.You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. 

You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 15 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.

As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.

You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both what we build, and how we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.

Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.

You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.

Our Android app

Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.

Around 95% of the codebase is in Compose. We use Coroutines, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Metro for dependency injection. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data.

We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.

We’ve previously written about building Monzo Chat on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.

You should apply if

  • You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output
  • You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Kotlin
  • You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the Play Store
  • You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • You love turning excellent design into beautiful products
  • You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • You have an understanding computer science principles

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions or want to talk through reasonable adjustments ahead of or during application please us at any point on -----

Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

There’s a detailed blog on the interview process, for extra details, hints and tips.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

What’s in it for you

💰 £78,000 - £110,000 base salary per year + Incentive Awards tied to your performance+ Benefits, we also provide all of our engineers with the latest MacBook Pro.

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅We can sponsor visas.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. title: Applied AI Engineer

We apply frontier models and agentic systems to how quantitative research, software development, and other critical work at HRT gets done. We combine cutting-edge commercial and open-source models and tools with infrastructure, research, and systems of our own.
