title: Applied AI - Member of Technical Staff
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Applied AI Research at Callosum discovers the methods that make real AI workloads faster, cheaper and better, and turns them into systems that run in production. You will study how agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines and code intelligence stacks actually behave, then invent ways to optimise them at a systems level.

A single optimisation can touch agent and workflow design, context and prompting, model choice, the serving stack and the silicon underneath. So we don't hire specialists in one layer. We hire researchers who can reason across the whole system, from agentic design down to the specifics of the model, and who have a feel for how inference and hardware shape what is possible.

The role is research-led and engineering-heavy. You will need first-principles judgment to see what kind of system a problem needs, the rigour to prove that it works, and the engineering skill to build it yourself.

You will sit across our research and platform functions. What you discover becomes product capability, and what you see in real workloads sets the research agenda. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI Research function as the team scales.

What You'll Work On

Our research tries to construct optimal inference systems from the silicon layer all the way up to the harness: the system will learn from the actual deployment profile and tasks it is used on and optimise itself. Open problems you will own include:

•⁠ ⁠Reverse-engineering agentic systems. Infer the structure of agentic systems from minimal data, and find where it spends compute it doesn't need to.

•⁠ ⁠Routing. Build robust routers that send each request to the cheapest or fastest path that strictly matches or beats the incumbent model on quality.

•⁠ ⁠Proving there is no regression. Design layered proxy evaluations, that bound quality ever more tightly, from coarse checks down to a granular understanding of the system.

•⁠ ⁠New optimisation surface area. Extend the same automatic, detection to new optimisation techniques, and help decide which ones we pursue next.

•⁠ ⁠Research that ships. Run rigorous experiments, write up what you learn, and work with our platform team to turn what works into general product capability.

•⁠ ⁠Shared research infrastructure. Build the evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and experiment tooling the team runs on.

How We Work

•⁠ ⁠Generalists by design. Our cadence is fast and our priorities move as we learn. You will move between projects as the problem demands, so breadth and the speed at which you learn matter more than depth in one niche.

•⁠ ⁠Research judged by production. A result counts when it holds on real workloads. Ideas move quickly from hypothesis to experiment to a deployed system.

•⁠ ⁠Close to real workloads. You work from real production systems and pipelines. Customer contact is scoped: team members who show an aptitude for it can take on more customer-facing technical work, but it is not the core of the role.

•⁠ ⁠A mix of experience. We hire across seniority levels. Experienced researchers bring proven practice from large-scale AI development, earlier-career members bring speed and fresh eyes, and each learns from the other.

What You Bring

•⁠ ⁠Broad, foundational knowledge across the modern AI stack: agent and workflow design, LLMs and how they work inside, and inference and serving. You can reason about how a change in one layer affects the others.

•⁠ ⁠Exceptional technical depth, demonstrated through any of: research that shipped, production AI systems at scale, or an early or founding role where you owned the system end to end.

•⁠ ⁠Rigour in experimental design, evaluation and benchmarking. You can tell a real improvement from noise, and you design the measurement before you trust the result.

•⁠ ⁠A very fast learner who goes to first principles when the map runs out.

•⁠ ⁠Strong engineering skills: you build the systems you research.

•⁠ ⁠A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership.

What Sets You Apart

•⁠ ⁠An early or founding role at an AI-first, deep-tech company, where you made key technical decisions from first principles.

•⁠ ⁠You have designed and built multi-agent or agentic systems from the ground up, and you also have depth lower in the stack.

•⁠ ⁠Low-level systems or performance engineering: kernels, serving engines or latency-critical systems.

•⁠ ⁠Experience of large-scale AI development at a frontier lab or big tech company, and the engineering practices that come with it.

•⁠ ⁠Research in inference optimisation, model internals, evaluation, routing or distillation.

•⁠ ⁠Publications, open-source work or public write-ups that show how you think.

•⁠ ⁠Familiarity with novel accelerator platforms.

•⁠ ⁠Experience working directly with external engineering teams.

What We Offer

•⁠ ⁠Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

•⁠ ⁠Equity & Ownership

•⁠ ⁠Private healthcare

•⁠ ⁠We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

•⁠ ⁠We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

title: Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

The role

Large, high-volume contracts mean our factories need to run around the clock. Overnight shifts can bridge the gap, but the long-term answer is automated machine tending. The market is crowded, with billet, vice, pallet and bar feed systems and many more, so rather than designing our own we work with external system integrators.

You will own machine tending across our factories: choose the right solutions, manage the integrators who deploy them, and keep the cells running. You won't be designing and building cells yourself. Your job is to make sure the ones we buy deliver, and see them running on a live factory floor. The package includes equity.

  • Scope automation projects and choose the right machine tending setup for each cell.

  • Manage external system integrators through procurement, installation and commissioning.

  • Own the performance and uptime of automated cells once they're live.

  • Build a long-term procurement plan for automation as we add machines and sites.

  • Work with operators on the floor so automation fits how the factory runs.

What you bring

  • Automation, controls or system integration experience in manufacturing, whether at an integrator, an OEM machine builder, a larger manufacturer with its own automation team, or a machine shop with serious machine tending.

  • Hands-on experience with PLCs (Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley), HMI/SCADA, and industrial robots or cobots (FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Universal Robots).

  • Experience in at least two of: project scoping, cell design or procurement, installation and deployment, maintenance and uptime.

  • Machine safety: risk assessments, guarding, ISO 13849, CE/UKCA.

  • Real time on site, commissioning cells and handling what goes wrong.

  • Useful, not essential: results you can point to such as cycle time, uptime or labour saved, connecting machines to data systems (OPC UA, MES, MQTT), vision systems, sensors, pneumatics or motion control, or an electrical, mechatronics or mechanical degree or apprenticeship.

title: B2B Marketing Graduate at United Media
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next B2B Marketing Graduate.

About us

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. To this date, we have organically launched six companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our B2B Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Branch Support Manager - Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Rain for Rent International

Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units.

Your role

We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions.

This is not a traditional IT Manager position.

It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership. You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective.

What you will do

Become a Business Systems Expert

You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users.

A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as:

  • Purchasing and purchase orders

  • Goods and invoice receipt

  • Rental contracts

  • Equipment on-hire and off-hire

  • Recurring and final billing

  • Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing

  • Customer, supplier and item master data

You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications.

Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly.

Help People Get the Best From Technology

You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working.

That includes:

  • Providing practical systems and process support

  • Training new and existing users

  • Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials

  • Creating screen recordings and short training videos

  • Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library

  • Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes

Most importantly, you will explain the why, not only the how.

Connect Systems With Business Reality

Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly.

You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data.

You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business.

Listen, Challenge and Improve

Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements.

Your job is not simply to say yes.

You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else.

For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership.

Lead a Small Team

You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities.

This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself.

Stay Curious

Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it.

You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot, automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively.

The Person We Are Looking For

Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much.

You are someone who:

  • Listens before proposing a solution

  • Is patient and enjoys explaining things

  • Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience

  • Builds credibility and strong working relationships

  • Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy

  • Is comfortable constructively challenging a request

  • Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs

  • Learns new business processes quickly

  • Enjoys solving problems

  • Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business

  • Is curious about technology and AI

You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership.

European Scope

The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France.

Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations, build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice.

Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

  • How we use our business systems

  • How we support and train users

  • How processes are standardised across countries

  • How knowledge is documented and shared

  • How new technology and AI are adopted

  • How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves

If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you.

Rain for Rent International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
department: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

Starting date: Fall 2026

title: Chef.fe de Projet numérique en santé / Project Manager Healthtech
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

  • Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

  • Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

  • Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

  • L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

Soft skills

Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.

title: Client Success Manager - 100% Remote (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

EINSTIEGSGEHALT: 40.000–55.000 € BRUTTO-JAHRESGEHALT (ABHÄNGIG VON BERUFSERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATION)

Du bist erfahren in der Kundenbetreuung und hast es drauf, langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen? Du kannst dich in technische Probleme deiner Kunden reinfuchsen und es macht dich happy, für sie den Unterschied zu machen? Bei Digistore24 - einem der Top-IT-Unternehmen Deutschlands - kannst du in einem kollaborativen Remote-Arbeitsumfeld wachsen!

Bitte beachte: Diese Position setzt fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse voraus.

👀 Du siehts die Stelle schon länger? Ja, das Team wächst stetig, wie unser Kundenstamm.

Über Digistore24

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Technologieunternehmen und haben eine klare Vision: We shape the digital future.
Unsere Mission? Menschen weltweit dabei zu unterstützen, ihr Wissen online zu teilen und sich damit ein eigenes, erfolgreiches Business aufzubauen. Mit unserer Platform ermöglichen wir Millionen von Menschen den Zugang zu wertvollem Wissen und geben ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, ihre Ziele wirklich zu erreichen.

Was uns besonders macht:Wir sind rund 200 hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende, die nicht auf Anweisungen warten, sondern ihren Alltag aktiv gestalten und jeden Tag neu verbessern - genau wie unsere Kunden.
Unser Team ist so vielfältig wie unsere Ideen: Menschen aus über 40 verschiedenen Ländern arbeiten bei uns gemeinsam an einer Vision. Was uns verbindet, sind unsere Werte, unser Antrieb und unser Anspruch, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Wir sind keine großen Redner: wir sind Macher. We love to perform.
Mit unserem Wachstum bauen wir unsere Teams gezielt und nachhaltig aus und suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und mit uns die Zukunft gestalten.

Dein neuer Traumjob

Bilde deine Software- & Online-Marketing-Expertise und trage zur Digitalisierung kleiner und mittlerer Unternehmen bei!

  • Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust deinen eigenen festen Kundenstamm, baust langfristige und persönliche Beziehungen auf und kümmerst dich vorausschauend um deine Kunden, indem du sie z. B. proaktiv ansprichst.
  • Software- & Online-Marketing-Beratung: Nach einem gründlichen Onboarding wirst du zum Spezialisten für Online-Marketing und Software-Anwendungen. Du beantwortest Fragen deiner Kunden rund um unsere Software im Kontext von Online-Marketing ‒ schriftlich und telefonisch sowie auf unterschiedlichen Kanälen wie z. B. WhatsApp. So wächst dein Know-How jeden Tag!
  • Kundenzufriedenheitsmanagement: Werde zum zentralen Ansprechpartner für alle Kundenanliegen – von neuen Ideen (Feature-Anfragen) bis hin zu Problemen (Bug-Meldungen). Du verifizierst Bugs oder sammelst detaillierte Informationen zu Feature-Wünschen und leitest alles strukturiert an die Entwicklung weiter. Dabei identifizierst du fortlaufend Verbesserungspotenzial und Herausforderungen aus dem Kundenkontakt und teilst diese proaktiv mit deinem Team, um unsere Prozesse und die Erfüllung der Kundenbedürfnisse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Repräsentation von Digistore24: Ob bei internationalen VIP-Kunden-Events, einem Business-Lunch oder auf Messen ‒ du verstehst es, Kundenbeziehungen auch face to face zu pflegen.

PS: Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine Vertriebsstelle.

Unsere Werte

Bitte schau dir die WIRKLICH genau an. Bist du bereit diese zu leben?

Stellenanforderungen

Deine Superkräfte

  • Kommunikationsgeschick: Du kommunizierst präzise und empfängerfreundlich. Potenzielle Konflikte entschärfst du durch Feingefühl und Lösungsorientierung. Gegenüber Kunden und deinem Team triffst du - auch unter Zeitdruck - stets den richtigen Ton and you can seamlessly switch to English if necessary.
  • Account Management: Du besitzt mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung. Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du schriftlich und mündlich versiert. Nice-to-have sind Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS sowie Erfahrung im Online-Marketing.
  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und kannst eigenverantwortlich Prioritäten setzen. Dank deiner ausgezeichneten Planung behältst du auch in Stresssituationen stets den Überblick und arbeitest im Homeoffice effektiv.
  • Hohe Motivation: Unsere Branche entwickelt sich ständig weiter. Um deine Kunden als Experte optimal zu beraten, verfolgst du daher laufend aktuelle Trends und hast Spaß daran, dich immer wieder eigenverantwortlich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Dieser Job ist NICHT für dich geeignet, wenn du:

  • … weniger als 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung hast.
  • … bei gelegentlich anfallenden späten Kundenterminen unflexibel bist.
  • … dich schwertust mit der Planung und Priorisierung deiner Aufgaben.
  • … keinen Spaß daran hast, (technische) Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen.
  • … lieber nur schriftlich oder nur telefonisch kommunizierst und beim bevorzugten Kommunikationsweg deiner Kunden unflexibel bist.
  • … lieber an kurzweiligen Kundenanfragen arbeitest, als Kunden langfristig zu betreuen.
  • … keine Lust auf Social Media hast - deine Kunden sind dort präsent und aktiv. :)
  • … nicht den Anspruch hast, dein Wissen laufend auszubauen.
  • ... dich nicht mit unseren identifizierst.

Deine Benefits bei Digistore24

Bei Digistore24 sind wir überzeugt: Großartige Menschen leisten ihre beste Arbeit, wenn sie echte Autonomie, klare Ziele und ein unterstützendes Umfeld haben. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • 100 % Remote: Arbeite dauerhaft von zu Hause aus. Alles, was du brauchst, ist eine stabile Internetverbindung.
  • Du bist permanent außerhalb Deutschlands ansässig? Auch das ist in Festanstellung in vielen europäischen Ländern möglich.
  • Arbeite bis zu 170 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland (weitere Länder nach Absprache ggf. möglich).
  • Nutze bis zu 3 Tage pro Woche die Coworking-Spaces unseres Partners.
  • 30 Urlaubstage auf Vollzeitbasis.
  • Klare Strukturen: Arbeiteim Gleitzeitmodell und in Absprache mit deinem Team.
  • Keine starren Entwicklungspläne: Deine Weiterentwicklung richtet sich individuell nach deinen Stärken. On the job setzt du dich mit modernen und relevanten Themen auseinander.
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Die Stabilität eines extrem erfolgreichen deutschen Hightech-Unternehmens, das sich seinen Start-Up-Spirit über die Jahre bewahrt hat.
  • Unsere Founder sind Teil unseres Teams: wir agieren ohne externe Investoren aus eigener Kraft und reinvestieren alles, was wir erwirtschaften.
  • Selbstbestimmte, ergebnisorientierte Teams: Arbeite in einer Unternehmenskultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und direktes Feedback setzt, statt auf Micromanagement.
  • Du erhältst von uns modernes Equipment für deine Arbeit.
  • Internationale, kollaborative Kultur: Arbeite mit einem internationalen Team aus engagierten, klugen Köpfen zusammen.
  • Team Lunches mit Lieferando-Guthaben.
  • Echte menschliche Verbindung: Erlebe spektakuläre Team-Events in ganz Europa und baue Beziehungen auf, die über Bildschirme hinausgehen.
  • Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Bei uns bist du kein Rädchen im System, sondern ein wichtiger Teil eines A-Player-Teams und wirst von der Teamleitung persönlich gefördert (und gechallenged!), unter anderem in monatlichen One-on-One-Gesprächen. .
  • Arbeite in deinem Team per du, ohne Dresscode und auf Augenhöhe.

Dein typischer Tag bei Digistore24

  • Struktur ist alles: Zum Start screenst du alle Nachrichten. Auf dieser Grundlage priorisierst und planst du deine heutigen Aufgaben.
  • Du beginnst mit den wichtigsten Kundenanfragen: Einem Kunden, dem du gestern bei der Genehmigung seines digitalen Produktes geholfen hast, beantwortest du noch eine Rückfrage zum Multi-Upsell-Feature.
  • Jetzt steht ein virtueller Kaffee-Call an: Die nächsten 15 Minuten sind für einen entspannten Austausch beim Kaffee mit einer Teamkollegin reserviert.
  • Weiter geht’s mit der Bearbeitung neuer Kundenanfragen per E-Mail und Voice-Message, die während deines Kaffee-Calls reingekommen sind. Technische Fragen zu APIs, Upsell-Flows und Split-Tests beantwortest du dank deines detaillierten Onboarding sowie einer Checkliste im Handumdrehen!
  • Ping! Dich schreibt ein VIP-Kunde über WhatsApp an und bittet dich um Unterstützung bei einem dringenden technischen Problem, das dir neu ist. Du überlegst dir Lösungsvorschläge und postest diese im Team-Chat. Deine Kollegin meldet sich prompt mit Feedback. Du rufst deinen Kunden an und erklärst ihm die Lösung, Dein Kunde ist happy und es ist gut zu wissen, dass dein Team dir Rückendeckung gibt!
  • In deiner Mittagspause triffst du Freunde bei deinem Lieblings-Italiener um die Ecke. Diese Freiheit kannst du dir nehmen, weil du remote arbeitest, und die Pause frei gestalten kannst.
  • Zurück am Schreibtisch klingelt dein Handy. Deine VIP-Kundin ist dran - eine Ärztin, die Health-Coachings anbietet. Sie launcht morgen ihren Online-Kurs, doch die Produktgenehmigung hat ein Problem gemeldet. Du prüfst den Freigabeprozess. Der Grund ist schnell klar: Die Preise auf der Produktseite und im Bestellformular stimmen nicht überein. Nach der Anpassung informierst du das Produktgenehmigungsteam. Das Produkt geht online, deine Kundin ist dankbar, und Tausende von Menschen kommen ihren Gesundheitszielen näher.
  • Motiviert gehst du in den Team-Call. Ihr besprecht die Entwicklung neuer Features bei Digistore24 und tauscht euch zu Fragen sowie aktuellen technischen Updates aus.
  • Deine Teamleiterin informiert euer Team über ein neues AI-Tool, das interne Meetings aufzeichnet und Action-Items zusammengefasst. Du nimmst dir Zeit, um dich in die Nutzung einzuarbeiten. So bleibst du bei uns on top der modernsten Technologie.
  • Danach steht ein Check-in-Call mit einer Kundin an. Du hast Ideen zur Erschließung neuer Märkte für ihr Produkt und präsentierst nun deine Ideen, um sie aktiv voranzubringen.
  • Vor dem Feierabend checkst du noch schnell Social Media, um zu sehen, was deine Kunden bewegt. So bist du stets am Puls ihres Business und stärkst die Beziehung aktiv durch regelmäßige, wertschätzende Kommentare.
  • Mit einem guten Gefühl gehst du in den Feierabend: Heute hast du wieder Neues gelernt und konstruktives Feedback von Kunden und Kollegen bekommen. Es ist einfach super zu sehen, was du bewegen kannst!

title: Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA)
descriptionHtml:
About Norm

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.

AI Fluency:
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

As a Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA), you will work on a high impact team that provides important services to Norm Law’s clients, while using AI agents to streamline the drafting, review, and execution process in providing non-disclosure agreement review for clients. You’ll collaborate closely with partners, clients, and technology teams to deliver efficient, precise, and data-driven legal services for in-house legal teams of leading asset managers.

Our practice embraces the use of AI to reduce burden and increase your ability to focus on strategic legal judgment and client engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Document Drafting, Review, and Negotiation: Leverage AI agents to generate, compare, negotiate, and redline NDAs tailored to client guidelines

  • Incorporating Legal Context: Advise clients on their NDA playbooks and market standards, including ensuring AI agents understand each client's specific context and comparing client’s actual practices with playbook positions in order to guide updates.

  • NDA Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management, execution, negotiation, and coordination with counterparties for any NDAs.

  • Client Advisory: Partner with clients to demonstrate how AI-assisted workflows improve accuracy, transparency, and velocity.

  • Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the NDA review process even more efficient using AI.

  • Managing high volumes of requests: Maintain a tracker, manage multiple high priority requests simultaneously and communicate timing expectations to clients and consistently and proactively follow up and move negotiations forward.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Qualified solicitor admitted in England and Wales, with a current Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) practising certificate.

  • 2-3+ years of experience reviewing NDAs or similar agreements.

  • Strong drafting and communication skills; meticulous attention to detail.

  • Interest in applying technology to enhance traditional deal workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Learn firm AI platforms; begin supporting the commercial contracts team using AI-enabled review and drafting.

  • 60 Days: Independently manage discrete components of NDA review with AI support.

  • 90 Days: Lead AI-augmented workstreams in live NDA reviews, improving efficiency and accuracy in document management and execution processes.

Benefits

Benefits: pension plan with an employer contribution, medical and dental insurance coverage, employee referral bonus program, initial 2 week onboarding in the US.

Work Location

Location: Central London

Work model: Hybrid

In-office expectation: 4-5 days per week

Why Join Norm Law

You’ll be part of the founding UK team bringing a proven US category leader to a receptive UK market. You’ll have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to build meaningful relationships — backed by a world-class product, an experienced executive team, and a growing global reputation.

To learn more about Norm, visit our website.

title: Commercial Senior Manager, Expansion Markets
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a sharp, commercially-minded finance leader to own our Germany Expansion Market's financial strategy and lay the foundations for European expansion.

You'll act as the central voice on performance, forecasting, and financial decision-making. From CAC and contribution margin to free cash flow and scenario planning, you’ll be responsible for turning financial insight into action.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional leaders across growth, operations, product, and care to shape the our Germany and AMEA Expansion Market's financial trajectory, while ensuring the business runs efficiently and invests wisely. This is a high-trust, high-impact role where the stakes, and the pace, are high.

While this role is DE and Expansion market focused today, it has clear runway to grow into a broader European leadership role as we expand across new markets and business lines.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Own the Germany and AMEA Expansion Market financial model — Build and manage end-to-end models for revenue, CAC, LTV, margin, and free cash flow. Your outputs will guide day-to-day decisions and long-term bets.
  • Lead the planning process — Drive monthly re-forecasting, annual planning, and scenario modelling in close collaboration with Group FP&A.
  • Be the commercial partner to growth and ops — Set CAC and payback targets, assess performance by cohort, and guide spend allocation to maximise ROI.
  • Run commercial analysis that unlocks growth — Lead deep dives into pricing, retention, margin, and expansion levers to identify opportunities and recommend trade-offs.
  • Make the numbers visible — Build dashboards and trackers for key DE performance metrics (e.g. contribution margin, CAC, LTV, cash flow), keeping the business tightly aligned.
  • Ensure clean, accurate financial operations — Partner with Group Finance on reconciliations, cost allocation, and timely month-end closes.
  • Build for scale — Design financial systems and insights that don’t just serve the German markets, but become the blueprint for future markets.

About You

Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, consulting, or banking, with experience in high-growth or tech-enabled businesses.
  • Proven experience owning P&L and end-to-end planning processes — ideally in a business with both consumer and operational complexity.
  • Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, payback, cash flow dynamics, and how these fuel long-term value creation.
  • Highly proficient in Google Sheets / Excel (bonus points for SQL, Looker, NetSuite, or similar tools).
  • Strong commercial instincts — you're as comfortable in the numbers as you are helping teams make smart, trade-off decisions.

Behaviours & Attitudes

  • You move fast and bias toward action, even without perfect information.
  • You bring a strong point of view, but you’re open to challenge and new ideas.
  • You get energy from messy, complex problems and know how to bring structure and clarity.
  • You own outcomes, not just analysis — you want to see your insights drive performance.
  • You’re calm under pressure, confident with ambiguity, and committed to delivering impact.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

  • What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
  • Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the UK

  • Invest in your growth – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
  • Work flexibly – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
  • Support your well-being – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
  • Take time off – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year
  • Join a connected team – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: Consolidation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Our Group Reporting team is dedicated to delivering high-quality financial information to internal and external stakeholders, facilitating informed decision-making. As Consolidation Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining our commitment to excellence in consolidation and reporting.

Your mission

  • Accurately prepare and consolidate the Group financials  in accordance with IFRS and German GAAP, serving as the primary point of contact for Group month-end-close topics with internal stakeholders.

  • Drive continuous improvement of the Group month-end close processes and control environment, focusing on automation and standardization to ensure effective and efficient system utilization.

  • Lead the coordination of stakeholders for the capitalization of internally generated intangibles, ensuring precise measurement, amortization, and impairment.

  • Own Group-level analytical reconciliations and variance analysis to support the timely and accurate drafting of interim and annual financial statements. 

Your toolkit

  • Educational Foundation: preferably hold a professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA) or an equivalent master's degree

  • Financial Experience: A minimum of 5 years in the finance department of a large company, ideally within the e-commerce sector.

  • Regulatory Know-How: Strong knowledge of IFRS, familiarity with accounting for intangible assets and German GAAP is advantageous.

  • Analytical skills: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, preferably with experience in PowerBI and SQL for data management and querying.

  • Language Prowess: Excellent English skills are a must, and German language skills are a valuable asset.

  • Systems knowledge: Proficiency using SAP or other large ERP system, experience with a consolidation system is advantageous.

  • Work Ethic: Be an independent and structured worker while embracing teamwork and displaying reliable time management.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

title: Customer Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Retail and Consumer team is dedicated to helping clients deliver their strategic objectives through the successful application of Data Science and Frontier AI.

Our work spans the full spectrum of AI capabilities from machine learning to computer vision, simulation, optimisation, generative AI, agentic systems, and bringing these capabilities together in decision intelligence applications. Our solutions help clients understand and better engage with customers, improve commercial and trading decisions, improve the efficiency of end to end operations, and improve colleague experience.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts and shape our go-to-market strategy in order to achieve our ambitious growth targets.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Retail clients, helping them reinvent the way they engage with customers, and the way they operate across commercial, supply chain, stores, online and support functions with AI. You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the Retail sector.

The ideal candidate will be T-shaped: broad enough to advise across AI for a range of firms including adjacent consumer facing sectors, with deep experience in Grocery and/or Fashion & Apparel sectors. We are particularly interested in candidates who have delivered enterprise AI solutions that have enabled real world impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and identifying new clients within the Retail sector (specifically Grocery and Fashion & Apparel)

  • Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major Retail clients, moving from strategic thinking to production-grade software delivery

  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite leaders and partners, acting as a strategic advisor on how AI can automate knowledge work and drive operational efficiency

  • Generating high-value growth for Faculty by shaping compelling commercial pitches and demos that showcase our technical depth and ability to solve sector-specific challenges

  • Elevating Faculty’s industry profile by articulating differentiated propositions and points of view through thought leadership, media engagement, and industry forums

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality client work by guiding multidisciplinary teams and helping them navigate the ambiguity and pace of the sector

  • Managing a practice within a practice - leading cross-functional teams of delivery experts, PhD-calibre engineers and data scientists to further consolidate Faculty’s reputation for pioneering technical and delivery excellence.

Who we're looking for:

  • You’ve managed C-level, complex stakeholder relationships in the Retail industry, with a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence

  • You’re commercially driven - energised by hitting growth targets with a proven track record of shaping opportunities, winning work, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI concepts with clarity to technical and non-technical audiences

  • You are comfortable working alongside deeply technical teams and possess the curiosity to master and discuss AI applications.

  • You exhibit a leadership mindset that balances executive-level strategy with a hands-on approach to unblocking teams, challenging work constructively, and maintaining high quality

  • Some experience in consulting preferred

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Customer Operations Specialist - London
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Customer Experience

Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

The role

  • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

  • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

  • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

  • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

  • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

  • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

  • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

The Bar

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

  • Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.

  • Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things.

  • Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company.

  • Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space.

  • Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy.

  • Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

  • Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar support tooling in a live production environment.

  • Any familiarity with KYC or compliance workflows as they relate to customer onboarding.

  • Experience supporting or managing a small team, even informally, or helping onboard new colleagues.

  • An interest in how stablecoin and DeFi products work and the customer challenges they create.

  • Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

title: Customer Success Manager (w/m/d) - Werkstudium oder Pflichtpraktikum
descriptionHtml:
Ein Abschluss ist bei uns kein Ziel, sondern ein Startpunkt.

Ab da sorgst du dafür, dass aus einem Vertrag ein zufriedener Kunde wird.

Bloom Future bringt Jugendliche zwischen 15 und 20 über Selbstreflexion zu passenden Ausbildungswegen und verbindet sie mit Ausbildungsbetrieben aus der Region. Die Unternehmen kaufen dabei keine Plattform, sie wollen passende Bewerbungen für ihre Ausbildungsplätze. Ob wir das liefern, entscheidet sich nicht im Verkaufsgespräch, sondern in den zwölf Monaten danach.

Warum diese Rolle das Bindeglied ist

Unser Vertrieb gewinnt die Unternehmen, unser Marketing sorgt dafür, dass ihre Stellen bei den richtigen Jugendlichen ankommen. Du sitzt genau dazwischen. Du kennst die Ziele unserer Kunden, siehst in den Zahlen, ob unsere Maßnahmen wirken, und sorgst dafür, dass Vertrieb, Marketing und Kunde immer auf demselben Stand sind.

Aufgaben

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach dem Abschluss und begleitest sie durch das Onboarding. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen bringst du ihre Stellenanzeigen auf der Plattform so in Form, dass sie bei Jugendlichen wirklich ankommen.

Danach wird es analytisch. Du wertest aus, wie die Kampagnen und Maßnahmen für unsere Kunden laufen: Wie oft werden die Stellen gesehen, wie viele Klicks und Bewerbungen kommen rein, wo hakt es? Liegt ein Kunde hinter seinen Zielen, erkennst du das früh und stimmst mit dem Marketing ab, welche Maßnahme jetzt greift, etwa eine regionale Anzeigenkampagne oder eine überarbeitete Stellenanzeige.

Aus diesen Zahlen machst du Kommunikation. Du erstellst regelmäßige Reports für unsere Kunden, schreibst Newsletter und hältst den Kontakt so, dass Unternehmen jederzeit wissen, was mit ihren Stellen passiert und was wir als Nächstes tun.

Dabei denkst du das Schuljahr mit. Jugendliche suchen nicht das ganze Jahr gleich, rund um Praktikumsphasen, Halbjahresinformation oder Zeugnisse verändert sich die Nachfrage. Diesen Rhythmus nutzt du, um die richtigen Maßnahmen zur richtigen Zeit anzustoßen.

Und du bist der Kanal zurück ins Team. Du behältst die Vertragslaufzeiten im Blick, damit Kunden zur Verlängerung zufrieden sind und nicht erst dann gefragt werden. Will ein Unternehmen mehr Stellen besetzen, gibt du das an den Vertrieb weiter. Fehlt Kunden etwas im Produkt, landet das bei unserem Produktteam. Weil wir Customer Success gerade so aufbauen, dass er auch mit Hunderten Kunden funktioniert, gestaltest du Abläufe, Vorlagen und Automatisierungen aktiv mit.

Kein reiner Support, der Anfragen abarbeitet. Du verstehst, misst und kommunizierst, in dieser Reihenfolge.

Qualifikation

Wen wir uns vorstellen

Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben und hast rund 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit. Ob du BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation, Psychologie oder etwas ganz anderes studierst, ist zweitrangig. Erste Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Marketing oder Projektarbeit ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Wichtiger ist uns: Du hast keine Scheu vor Zahlen und arbeitest gern mit Google Sheets oder Excel. title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on.

Who We Want

An experienced Data Engineer.
You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself.

Strong in SQL and dbt.
You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation.

At home in the Cloud.
You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine.

Reliability-minded.
You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you.

Curious about the business.
You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure dashboard builder.
You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from.

Pure pipeline plumber.
You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them.

Over-engineer.
You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it.

Remote-only operator.
You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office.

Our Data Stack

  • Warehouse: AWS Redshift
  • Ingestion: Airbyte, custom Python
  • Transformation: dbt
  • Orchestration: Dagster
  • Reverse ETL: Hightouch
  • BI: Metabase
  • Infrastructure & CI: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions

Your Day To Day

  • Own ingestion from our product database, Chargebee, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Amplitude and other tools, using Airbyte where it works and your own Python where it doesn't.
  • Design and build the dbt models that take raw data to gold tables, with clear layers, naming and documentation that the Business Analyst and the rest of the company can rely on.
  • Run orchestration in Dagster: schedules, dependencies, freshness checks and alerting, so a stalled sync gets noticed within hours.
  • Build data quality in: dbt tests, source checks and CI on every pull request.
  • Capture history where our source systems only keep the current state, so a question like "which plan was this customer on last March?" has an answer.
  • Run the warehouse: Redshift performance and cost, access management, and AWS infrastructure in Terraform.
  • Maintain the reverse ETL syncs (Hightouch) that send data back into HubSpot, Intercom and the other tools our teams work in.

Why People Choose Us

Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics

Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable

Real ownership. You own the data platform end to end, not one step of someone else's pipeline

Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup

Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!
