title: Data Engineer III - FMX
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.  Data Engineer III

About the Role
We're looking for a Data Engineer III to join our Data Engineering team, which builds and governs the data foundation that powers the business. You'll work within our stack — Python ingestion pipelines, Airflow orchestration, and Snowflake/Databricks — helping move data reliably and securely from source to decision-ready output.
You'll implement features and fixes against a given design, handle known classes of pipeline issues on your own, and escalate genuinely novel problems with clear context rather than working them in isolation. You're also expected to start contributing meaningfully in code review — catching real bugs, not just style nits.

What You'll Do
  • Implement new ingestion sources end-to-end against a senior engineer's design — connector code, DAG, schema, monitoring, and catalog registration — extending the team's existing framework where a new source needs a pattern it doesn't yet support
  • Investigate pipeline failures independently, recognize known classes of issues, and ship the documented fix without needing to escalate
  • Before shipping a new pipeline, identify downstream consumers and what would break if data were late or wrong, and flag gaps like this during spec review — before writing code
  • Write clear handovers when escalating a genuinely unresolved issue — what you tried, what you ruled out, and where things diverge — so a senior can pick up without re-discovery
  • Review peers' pipeline PRs and catch non-obvious issues (e.g., missing idempotency checks, race conditions) that could cause incorrect downstream data
  • Turn ambiguous "why is this data wrong?" questions into structured investigations — tracing data lineage from source to warehouse and communicating back what you found
  • Surface concerns in spec review as specific, well-reasoned questions rather than staying silent or blocking progress
  • Support data security and governance work (e.g., PII masking, access controls) and contribute to data delivery work, including reverse ETL integrations
  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and help scope and clarify requirements for new work
  • Mentor DE2s on their first significant projects — pairing on tricky decisions and helping them apply team conventions


What We're Looking For
  • 3–5 years of professional software or data engineering experience
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with solid experience building and operating production data pipelines
  • Comfort investigating and root-causing pipeline issues independently before escalating
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow or similar) and a cloud data warehouse/lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data pipeline concepts: idempotency, schema evolution, backfills, and data quality/testing
  • Experience giving substantive code review feedback, not just style or formatting comments
  • Strong communication skills — can write a clear technical handover, ask sharp questions in spec review, and explain a data lineage investigation to a non-technical stakeholder
  • A track record of taking ownership of known-class problems end-to-end rather than needing step-by-step direction

Nice to Have
  • Experience extending or building reusable pipeline frameworks/templates
  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools or patterns, PII masking, or data access governance (RBAC)
  • Exposure to observability/monitoring tooling (e.g., Datadog) for pipeline health and alerting
  • Some experience mentoring or informally supporting more junior engineers
  • Background in gaming, betting, e-commerce, or another regulated/high-compliance industry

Why Join Us
  • Real ownership over known-class problems, with senior/staff support available for the genuinely novel ones
  • Work on high-visibility, high-trust systems that the business depends on
  • A culture built around clear tenets: standardize before you scale, own the outcome (not just the ticket), and clarity over complexity
  • Clear growth path into Senior Data Engineer, with room to start mentoring and shaping team practices along the way

descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members.

title: Developer Experience Engineer - AI SDLC
descriptionHtml:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

You lead how Sparta builds software in the AI era. You own our AI-native software development lifecycle: the development agents engineers work alongside, the CI/CD that ships their code, and the testing strategy that lets us move fast without breaking trading workflows.

AI has changed how code gets written, reviewed, and tested, and the tooling has not caught up. Your job is to make an engineer with Claude Code, a good harness and a fast pipeline several times more effective, and to prove it with data, not anecdotes.

What you will do

  • Own the AI development toolchain. Set up and evolve Claude Code and other development agents across engineering: shared skills, MCP servers, repo context, and guardrails, so agents work well in our codebase out of the box.

  • Build agents into the lifecycle. Automate the work around the code: AI-assisted code review, test generation, dependency upgrades, migrations and incident triage, with humans in the loop where it matters.

  • Make CI/CD fast and boring. Own build, test and release pipelines across the Nx monorepo: caching, affected-only builds, preview environments and safe, frequent deploys to AWS.

  • Build the guardrails for everyone who builds. Anyone can build now, including product, design, data and domain experts working with agents. Create the tooling that makes it safe for them to contribute code: automated quality gates, code ownership and review rules, preview environments, policy checks and agent evals in the pipeline, so good changes ship fast and risky ones are caught early. Testing strategy sits inside this: define what we test at each level and make the right tests cheap to write.

  • Keep it secure. Secrets, permissions and sandboxing for agents that read code and run commands, and supply-chain checks in the pipeline.

  • Raise the bar for everyone. Run enablement, write the playbooks, pair with teams and turn good practice from one team into the default for all of engineering.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience as a hands-on software engineer, with recent focus on developer experience, platform or build and release engineering.

  • You have rolled out AI coding tools to a team and made them stick: you know where agents help, where they fail and how to set them up for a real codebase.

  • You lead without needing authority: you treat engineers as customers, listen first, and win adoption with tools people want to use.

Nice to have

  • Built Claude Code skills, plugins or MCP servers, or extended another agent harness.

  • Deep CI/CD experience: you have designed pipelines for a monorepo, cut build and test times, and run safe, frequent releases.

  • Infrastructure as code and container platforms.

  • Experience defining or running engineering metrics.

Our stack for this team

Claude Ecosystem · Nx monorepo · GitHub · AWS · TypeScript · Python · Kotlin

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Client Success Manager - Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members!

We are looking for a Client Success Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise, outstanding client communication, and an AI-first mindset.

This is a highly client-facing role: you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey.

You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations.

The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively, turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI, to work smarter, faster and with better insights.

Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

  • Client Communication & Relationship Management

    • Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations

  • Campaign Set-up & Coordination
    • Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary
    • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time
  • Optimization & Performance
    • Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client
    • Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams
  • Reports, Presentations & Sales Support
    • Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations
    • Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals
  • AI-Powered Ways of Working
    • Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow
    • Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation
  • Collaboration & Administration
    • Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration
    • Handle client invoicing

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

  • Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment.
  • Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships.
  • AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter.
  • Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once.
  • Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must.
  • Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance.
  • Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English.
  • Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE🎆

  • Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion).

LOCATION 🌐

While you need to be based in the Netherlands, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

WHO WE ARE 💜

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.

title: Director, Antibody Discovery
descriptionHtml:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for a Director, Antibody Discovery to lead our antibody discovery function and help drive our growing biologics portfolio. This role will turn Relation’s patient-derived understanding of disease biology into differentiated antibody therapeutics, accelerating the journey from novel target to development candidate.

As functional lead, you will lead a small, high-performing team of antibody scientists and drive the strategic build of Relation’s antibody capabilities — combining in-house platforms, computational and machine learning-enabled design, external partnerships and a carefully managed network of CROs to deliver high-quality molecules efficiently. Alongside this leadership remit, the role is deliberately hands-on: you will serve as the design lead on one or more drug discovery programmes, owning the molecular design strategy from project initiation, through hit identification and lead optimisation, to the nomination of a development candidate.

Sitting within Relation’s Drug Discovery team, this position is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and will support multiple disease areas as our portfolio grows. You will work closely with Target Biology, Machine Learning, Protein Sciences, in vivo Pharmacology, Translational Safety, DMPK and CMC to ensure that every molecule is designed with efficacy, safety, developability and manufacturability in mind. As the portfolio develops, you may also take accountability as Project Leader, leading a cross-functional team of scientists and owning the overall project strategy and delivery to development candidate.

Your scope will span the full breadth of antibody formats, from monoclonal antibodies to bispecific and multi-specific molecules, antibody-drug conjugates and other engineered biologics.

The role is a hybrid role based at our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of London.

Day to day, you will

  • Build and lead Relation’s antibody design function, recruiting, mentoring and developing a small team of antibody scientists, setting standards for scientific excellence and championing innovative approaches to drive data-informed decisions.

  • Define and execute the strategy for building Relation’s antibody discovery capabilities, determining the right balance of in-house, partnered and outsourced activity, and evaluating and onboarding new technologies such as in vivo immunisation (including transgenic platforms), display libraries, single B-cell screening and computational / AI-enabled de novo design.

  • Act as the hands-on antibody design lead on one or more drug discovery programmes, translating target biology and the target product profile into a molecular design strategy — including format, epitope, affinity, valency, mechanism of action and Fc engineering — from project initiation to development candidate.

  • Prosecute antibody discovery campaigns end-to-end: antigen and reagent strategy, hit generation, hit triage and screening cascades, and lead optimisation through affinity maturation, humanisation, specificity profiling and cross-reactivity to toxicology species, culminating in candidate selection.

  • Embed developability and manufacturability from the outset, using in silico and experimental assessment of sequence liabilities, biophysical properties, stability, expression and immunogenicity risk, and partnering with CMC to de-risk the path to the clinic.

  • Integrate computational, structural and machine learning-enabled design into iterative design–make–test–learn cycles.

  • Establish and manage CRO and external partner relationships, leading partner selection, scoping and contracting, and providing scientific oversight to ensure effective execution, clear prioritisation and delivery against timelines, budgets, quality and project goals.

  • Where required, take accountability as Project Leader for a cross-functional project team, owning project strategy, integrated plans, budgets and risk management, and leading the team through governance milestones to development candidate nomination.

  • Interface closely with cross-functional teams, including target biology, machine learning, protein sciences, structural biology, in vivo pharmacology, DMPK and clinical pharmacology, translational safety, CMC and IP, to ensure antibody candidates meet the target product profile.

  • Contribute to intellectual property strategy and patent filings and author relevant sections of development candidate nomination packages and IND-enabling documentation.

  • Translate complex antibody discovery and characterisation data into clear, actionable insights, communicating findings effectively to project teams, governance bodies and senior stakeholders.

  • Champion Relation’s collaborative, ambitious and science-driven culture, sharing antibody discovery expertise across the team and helping build an outstanding drug discovery organisation.

Professionally, you will have

  • A PhD in Immunology, Protein Engineering, Biochemistry, Structural Biology, Molecular Biology or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent industry experience in a lead antibody discovery position.

  • Significant experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry in antibody drug discovery, with a proven track record of prosecuting antibody programmes from project initiation through to development candidate nomination as the design or functional lead. Experience across multiple antibody formats, such as monoclonal, bispecific and multi-specific antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates, and experience leading cross-functional project teams would be highly beneficial.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in antibody discovery technologies (immunisation including transgenic platforms, phage / yeast / mammalian display, single B-cell technologies) and antibody engineering (humanisation, affinity maturation, Fc engineering, multi-specific format design), together with a strong grasp of developability assessment, biophysical and functional characterisation and screening cascade design. Familiarity with structure-based, computational and machine learning-enabled antibody design, and a sound understanding of the translational, safety and CMC requirements on the path to IND, is expected.

  • A demonstrable ability to lead, motivate and develop a small team of scientists, together with experience building new capabilities and selecting, contracting and managing CROs and external partners to deliver against timelines and budgets.

  • Outstanding communication skills, with a clear ability to translate complex scientific data into actionable strategic messages for cross-functional teams, stakeholders and senior leadership.

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

title: Director Sales (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As Director Sales at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6–8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.


What you'll do

  • Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

  • Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

  • Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

  • Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

  • Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

  • Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.


Who you are

  • You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

  • You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

  • You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

  • You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

  • You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

  • Building a team excites you more than your own quota.


This might not be the right fit if…

  • you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

  • you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

  • you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

  • you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.


Why now

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

title: Director, Solutions Engineering EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As Director, Solution Engineering EMEA, you’ll lead Parloa’s Solution Engineering team across EMEA and build it into the trusted technical advisor for our enterprise customers. You and your team will help some of the world’s best-known brands see what AI agents can do for their customer experience, and how to bring them to life in their business. Working side by side with our EMEA sales leadership, you’ll shape how we win across the region.

Areas of ownership

  • Lead and grow the team: Hire, develop, and lead the EMEA Solution Engineering team through its managers. You own performance, career paths, and the hiring bar.

  • Own the technical win: Set the SE strategy with the sales leaders. Decide where to put coverage across markets and segments, and make sure strategic deals get the right engineer.

  • Run SE with rigour: Bring MEDDPICC discipline to technical qualification, discovery, POVs, and scoping.

  • Lead on strategic deals: Be the senior technical voice with customer executives on the region’s most important opportunities.

  • Scale through the ecosystem: Work closely with Partnerships, Value Engineering, and Professional Services to give customers a seamless experience from first conversation to go-live.

  • Turn field signal into product: Turn customers' needs into clear input for Product and Engineering.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Solution Engineering or a similar customer-facing technical role within SaaS or enterprise technology, including 2+ years of leadership experience

  • Strong technical foundation across APIs, cloud environments, integrations, and enterprise architecture

  • Hands-on understanding of AI infrastructure, including LLMs, model deployment, and how AI agents run in production

  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with MEDDPICC or a similar framework

  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value and outcomes

  • You're AI native and use AI in everything you do

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus

Our recruiting process

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

title: Energy Procurement & Policy
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years. Every megawatt needs power, and power is this role's domain.

The Role

Mistral's data centers will consume hundreds of megawatts of electricity. This hire makes sure that power is reliable and affordable. You will define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy: structuring agreements with utilities, hedging against volatile spot prices, and tracking the regulatory changes that affect where and how data centers can be powered. The role also touches energy policy and community relations in the regions where Mistral operates.

This is a hybrid seat. Roughly half of the work is commercial: procurement contracts, hedging instruments, and price risk management. The other half is policy and positioning: monitoring regulation, engaging with grid operators and local authorities, and helping Mistral build the social license to operate large data centers across Europe.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy across European data center sites

  • Negotiate power purchase agreements and procurement contracts with utilities

  • Structure hedging agreements to limit exposure to volatile spot power prices

  • Monitor energy regulation and policy developments that affect data center siting, grid connection, and power pricing

  • Engage with grid operators, regulators, and local communities in regions where Mistral builds and operates data centers

What We're Looking For

  • You have procured energy at scale. You have structured power purchase agreements, utility contracts, or hedging instruments for industrial or infrastructure-scale consumers.

  • You understand European energy markets. You know how power pricing, grid connection, and regulation work across the markets where Mistral operates.

  • You can read a regulatory brief. You have tracked and interpreted energy or infrastructure policy and translated it into commercial implications.

  • You communicate across disciplines. You work effectively with engineers, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, and can explain complex energy concepts to non-specialists.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Executive Director, Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacometrics
descriptionHtml:
Your work will change lives. Including your own. 

The Impact You'll Make: 

You will join an innovative and passionate clinical development team dedicated to improving the lives of patients suffering from devastating diseases.  You will lead the innovative clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics strategy and execution for a portfolio of rare disease and oncology clinical programs.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop the clinical pharmacology and pharmacometric strategies to accelerate and support the overall product development plan. You’ll be the Clinical Pharmacology lead for various programs in clinical development, the representative for regulatory interactions, and propose innovative strategies to get therapies to patients faster.
  • Solve drug development questions/problems by performing and/or overseeing modeling and simulation with various tools to expedite decision making.
  • Design clinical studies. You’ll provide (clinical) pharmacology input on all clinical study designs, from Phase 1-3 and dedicated Phase 1 clinical pharmacology studies.
  • Author review relevant clinical pharmacology sections for regulatory documents, including Investigator's Brochures (IB), INDs, NDAs, and other regulatory submissions. Act as the clinical pharmacology expert during interactions with health authorities.
  • Interface with cross-functional teams. You’ll work closely with clinical study teams, translational teams (DMPK, Translational Modeling and Toxicology), preclinical teams and due diligence teams to ensure clinical pharmacology-related considerations are addressed.

The Team You’ll Join 

You will join the Pharmacometrics team within Recursion comprising clinical pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and translational modeling. The Pharmacometrics group sits within Recursion’s Clinical Development organization. Team members get to sit on both Discovery and Development projects and work in a seamless end-to-end environment at Recursion. The team collaborates closely with clinical development functions (clinical science, clinical operations, regulatory affairs, biostatistics, etc.), as well as discovery functions (DMPK, Biology, Chemistry and Translational Biomarkers). 

The Experience You’ll Need

  • Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacokinetics or related discipline, M.D with a Clinical Pharmacology expertise, or a Pharm D. with a Clinical Pharmacology fellowship, with 10+ years of experience in biotech/pharmaceutical drug development.
  • Demonstrated success leading all clinical pharmacology related aspects of drug development. 
  • Ability to work closely with internal and external stakeholders to manage PK, PK-PD, and PK-safety analyses, including non-compartmental analysis, population PK modeling, and PK-PD modeling and simulations to support dose selection, exposure-response and exposure-safety analyses through various phases of drug development.
  • Proficiency with WinNonlin, Monolix, NONMEM, R or other modeling software.
  • Effective skills directed toward driving collaboration, achieving results, influencing, and resolving conflicts across internal and external stakeholders
  • Demonstrated experience responding to regulatory agency questions, preparing clinical pharmacology aspects of regulatory submissions and attending regulatory meetings.
  • Highly motivated, decisive, and results-oriented individual who is proactive, resourceful, and efficient with the flexibility and creativity to excel in and contribute to a rapidly growing drug discovery and development company   

Experience in oncology is preferred, but not an absolute requirement. 

Working Location & Compensation:

This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom with required periodic travel. 

At Recursion, we believe that every employee should be compensated fairly. Based on the skills, experience, and qualifications needed for this role, the estimated annual base salary range is: £136,500–£167,200. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • We act boldly with integrity. We are unconstrained in our thinking, take calculated risks, and push boundaries, but never at the expense of ethics, science, or trust.

Our values underpin the employee experience at Recursion. They are the character and personality of the company demonstrated through how we communicate, support one another, spend our time, make decisions, and celebrate collectively.

Recursion (NASDAQ: RXRX) is a clinical-stage TechBio company decoding biology to radically improve lives. title: Financial Control, Accountant
descriptionHtml:
About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank transforming banking infrastructure through innovative technology and a full banking licence. We provide cloud-based banking and payment solutions to a growing range of clients and are committed to delivering reliable, scalable financial services while maintaining the highest standards of financial control, governance and regulatory compliance.

The Financial Control team is responsible for ensuring ClearBank’s general ledgers are controlled, maintained and reconciled to support timely and accurate reporting across the organisation and externally to regulators and tax authorities. As ClearBank continues to grow, the team plays a critical role in building scalable, efficient and well-controlled finance processes that support the Bank’s strategic ambitions.

Role Purpose

The Financial Control Lead owns allocated month-end activities within a small, hands-on team, supporting accurate, timely and well-controlled financial information.

Reporting to the Financial Control Manager, you will complete month-end tasks, investigate balances and variances, and prepare accounting entries and reconciliations to keep the general ledger accurate and fully supported.

The role will also be expected to stay close to all key aspects of the Financial Control team’s remit, including journals, reconciliations, reporting inputs, controls, audit support, process documentation and stakeholder queries. As ClearBank continues to grow, the Financial Control Lead will be at the forefront of identifying, driving and implementing scalable, efficient and well-controlled processes, helping the team reduce manual effort while maintaining strong financial control standards.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Own allocated month-end close activities and ensure they are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Prepare, review and approve general ledger journals as required, ensuring postings are technically accurate, appropriately supported and comply with internal control requirements.

  • Own revenue and expense analysis for the relevant areas, ensuring variances are investigated, understood and appropriately communicated to stakeholders.

  • Own the monthly capitalisation and amortisation process for intangible assets, ensuring entries are accurate, supported and appropriately controlled.

  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure accruals and accounting adjustments are identified, calculated and recorded accurately.

  • Prepare, review and approve bank reconciliations as required, ensuring reconciling items are investigated and resolved promptly.

title: Founders Associate
descriptionHtml:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Founder's Associate to join the office of the CEO, reporting to our Chief of Staff and working directly with our CEO. Your goal is to make the CEO, Chief of Staff and leadership team more productive, so that leadership time goes on the things only leadership can do. You will be a business-minded, AI-first operator: you will run consulting-style special projects, build AI-enabled workflows that give the office of the CEO leverage, keep the leadership operating rhythm tight, run internal communications and prepare board materials.

You will report to the Chief of Staff and have direct access to the CEO. This is a generalist role by design: one week you might be scoping and running a cross-company project, the next you might be automating a leadership workflow, drafting an all-hands update or pulling together a board pack.

This is not an Executive Assistant role with a different title. A small part of the job is executive support, but the ceiling is set by what you deliver, and the scope will grow as you earn trust.

As a guide, we expect your time to split roughly as follows: special projects (around 35%), AI-enabled systems and productivity (around 25%), leadership operating rhythm and CEO and Chief of Staff support (around 20%), internal communications and board preparation (around 15%), and executive support (around 5%, shrinking over time).

What the job involves

Special projects

  • Own special projects on behalf of the CEO and Chief of Staff, run like a consulting engagement: clear scope, stakeholder map, workplan, milestones and regular progress updates.

  • Structure ambiguous problems quickly: define the question, form hypotheses, test them and drive to a clear recommendation.

  • Given the why, work out what needs doing and how, propose priorities and trade-offs, and agree them with the Chief of Staff or CEO before driving delivery.

  • Produce research, analysis, options papers and decision documents that get leadership to a decision in a single conversation.

Building the AI-enabled office of the CEO

  • Own, maintain and extend the AI workflows and tools that run the office of the CEO, such as decision documents, meeting briefs, task intake, meeting capture and leadership updates.

  • Find repetitive, low-leverage work across the CEO, Chief of Staff and leadership team, then redesign or automate it and measure the time saved.

  • Enhance the productivity of the leadership team by building AI tools and workflows that add value and they actually use.

CEO time and priorities

  • Optimise how the CEO spends their time, so their calendar reflects the company's priorities rather than whoever asked first.

  • Maintain a clear, current view of the CEO's priorities, open actions and commitments, and make sure nothing important is dropped.

  • Triage incoming requests to the CEO: resolve what you can, route what belongs elsewhere, and bring the rest with the context needed for a fast decision.

  • Prepare the CEO for key meetings with concise briefs, and capture and follow up on the actions that come out of them.

Internal communications

  • Manage internal communications from the CEO and the leadership team, including company updates, all-hands content and key announcements.

  • Draft in the CEO's voice and make sure messages are clear, timely and consistent with what leadership has decided.

  • Run the rhythm of company communications so the team knows what is happening, why, and what it means for them.

Board preparation

  • Prepare materials for board meetings, working with the CEO, Chief of Staff and functional leads. This role prepares for the board but does not attend board meetings.

  • Coordinate inputs from across the business, assemble board packs to deadline, and check them for accuracy and consistency.

  • Track board actions and follow-ups through to completion.

Leadership operating rhythm

  • Take ownership of workstreams across the Chief of Staff's portfolio, and help functional leaders run their priorities, updates and actions more efficiently.

  • Help run the leadership operating rhythm: leadership meetings, decision logs and action tracking.

  • Keep templates and trackers current so the office of the CEO runs well and does not depend on any one person.

Executive support

  • Provide light-touch executive assistance to the founders where it adds the most value, such as calendar management, scheduling and travel coordination.

  • Look for ways to reduce this load over time through better systems, tools and automation.

You should apply if

  • You are a true generalist: you are comfortable moving between operations, communications, analysis and admin in the same day, and you do not need a narrowly defined job box to do great work. You are business-minded: you understand how a SaaS company makes money and can connect a project to revenue, cost or risk. You think like a consultant: you structure ambiguous problems quickly and drive to a clear recommendation.

  • You have excellent judgement and discretion. You will see sensitive company, board and customer information, and you know how to handle it.

  • You write clearly and quickly, and can adapt your tone for an all-hands update, a board paper or a one-line Slack message.

  • You are relentlessly organised and take ownership. When you pick something up, you see it through and close the loop without being chased.

  • You are comfortable with candour: you will push back on leadership and you bring a view, not just options.

  • You are an AI power user with builder instincts: you reach for AI first, you have built workflows or automations that other people rely on, and you want to make a whole leadership team more productive, not just yourself.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: you own the leadership operating rhythm and action tracking end to end, and you have shipped at least one workflow that measurably saves CEO or leadership time.

  • Six months: you have delivered a special project from scoping to decision, and you own the board pack process.

  • Twelve months: you are the go-to operator for cross-functional projects, and the office of the CEO runs on systems rather than individuals.

Where this role can take you

  • Work on special projects across the company, giving you exposure to how every part of ExTrac operates.

  • Gain first-hand experience of board preparation and governance in a fast-growing, venture-backed company.

  • Build your craft in internal communications, working directly with the CEO on how leadership communicates with the company.

  • Strong performance creates a path to a Level 4 role in the OCEO or a move into a strategy or functional role in Operations, Growth or Product, based on the special projects you lead.

Requirements

  • Due to the security requirements of our customers, applicants must be British nationals or nationals of a NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand, with the right to work in the UK.

  • Generalist experience across a range of business functions, with evidence of working effectively across operations, communications and project delivery.

  • 3+ years in a fast-paced, execution-focused environment, for example management consulting, a startup or scale-up, investment banking, government or a Founder's Associate, Chief of Staff office or Business Operations role.

  • Demonstrable experience owning projects end-to-end and working directly with senior leaders or executives.

  • Excellent written communication, with examples of internal communications, briefing papers or board materials you have produced.

  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with confidence in spreadsheets, slides and modern productivity tools. Evidence of building AI-enabled workflows or automations (for example, with AI assistants, Notion, Linear, Zapier or n8n), not only using AI tools.

  • Willingness to undergo UK security vetting if required for the role.

  • Ability to work from our London office 2-3 days per week

Desirable

  • Experience supporting board meetings or investor reporting.

  • Some executive assistant or office of the CEO experience. Exposure to SaaS metrics, pricing or go-to-market work.

  • Exposure to the defence, national security, intelligence or geopolitical risk sectors.

  • Existing UK security clearance.

Interview Process

Draft stages below; to be confirmed with People Ops before this goes live.

  • Initial Intro Interview - 30-45 minutes

  • Competency-based and Practical Technical Interviews - 2 x 45 minutes

  • Final Interview with the CEO - 30-45 minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • Flexible working, hybrid: 2-3 days per week in our central London office.

  • A benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • £500/year education budget with additional items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

title: Founder's Office Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Founding Content & Thought Leadership Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Ace Waves

Ace Waves builds AI agents that turn customer service into revenue. Our agents resolve complex, multi-step support cases end to end, such as refunds, subscription changes and order disputes, by taking real actions inside the tools our customers already use. They also work the revenue moments: saving churn at cancellation, turning refunds into replacements, and spotting upsells where they fit.

We work with consumer brands across Europe and the US, including Eneba, Pulsetto, Ovoko and Pigu. We are a fast-growing startup with teams across Europe, and we are building our marketing function from the ground up.
About the role

The AI customer service market is loud. Every vendor promises transformation; few can show results. We want Ace Waves, and our CEO, to be the clearest and most credible voice in the category: the people who say what agentic AI in customer service actually does, what it doesn't, and how to deploy it responsibly.

This is a founding role that combines three jobs: thought leadership and executive profile, content, and public speaking. You will shape and grow our CEO's public profile, build the content engine behind it, and take the stage yourself as one of the company's main voices at events across Europe and the US.
You will report to the VP of Marketing and work directly with our CEO every week. Expect roughly this split, which will shift with the event calendar:
  • ~50% thought leadership and CEO profile
  • ~30% content strategy and production
  • ~20% speaking and external presence

What you’ll do

Thought leadership and CEO profile

  • Define Ace Waves' point of view on agentic AI in customer service, from cost center to revenue driver, trust and transparency, and what the EU AI Act means for CX teams, and turn it into a 12-month thought leadership plan.
  • Own our CEO's public voice: ghostwrite bylines, op-eds, keynote narratives and newsletters that sound like them, with social posts as one channel among several.
  • Build the CEO's external platform: podcasts, media interviews, analyst and industry conversations, and speaking slots at the events our buyers attend.
  • Prepare the CEO for every appearance with briefing docs, talking points, story banks and data, and turn each appearance into content afterwards.
  • Track and report on share of voice, executive profile growth and the pipeline influence of thought leadership.
  • Build an original research programme: a flagship annual report on AI in customer service, drawn from anonymised platform data and buyer surveys, plus benchmarks CX leaders cite. Every number is signed off with Product Marketing before it goes out.
  • Lead our voice on responsible AI: trust, transparency, auditability and the EU AI Act, including fast, credible commentary when regulation or industry news breaks.
  • Earn media coverage: pitch and place the CEO in business, tech and CX trade press across the UK, DACH and the US, and work with our PR partner when engaged.
  • Create recurring formats that build a following, such as a CEO-led newsletter or podcast series and invite-only executive roundtables with CX leaders and COOs.
  • Develop a bench of credible voices beyond the CEO: customers, product and delivery leaders who can speak to real results.
Speaking and events
  • Represent Ace Waves on stage: keynotes, panels, webinars and moderated executive roundtables at CX, ecommerce, DTC and AI events in Europe and the US.
  • Own the speaking pipeline for both yourself and the CEO: identify the right events, write and submit proposals, and secure slots.
  • Build signature talks and workshop formats grounded in real customer results, and co-present with customers wherever possible.
  • Work with Field Marketing so every speaking slot is backed by meetings, follow-up and measurable pipeline.
Content
  • Own the content strategy and calendar across blog, newsletter, video, social and long-form assets, aligned with Product Marketing and our priority verticals.
  • Write and edit flagship content yourself: points of view, guides, research reports and customer stories that make complex AI topics clear to CX leaders, COOs and CFOs.
  • Partner with Product Marketing on customer proof and make sure every claim we publish is substantiated. In AI, trust is the brand.
  • Repurpose every talk, podcast and article across channels; build our owned audience and newsletter.
  • Work with our SEO and AI search agency so our point of view shows up where buyers search, including in AI answers.
  • Manage freelancers, designers and video partners as the engine grows.

Your profile
  • Based in Germany or the UK with the right to work there, and willing to travel regularly across Europe and occasionally to the US (around 20–30% of your time in peak event seasons).
  • 6+ years in B2B content, communications or thought leadership, ideally in SaaS or AI, with at least some of that in a startup or scale-up.
  • A track record of building an executive's or founder's public profile: ghostwriting in their voice, growing their audience and landing them on stages and in media.
  • Proven public speaking experience: you are comfortable delivering a keynote, holding your own on a panel and moderating a room of senior executives. Please share links to talks, panels or podcasts.
  • Native-level written and spoken English, and a portfolio that shows clear thinking and sharp writing.
  • A network in the UK or DACH tech, CX or ecommerce scene: event organisers, podcast hosts, journalists or communities you can activate.
  • Evidence that your content and thought leadership drove real business outcomes such as audience, leads or pipeline, not just impressions.
  • Enough curiosity to go deep on how AI agents work, and the judgment to explain them without hype.

Even better
  • Experience in customer service, CX or contact center technology, or in conversational or agentic AI.
  • A second European language, especially German (a strong plus for DACH audiences), or French, Spanish or Dutch.
  • A background in journalism or a personal audience of your own (newsletter, podcast or strong professional following).
  • Familiarity with the EU AI Act, GDPR or responsible-AI debates.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days: our point of view and 12-month thought leadership plan are agreed with the CEO, the first CEO bylines, podcast and media appearances are booked, and the first speaking submissions for 2027 are in.

In your first 12 months: the CEO and Ace Waves are recognised voices in AI customer service in our core European markets, you and the CEO have spoken at a regular run of target events, our first flagship research report is out, and thought leadership is a visible source of influenced pipeline.
What we offer
  • A founding role with real ownership, working directly with the CEO and VP of Marketing.
  • The chance to define how a category talks about itself.
  • Competitive compensation, benchmarked to your local market and experience, discussed early in the process.
  • Hybrid or remote working from Germany or the UK, with travel budget for events.
Ace Waves is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

What You'll Be Doing

Supercell New Games
