title: Freelance Campaign Manager, Influencer Marketing, CPG (Europe) - Second European Language Essential
descriptionHtml:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Role Details

  • Freelance (up to 12 months)

  • Fully-Remote role across Europe or the UK

  • Fluency in a second European language essential

  • For this role, you must be fluent in English and at least one additional European language. This is an essential requirement.

We're looking for brilliant Campaign Managers who live and breathe the creator economy.

You'll be working with a leading global consumer brand, bringing creator campaigns to life across European markets.

And we're not talking about the occasional influencer campaign. This is creator marketing at scale. Multiple campaigns, regular product launches and a constant stream of creators producing content that gets people talking.

If you love discovering great creators, know what makes content perform and get excited about turning a brief into a successful campaign, we'd love to meet you.

At Kyra, we're building a different kind of creator marketing company. We combine great people, technology and AI to make creator marketing smarter, faster and more effective.

You'll have access to our own platform and tools to manage everything from casting and outreach to contracts, payments and reporting.

You'll take ownership of campaigns in your market, work directly with client stakeholders and collaborate with a team that genuinely loves what it does.

🚀 What You'll Be Doing

Bring Campaigns to Life

  • Manage multiple creator campaigns from the initial brief through to launch, delivery and reporting.

  • Keep timelines, budgets, content approvals and deliverables moving.

  • Work closely with creators, clients and our internal teams.

  • Spot potential issues early and find solutions before they become problems.

Make the Numbers Work

  • Build creator pricing around CPV targets and expected performance.

  • Negotiate creator fees and manage campaign budgets with confidence.

  • Balance creative ambition with commercial performance.

  • Use campaign data to make smarter decisions and improve results.

Build Great Client Relationships

  • Be a day-to-day contact for local market stakeholders.

  • Lead campaign calls, share updates and keep everyone aligned.

  • Bring ideas, recommendations and solutions to the table.

  • Build trust through great communication and consistent delivery.

Find and Work With Amazing Creators

  • Discover and cast creators who are the right fit for each product, audience and brief.

  • Build high-quality creator shortlists across multiple campaigns.

  • Manage outreach, briefing, negotiations, contracting and content delivery.

  • Oversee usage rights, advertising disclosures and creator approvals.

  • Use performance insights to make your next casting list even better.

Get Creative With Technology

  • Use Kyra's platform to manage campaigns from start to finish.

  • Monitor CPV, reach, engagement and other key performance metrics.

  • Use AI tools to make creator discovery, research, analysis and campaign management more efficient.

  • Keep campaign information accurate and up to date so everyone has visibility.

⚡ How We Work

We move quickly, work collaboratively and care about doing great work.

With multiple campaigns running at once, staying organised, taking ownership and communicating clearly makes a huge difference.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • New briefs are picked up within 24 hours, with creator discovery and outreach underway.

  • Blockers are escalated within 3 hours so we can resolve them quickly.

  • Campaign risks and performance concerns are raised early, ideally with a suggested solution.

  • Clients and teammates receive regular updates without needing to chase.

  • Campaign information is kept accurate and up to date in our platform.

We don't expect everything to go perfectly. We do expect people to take ownership, communicate openly and work together to find solutions.

🙌 Who We're Looking For

First and foremost, we want someone who really understands creator marketing.

Someone who knows the difference between a creator with a big following and one who can actually deliver results. Someone who enjoys both the creative and commercial sides of the job.

The Essentials

  • Languages: For this role, you must be fluent in English and at least one additional European language (e.g. Spanish, German or French). This is an essential requirement. You must be confident communicating with creators and clients in both languages.

  • 3–5 years of experience in influencer or creator marketing.

  • Experience running high-volume creator campaigns, ideally for consumer brands.

  • Strong knowledge of the creator landscape in at least one European market.

  • Experience managing campaign budgets, negotiating creator fees and handling contracts.

  • A solid understanding of CPV and creator performance metrics.

  • Strong Excel and data skills.

  • Experience working directly with clients, ideally large consumer brands.

  • Confidence using AI tools such as Claude in your everyday work.

  • Based in Europe or the UK, with availability to work across European business hours.

Even Better If You Have

  • Experience with CPG, FMCG or other major consumer brands.

  • Experience managing high-volume or always-on creator programmes.

  • Knowledge of multiple European creator markets.

  • Experience using influencer marketing platforms.

You'll Probably Love This Role If You...

  • Spend more time than you'd like to admit discovering new creators.

  • Can spot a great creator-brand fit almost immediately.

  • Love managing lots of moving parts without dropping the details.

  • Enjoy negotiating, solving problems and making the numbers work.

  • Get excited by technology and finding smarter ways to deliver campaigns.

  • Like having real ownership and seeing the impact of your work.

✨ Interested?

If you know your local creator market, love bringing great campaigns to life and speak fluent English plus at least one additional European language, we'd love to hear from you.

💬 Creator Communications

  • Own day-to-day comms with creators and creator managers, ensuring timelines, briefs, and expectations are crystal clear

  • Manage asset submission, revisions, and general troubleshooting throughout the campaign

🗂️ Project Management & Campaign Delivery

  • Run complex, high-value campaigns under the oversight of a Senior Campaign Manager

  • Flag risks early and proactively manage challenges around creators, budgets, or shifting client expectations

  • Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients—attending calls, sharing updates, and supporting feedback management

  • Secure client approvals on key campaign milestones and keep them aligned throughout the process

📜 Creative Briefing & Content Review

  • Lead creator briefing calls and ensure deliverables follow brand guidelines, brief requirements, and FTC compliance

  • Monitor campaign KPIs and update trackers daily to ensure accurate performance records

✅ You’re delivering high-quality work that meets KPIs and strengthens client trust

title: Full Stack Engineer, AI systems
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer - AI Systems to build the product layer that turns these capabilities into usable, production-grade workflows. This includes designing how agents operate, fail, recover, and deliver consistent value to users.

 

Focus

  • Build end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, and AI integrations

  • Design agent workflows that handle planning, tool use, failure, and recovery across multiple steps.

  • Integrate LLMs, memory, and external tools into systems that behave reliably under real-world conditions

  • Design real-time AI interactions with streaming, partial results, and tight latency constraints

  • Improve system reliability, observability, and fallback mechanisms

  • Collaborate closely with ML, backend, and product teams to ship features end-to-end

  • Continuously iterate based on real usage and failure modes

 

Ideal Experiences

  • Strong experience in full stack engineering (frontend + backend)

  • Solid understanding of system design and API architecture

  • Experience working with LLMs, RAG systems, or AI-powered applications

  • Ability to handle ambiguity and make pragmatic engineering decisions

  • Strong ownership - able to take features from idea to production

  • Comfort working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements

 

Outcomes

  • Own and ship AI-native product features that move beyond chat into persistent, goal-driven workflows

  • Design and deploy agent workflows that reliably complete multi-step tasks across tools and sessions

  • Reduce latency and improve responsiveness of AI interactions while maintaining output quality

  • Build robust fallback and recovery mechanisms for LLM and tool failures in production environments

  • Improve the success rate and reliability of AI-driven workflows through iteration, evaluation, and monitoring

  • Establish patterns and abstractions for integrating LLMs, memory, and external tools into scalable product systems

  • Contribute to a product experience where AI feels proactive, consistent, and dependable over time

 

Tech Stack

  • Next.js

  • Python

  • NodeJs

  • Pytorch

  • OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs

  • SQl & noSQL

  • Kubernetes

  • Docker

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Geschäftsleiter Markt - SumUp Bank (Managing Director, Front Office)
descriptionHtml:
SumUp is preparing to build a CRR (Capital Requirements Regulation) licensed bank in Germany—an important next chapter in our journey to help small businesses thrive. As Managing Director, Front Office, you’ll be part of the team that shapes how this bank serves customers: the proposition we bring to market, the products we build, and the standards by which we grow.

This is a rare opportunity to take an executive management role in a new, digitally native bank. You’ll combine commercial leadership with direct accountability for customer-facing governance, and represent the market perspective in dialogue with supervisors. We’re looking for a leader who sees customer trust and sustainable growth as inseparable—and who can build with the pace of a technology company and the discipline of a bank.

What you’ll do

  • Together with the other members of the executive management team contribute to the strategic and corporate development of the bank.
  • Lead the market facing part for the German banking licence application. Represent the bank in supervisory dialogue on commercial strategy, products, distribution and customer treatment, including with BaFin, Deutsche Bundesbank and the European Central Bank where relevant.
  • Support building  the go to market operating model and ensure it is integrated into the bank’s governance, risk and control framework. Work closely with the Managing Director, Back Office (Geschäftsleiter Marktfolge) to ensure product, conduct and outsourcing risks are understood and managed.
  • Partner with the wider SumUp and bank leadership teams—including Finance, Global Banking, Product and Engineering—to turn the strategy into a viable, well-governed business.
  • Coach the next generation of SumUp leaders on their path to a §25c Abs 1 KWG qualification.

You’ll be great for this role if…

  • You bring 15 - 20+ years of senior leadership experience in credit institutions, including the qualification according to §25c Abs. 1 KWG.
  • You have led commercial, product or customer activity in a regulated bank and can show how you balanced business performance with customer outcomes, conduct requirements and effective controls.
  • You have a practical understanding of German and European banking regulation, including the requirements relevant to governance, product oversight, market conduct and customer protection.
  • You’re fluent in German and have excellent English skills. You can engage credibly with supervisors, communicate complex issues clearly and raise difficult topics early.
  • You bring sound judgement, integrity and the independence of mind expected of a bank executive, and can meet the applicable fitness and propriety requirements for the appointment.
  • You’re comfortable building in a fast-moving environment where there may be limited precedent. You can establish the right foundations without slowing the business down with unnecessary processes.
  • Experience in merchant or SME banking, payments, lending, embedded finance, digital banking or API-led products would be especially valuable. So would experience building a new regulated entity or scaling a fintech, specialist lender or digital bank. 
  • You’ll need to commit the capacity expected of a full-time executive board role.

Why you should join SumUp

  • You’ll help shape a new bank for the businesses that keep local economies moving. 
  • You’ll have the influence to define its commercial direction and customer proposition, while building the governance and trust that let it grow for the long term. 
  • It’s a chance to bring together your banking experience and your builder mindset at a defining moment for SumUp.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

  • Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

  • Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released.

  • Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts.

  • Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers.

  • Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers.

  • Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability.

  • Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon.

  • Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

  • Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

  • Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration.

  • Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team.

Preferred Experience

  • A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field.

  • Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled.

  • Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN).

  • Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards.

  • Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched.

  • Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Graduate Silicon Architect 2027
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol, UK
Salary: £45,000 per annum 
Start date: September 2027
Application deadline: Midnight, 29th November 2026 
We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.

The Graduate Programme at Graphcore

Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.

What you’ll work on 

Put your understanding of computer architecture to work on the choices that shape Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware. 

As a Graduate Silicon Architect, you’ll help specify, model and evaluate complex system-on-chip (SoC) subsystems, with guidance from experienced architects. You’ll explore how product requirements translate into technical options, design trade-offs and validation plans. 

Your work will likely include some of: taking responsibility for the architecture of a chip subsystem or function, modelling architectural features, assessing third-party intellectual property (IP) and supporting silicon bring-up. Working across design, verification, hardware and software teams, you’ll help gather the performance evidence that supports architecture decisions. 

Your team and support 

The Silicon Architecture team sits within the Silicon group. We stand for practical ambition: clear thinking, careful engineering and curiosity that improves real systems. 

You’ll work with mentors and experienced architects through design reviews, modelling, simulation, documentation and discussions with neighbouring teams. You’ll take ownership of defined tasks that grow in scope as you develop your skills. 

Simulations, performance data and design constraints help guide our decisions. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge existing approaches and share ideas for making things better. Take responsibility for your work and speak up when something needs testing, explaining or support. 

How you’ll learn and grow 

During the two-year programme, you’ll develop your architecture skills through hands-on architectural design + integration, modelling and evaluation of AI acceleration hardware, supported by mentors. 

Exploring technical options and running simulations will help you understand how architecture choices affect system behaviour. You’ll learn how to compare trade-offs, document findings and use performance evidence to support a decision. 

Design reviews and work across engineering teams will help you connect specifications to implementation and validation. Supporting silicon bring-up will give you experience of how architectural ideas are checked on real hardware, while tasks that grow in scope will build your technical judgement and confidence. 

What we’re looking for 

  • A degree, or expected degree, in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related field 
  • An understanding of computer architecture or digital systems, with an interest in SoC design, AI hardware or high-performance computing 
  • Programming experience in Python, Rust, C++ or a similar language 
  • Analytical problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication, including documenting findings and explaining technical ideas 

You can demonstrate these skills through coursework, a dissertation, personal or team projects, research, or other relevant experience. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned. 

Exposure to register-transfer level (RTL) design, modelling, simulation, PCIe, Ethernet or DDR would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements. 

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
  • Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.

Introduction to Graphcore

At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: from semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together.

How to apply and what to expect 

To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring.

Ready to put your learning into practice? Start your career in a permanent SoC Architecture Engineer role, with two years of hands-on learning through the Graphcore Graduate Programme. Apply now and help shape what comes next.

title: Growth & Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will find the companies that fit Agent F, open the conversation and win them. That means outbound you build yourself, inbound you convert, demos you run, proposals you write and deals you close. It also means staying with the customer afterwards: through go-live with the Forward Deployed Engineer and into the first expansion. You own the pipeline you build and the accounts you win.

Our buyers are finance and operations leaders at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies. They are experienced, busy and precise. You will learn to sell to them with a senior Head of Sales who reviews your pipeline, joins your calls and coaches you on every deal, and with the CEO in the room on key accounts, where the whole team pulls through together.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain.

What you will build and own

  • Your own pipeline. Target lists, outreach, network, events and partner introductions. Convert marketing-generated leads into qualified opportunities. Book first conversations every week.

  • Deals. Qualify, demo, propose, negotiate, close. Mid-market deals end to end; key accounts together with the CEO and the Head of Sales.

  • Accounts after signature. Stay the account owner through go-live with the Forward Deployed Engineer. Own the first expansion: the next module, the next entity, the next team.

  • A clean CRM. Every deal has a stage, a next step and a date. Your forecast holds.

  • The playbook. Document what works, flag what does not, run the experiments the Head of Sales defines.

For example, a Mittelstand company replies to your outreach and asks for a demo next week. You would qualify the need, run the demo, build the proposal with the Head of Sales, close it, and hand the customer to the Forward Deployed Engineer with everything they need for a go-live inside the SLA, and you would already know which second entity comes next.

What you bring

You have three or more years of B2B software sales with personal closes, ideally into finance, operations or ERP-adjacent buyers in German-speaking companies. You have built pipeline from nothing and can show the numbers.

You can tell us about a deal you opened cold and closed, what you learned from a deal you lost, and how you keep your pipeline honest. You are hungry, structured and resilient on the phone and in the room, and you want to learn from a senior sales lead and outgrow the role.

Core experience

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales with personal quota attainment.

  • Outbound prospecting that produces first conversations; converting inbound leads.

  • Running demos and writing proposals for finance or operations buyers.

  • CRM discipline: stages, next steps, forecast.

  • Fluent German, good English.

  • Daily use of AI tools for research, outreach and preparation.

Useful additional experience

ERP, accounting or financial operations software; selling into corporate subsidiaries; experience with implementation-heavy products; partner or channel sales.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would build your own pipeline, run your first demos with the Head of Sales and then alone, and close your first deals. You would bring your first customers through go-live with the Forward Deployed Engineer.

We would look for first conversations booked every week, a pipeline that grows and converts, signed deals, and customers that go live inside the SLA.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in customers who go live and grow. You respond the same day to customers in active evaluation or onboarding, stay with a go-live until it is done and raise issues early rather than late.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to travel to a customer, interrupt planned work and stay engaged when a deal or a go-live needs it. Afterwards, you note what should change in the playbook.

How you will work

You report to the Head of Sales on pipeline and deals and work with the CEO and the Head of Sales on the playbook and on key accounts. Line management stays with the CEO. You will work closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on go-live and with marketing on inbound. You will use AI tools for research, outreach and preparation and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customers in the DACH region is part of the role. Fluent German is required.

Start a conversation

Tell us about a deal you opened cold and closed, and what happened to that customer afterwards. Numbers help: how many conversations, how long the cycle, what was signed and what went live.

title: Hardwareentwickler - Elektronik
descriptionHtml:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale, not just in the lab.

What you’ll do

  • Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible

  • Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level

  • Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification

  • Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package

  • Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production

  • Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training

  • Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility

About you

  • Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control)

  • A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product

  • Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar)

  • Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering

  • Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification

  • An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept

  • Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus

  • Basic experience with Linux and embedded software

  • You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures

What Filics offers

  • Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production

  • Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

title: Head of DACH
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a sales leader who wants to build, lead and win in a fast growing startup that’s changing how legal research is done. You’ll take ownership of our DACH sales team, help us move upmarket and play a key role in shaping the next stage of Pandektes’ growth.

About Pandektes

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

Pandektes has raised more than €17.5 million and most recently closed a €13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

About the role

As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets.

You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. A big part of the role will be helping the team move further upmarket and win larger, more complex customers. You’ll stay close to the team and the deals, coaching regularly, joining important customer conversations and helping your AEs progress and close opportunities.

This is a role for building, not maintaining. We recently closed our €13.5M Series A, and you’ll have the backing to hire, grow the team and take it upmarket. With 500+ customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland, customers already pay for the product, the team is in place, and there’s a lot of room to go bigger.

Our processes and playbooks are still being built, so you’ll have a real say in how we sell. How you run pipeline, coaching and hiring will become how sales works at Pandektes as we scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our DACH Account Executive team

  • Coach the team through regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal reviews

  • Own team targets, pipeline and forecasting across the DACH market

  • Help the team win larger and more complex customers as we continue to move upmarket

  • Get involved in key deals and support the team with customer meetings, objections, negotiations and closing

  • Help Account Executives improve their discovery, pitching and ability to work with multiple stakeholders

  • Make sure we have a healthy pipeline and a clear view of where revenue is coming from

  • Look at where deals are progressing, where they are getting stuck and what we can do differently

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and the wider commercial team to improve how we find and win customers across our global target market

  • Improve our sales processes and playbooks as the team grows

  • Hire and onboard new Account Executives as we continue to build the DACH team

The experience you bring

  • Experience leading a B2B SaaS sales team, ideally with Account Executives selling into the DACH market

  • A strong sales background and a track record of delivering against team revenue targets

  • Experience working across different deal sizes, including larger opportunities with longer sales cycles and multiple decision makers

  • Experience helping a team move upmarket and win larger customers

  • You enjoy coaching and know how to help salespeople improve rather than simply telling them what to do

  • You’re comfortable getting involved in deals and working alongside your team when needed

  • You understand what good pipeline management and forecasting looks like

  • You’re confident using CRM data to understand performance and where the team needs support

  • You’re comfortable joining a growing company where processes are still being built and improved

  • You’re able to balance hitting the number today with building a stronger sales team for the future

  • Professional fluency in German and English

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

What we offer

You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, pension and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We have offices in Copenhagen, London and Hamburg. This role will be based in Germany with some travels to our offices to meet the team.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work - you can expect social events, opportunity to travel to our different locations to visit the teams, and offsites - our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

As Director of Product & Technology, you will own the platform at the heart of enua UK: the patient-facing product and the systems behind it, from first visit through consultation, prescription and repeat order. We want patients to genuinely love using us, and this role is central to making that happen. It is a founding leadership role and one of the most important hires we will make.

You will not start from a blank page: we have already built a modern, AI-native platform. You will take it forward: setting the strategy for how it evolves, making the big build, buy and partner calls, and shipping the features that make us the easiest and most trusted way for UK patients to access care. You will be hands-on from day one, sit on our management team alongside our MD and Co-Founder, and work closely with our group technology team.

Tasks

  • Platform strategy: Set the strategy for our UK platform so it gives us a lasting advantage through convenience, quality and cost. Build on the foundations we have and decide where we build, buy or partner across EHR, telehealth, pharmacy, payments and CRM.

  • Leadership: Be a core member of our management team, jointly responsible for the strategy and execution of the business. Build and lead a high-performing product and engineering function as we scale, working closely with group colleagues.

  • Patient experience: Own the end-to-end patient product, from first visit to repeat order, and drive exceptional patient satisfaction. Set the roadmap with the MD and management team, balancing the needs of patients, clinicians and operations.

  • Hands-on build: Build and ship yourself. Balance pace with reliability, keep technical debt in check, and set high standards for architecture, security and AI-assisted code.

  • Testing, data and analytics: Own end-to-end testing and optimisation, from UX to back end, and the tracking, analytics and reporting the business runs on.

  • AI agenda: Set the AI agenda for the organisation, finding where it can improve the patient experience and how we work, and making sure it is used safely.

  • Compliance and clinical safety: Make sure our platform meets the standards of a regulated healthcare provider, including CQC, UK GDPR and clinical safety (DCB0129/DCB0160), working with our group quality and regulatory teams.

Requirements

  • A product leader: 7+ years in product and technology, with at least 3 leading a product or engineering function. Obsessed with patient experience, with strong UX instincts and the ability to turn patient and commercial needs into a clear roadmap. You have hired and led teams and been part of a management team.

  • Technically deep: Strong architectural judgement, able to set technical direction, review code (including AI-generated code) and build data and analytics the business can rely on.

  • A builder: You have taken a digital product from 0 to 1 and on through rapid scale, ideally in D2C subscription, telehealth or digital health.

title: Integration Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Role - Integration Test Engineer

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht

About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof.

We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact: iwell is committed to form a diverse and inclusive team to tackle the challenges of the energy transition.

The Role

The proof is in the pudding, they say in the UK, however, we believe proof is in the test data. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage.

You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers. We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

  • Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements

  • Discuss and present test results internally and externally

  • Execute tests and document the result

  • Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications, processes, and instructions.

  • You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams.

What are looking for

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience.

  • Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements.

  • Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines.

Interested?

title: Interaction Designer, HCI
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing.

This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows.

There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks.

  • Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging.

  • Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery.

  • Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff.

  • Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns.

  • Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction.

  • Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth.

  • Ability to design at the micro level - states, transitions, edge cases, and failure handling.

  • Strong prototyping skills in Figma or equivalent tools.

  • Systematic thinking - able to map complex AI behavior into coherent user-facing interaction logic.

  • Clear understanding of HCI principles: user control, transparency, feedback, and graceful recovery.

  • Experience working closely with engineers to ensure interactions are implemented as designed.

  • Comfort designing for systems where output is non-deterministic and behavior can vary across sessions.

  • Strong judgment on when users should be guided, interrupted, asked for confirmation, or left alone.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

  • Gestion & Asset Management : Tu es responsable de l'inventaire, de la facturation et de la documentation technique de ton périmètre pour garantir une continuité de service irréprochable.

TES COMPÉTENCES TECHNIQUES

Nous recherchons un profil polyvalent, capable de jongler entre technique pure et gestion de projet :

  • Network Specialist : Maîtrise des fondamentaux (IPv4, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, switching, firewalls).

  • Ops & Support : Capacité d'analyse N2/N3, escalade de tickets complexes et gestion de problèmes (coordination d'équipes pluridisciplinaires).

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Tu es convaincu·e que la réussite est collective. Ta connaissance du terrain te permet de prioriser les urgences en fonction de l'impact business.

  • Tu aimes prendre des responsabilités et organiser ton activité pour gagner en efficience.

  • Tu es à l'aise en anglais (écrit/oral) pour évoluer dans notre contexte international.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

title: Lead Accountant, France & Accounting Integration
descriptionHtml:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet the Team

At Fever, our Accounting team keeps finances accurate, compliant, and transparent. We define financial parameters, resolve compliance issues, and develop better tools to manage and report data. Partnering with teams like Legal, Operations, and Brand Partnerships, we ensure every project is accounted for and every number tells the right story.

Join us if you want to ensure financial excellence, useinnovative reporting tools, and provide the transparent insights that support our rapid global growth.

  • Soft skills: strong ownership, meticulous, able to seamlessly balance operational priorities with tight project deadlines.
  • Working knowledge of French tax (VAT, corporate income tax, CFE/CVAE, liasse fiscale) to steer tax advisors with confidence.
  • FP&A literacy: budget vs. actual analysis, management reporting and cash flow forecasting.

Why You’ll Love It Here

title: Lead Customer Success
descriptionHtml:
At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

The role

Context

This new role comes as our customer base grows rapidly, driven in particular by deployments in private healthcare facilities. Its purpose is to ensure our customers get the most out of our solution and are fully satisfied with it.

As Lead Customer Success, you will own customer usage and satisfaction, and manage our Customer Support team of two experienced people. This is a hands-on Lead role: you will manage the team while still spending a significant share of your time working directly on accounts. You will work closely with Clémentine (Head of Ops), the Deployment Strategists, the Product team, and RevOps.

Missions

  • Account monitoring: track usage metrics for each hospital and define the indicators to watch.

  • Detection and resolution: spot accounts in trouble (for example a hospital whose activity suddenly drops), raise the alarm and solve the issue, on your own or with the Deployment Strategists.

  • Satisfaction: set up and follow NPS campaigns.

  • Adoption: run campaigns to increase usage of Parallel across our customers.

  • Product feedback: share what you see in the field and work with Product on levers to increase usage.

  • Management: manage two experienced people, set the framework and priorities, help them grow and structure the team as the number of accounts increases.

Who you are

  • You have 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, with your own B2B customer portfolio.

  • You have already managed people, even an intern, and you have the credibility to lead two experienced people.

  • You have already set up NPS campaigns and done account monitoring: you know which indicators you track and how you detect an account in trouble.

  • You make decisions on your own on an account and raise the alarm when a metric drops.

  • You want to keep working directly on accounts on top of managing: this is not a pure management role.

  • A plus: experience with key account portfolios.

Our values

  • Play to Win: we're not here to just take part, deliver something "good enough" or simply enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters.

  • High Trust, High Standards: trust is our starting point. If you join us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with accountability: the more freedom you have, the higher the bar.

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: at Parallel, no one is above the work. No title, seniority or past success exempts anyone from getting involved in the actual work. Leading means taking responsibility, not distancing yourself from execution.

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: we take our mission very seriously, not ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both.

Hiring process

  1. Call with the Hiring Team (30 min)

  2. Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min)

  3. An afternoon at our office to present your case and meet the founders (2 hours)

  4. Reference check

Why join us?

  • A role to build: you lay the foundations of customer success at Parallel (metrics, campaigns, team organisation).

  • A key role: customer success weighs heavily on Parallel's reputation, and you are the right hand of the Head of Ops on this topic.

  • Real traction: seed and Series A ($20M with Index Ventures) closed in less than a year, more than 800 clients and a team of over 30 people.

  • Strong investors and founders: Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI; founders who come from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo.

  • A complete package: competitive salary and BSPCE, Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, Apple equipment, 50% of public transport covered.

  • The team: a team event every month and two offsites a year.

  • Our office: Paris 2nd arrondissement.

  • Flexibility: on average one remote day per week and one remote week per year.

   

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Lead Java Software Engineer (v/m/x)
locations: Capelle aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van de openbare ruimte

Bij Progresity ontwikkelen we software die gemeenten helpt om de openbare ruimte slimmer, veiliger en duurzamer te beheren. Onze applicatie BinnenBeter verbindt inwoners en gemeenten: via de BuitenBeter app kunnen inwoners eenvoudig meldingen doen van problemen in de openbare ruimte, van kapotte straatverlichting tot zwerfafval of een losliggende stoeptegel. Gemeenten ontvangen deze meldingen in BinnenBeter en kunnen ze efficiënt opvolgen, zodat elke melding leidt tot een zichtbare verbetering in de leefomgeving. Zo zorgen we samen voor schonere, veiligere en beter onderhouden steden voor miljoenen inwoners in Nederland.

We staan aan de vooravond van een belangrijke volgende stap. Niet alleen ontwikkelen we onze software verder, ook professionaliseren we de manier waarop we software bouwen. We willen groeien naar een moderne engineeringorganisatie waarin eigenaarschap, kwaliteit, automatisering en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Daarom zoeken we een Lead Software Engineer (Java) die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook energie krijgt van het verder brengen van een engineeringteam. Iemand die verder kijkt dan de code van vandaag, een duidelijke technische visie kan ontwikkelen en anderen weet mee te nemen in verandering. Die begrijpt dat goede software niet alleen draait om technologie, maar ook om samenwerking, vakmanschap en het maken van de juiste keuzes.

Jouw rol

Als Lead Software Engineer (Java) combineer je hands-on software engineering met technisch leiderschap. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair productteam aan de verdere ontwikkeling van BinnenBeter en neemt het voortouw in de technische richting en professionalisering van Engineering.

Je bent eigenaar van de technische visie en architectuur van het product. Je bepaalt samen met je collega's hoe we onze software toekomstbestendig houden en vertaalt technische ambities naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan nieuwe functionaliteiten: ook onderhoudbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, security, betrouwbaarheid en technische schuld krijgen structureel aandacht.

Tegelijkertijd ben je een belangrijke kartrekker in het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Hoe kunnen we sneller en betrouwbaarder releasen? Hoe maken we geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD vanzelfsprekend? Hoe zorgen we dat engineers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun software, ook nadat deze in productie staat?

Je hoeft deze uitdagingen niet alleen op te lossen. Je coacht Software Engineers, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt dat technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden niet bij één persoon blijven liggen.

Je gaat onder andere aan de slag met:

  • Het ontwikkelen, uitdragen en bewaken van de technische visie en softwarearchitectuur van BinnenBeter.

  • Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare software met Java en Spring Boot.

  • Het richting geven aan belangrijke technische keuzes en het ontwikkelen en borgen van engineeringstandaarden en architectuurprincipes.

  • Het vertalen van relevante wet- en regelgeving en beveiligingseisen naar concrete technische richtlijnen.

  • Het verbeteren van onze engineeringpraktijken, waaronder CI/CD, testautomatisering, observability en DevOps.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken en structureel aanpakken van technische schuld, kwetsbaarheden en andere technische risico's.

  • Het ontwikkelen en realiseren van een technische verbeteragenda, samen met het engineeringteam.

  • Het coachen van Software Engineers en stimuleren van zelfstandigheid, kennisdeling en technisch eigenaarschap.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Engineering, Product, UX, Quality en Cloud/Platform.

  • Het onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen, waaronder AI, die onze software of manier van ontwikkelen daadwerkelijk beter maken.


Wat neem je mee?

We zoeken een ervaren Software Engineer die inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook begrijpt dat technisch leiderschap meer vraagt dan het maken van goede technische keuzes.

Je kunt complexe vraagstukken analyseren en een duidelijke richting bepalen. Tegelijkertijd weet je anderen daarin mee te nemen, sta je open voor andere perspectieven en haal je voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van collega's.

Wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en een sterke achtergrond in professionele software engineering.

  • Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, REST API's en het ontwerpen van onderhoudbare en schaalbare applicaties.

  • Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en onderbouwde technische keuzes maken.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van technische standaarden, architectuurprincipes en engineeringpraktijken.

  • Je hebt kennis van moderne softwareontwikkeling, waaronder CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen, security en observability.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden of coachen van andere Software Engineers en vindt het leuk om collega's technisch verder te helpen.

  • Je communiceert helder, kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen en weet verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Je neemt initiatief, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.

  • Je bent pragmatisch en kunt een goede balans vinden tussen technische kwaliteit, ontwikkelsnelheid en klantwaarde.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript.

  • Ervaring met WildFly, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes of vergelijkbare technologieën.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische veranderingen of het professionaliseren van een engineeringteam.

  • Ervaring met cloud-native architecturen, DevOps en het beheren van software in productie.

Je hoeft niet eerder de functietitel Lead Software Engineer te hebben gehad. Misschien ben je nu Senior Software Engineer of Software Architect en merk je dat je steeds vaker technische richting geeft, collega's begeleidt en verbeteringen initieert. Als je klaar bent om daarin een volgende stap te zetten, gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Dan bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500,- en €6.690,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een rol waarin je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de technische richting van onze software en de ontwikkeling van Engineering.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, technische verbeteringen en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden en een modern kantoor in Capelle aan den IJssel.

  • Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gehoord.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Laptop van de zaak.

  • Goede pensioenregeling en collectieve bonus.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Een rol waarin jouw werk iedere dag maatschappelijke impact heeft.

Over Progresity

Progresity is onderdeel van de Conxillium Group. Samen ontwikkelen we slimme software voor gemeenten. Onze producten ondersteunen gemeenten bij het beheren van de openbare ruimte: van bomen en groenvoorzieningen tot wegen, verlichting en meldingen van inwoners.

We bevinden ons in een interessante fase. We groeien van een traditionele softwareorganisatie naar productgerichte teams waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Dat betekent dat developers bij ons niet alleen meedenken over hoe we software bouwen, maar ook over waarom we iets bouwen en welke waarde dat oplevert voor onze gebruikers.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team waarin vakmanschap, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar helpen belangrijker zijn dan hiërarchie. We geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen verantwoordelijkheid krijgen en samen blijven leren.

Lees meer over onze organisatie op: www.progresity.com.

Sollicitatieproces

Ons sollicitatieproces bestaat meestal uit drie gesprekken. We vinden het belangrijk dat we elkaar goed leren kennen. Naast jouw technische kennis zijn we vooral benieuwd hoe jij samenwerkt, hoe je naar softwareontwikkeling kijkt en hoe jij jezelf én een team verder helpt groeien.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij bijdragen aan slimmere, veiligere en duurzamere software voor gemeenten én meebouwen aan de volgende stap van onze engineeringorganisatie? Reageer dan via de sollicitatiebutton of neem contact op met onze recruiter Steven Kruis via 06 57 43 92 61 of

title: Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
Lead Solution & Enterprise Architect

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Lead transformative architecture to redefine the future of financial services.

The Role

At Capco, you will play a pivotal role in delivering some of our clients’ most complex and high-profile transformation programmes, drawing on your expertise in enterprise and solution architecture.

You will move between hands-on solution design, collaborating closely with engineers, and articulating compelling enterprise visions to senior stakeholders. Your work will influence key technology decisions and business outcomes, leveraging approved AI-enabled tools and workflows where appropriate to enhance architectural insight, design quality and delivery efficiency.

You will oversee architecture across business, data, application and technology domains, guide cross-functional teams and support the development of colleagues. You will also contribute to the growth of our Technology & Engineering Practice through community leadership, delivery excellence and business development, while championing responsible AI adoption, appropriate governance and human oversight in architecture decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape enterprise technology strategies, architecture roadmaps and governance frameworks that align technology investments with business priorities.

  • Design complex, scalable and resilient solutions across legacy and cloud environments, applying modern distributed architecture patterns and engineering principles.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture and engineering teams, promoting collaboration, delivery excellence, continuous learning and the development of colleagues.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, communicate enterprise architecture visions and influence strategic decisions while contributing to business development and commercial opportunities.

  • Explore and apply approved AI tools, automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve architecture analysis, design documentation and delivery efficiency, maintaining human review, appropriate governance and clear escalation pathways.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience leading enterprise architecture initiatives, shaping technology strategies, roadmaps and governance across complex organisations.

  • Strong solution architecture expertise across legacy and cloud environments, including at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).

  • Experience applying modern distributed architecture patterns, including microservices, event-driven, containerised, serverless and zero-trust architectures.

  • Ability to build trusted senior stakeholder relationships, guide cross-functional technical teams and deliver through agile and DevOps practices, supported by recognised architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, Domain-driven Design or NIST.

  • Curiosity about AI-enabled ways of working, with an understanding of how approved AI tools can support architecture activities while preserving professional judgement, security, responsible AI principles and appropriate human oversight.

Bonus Points For

  • Senior-level consulting experience, ideally within financial services or other regulated industries with complex compliance, risk and security requirements.

  • Experience leading pre-sales activities, proposals or bids, including commercial ownership and client engagement.

  • Experience designing greenfield architectures, cloud-first enterprises or establishing and maturing enterprise architecture functions within agile delivery environments.

  • Awareness of emerging AI capabilities, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, and their potential application to enterprise architecture, engineering productivity and responsible technology transformation.

  • Relevant professional certifications in architecture frameworks, cloud technologies or related disciplines, such as TOGAF or cloud provider certifications.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

  • Work in a collaborative, flat and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

  • Access continuous learning, training and industry certifications.

  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across financial services and energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations and in-house first aiders.

  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause and bereavement.

  • Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.

  • Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.

  • Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way – a minimum of 40 hours of training annually. Take your pick from workshops, certifications and e-learning. You'll also be assigned a Business Coach from Day One, offering one-on-one guidance to support your goals and accelerate your development.

  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.

  • Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.
