title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Law & Contracts (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du hilfst uns bei der Erstellung, Prüfung und Verhandlung von Verträgen – alles von Verkaufs- bis Lieferverträgen oder auch Vertriebsvereinbarungen.

  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Vertragsvorlagen und -richtlinien zu verbessern und immer effizienter zu machen.

  • Wenn es um rechtliche Themen wie Vertrieb, Lizenzen oder Markenrecht und IP geht, bist du die Person, die uns mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht.

  • Du berätst unsere Marketing- und Vertriebsteams zu wettbewerbsrechtlichen Fragen (UWG) und prüfst Marketing-Claims, bevor sie live gehen.

  • Du bist direkt dabei, wenn wir spannende kommerzielle Deals und Business Development-Projekte auf die Beine stellen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams zusammen, um rechtliche Risiken zu erkennen und gemeinsam Lösungen zu finden, wie wir diese vermeiden können.

  • Außerdem bist du ein wichtiger Teil bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer kommerziellen Strategien.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du bist Volljurist:in mit zwei juristischen Staatsexamina (mind. ein Examen voll befriedigend)

  • Du verfügst bereits über 3+ Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in einer renommierten Anwaltskanzlei und/oder als Inhouse-Jurist:in, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt im allgemeinen Zivilrecht sowie in den Bereichen UWG/Marketing-Claims und Markenrecht/IP

  • Deine Kommunikation ist stets on point und du hast Freude am Verfassen rechtlicher Dokumente bzw. Schriftsätze

  • Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen und kannst rechtliche Anforderungen verständlich erklären

  • Du verfügst über exzellente Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, und es ist dir ein Leichtes, mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren

  • Neue und unbekannte Fragestellungen siehst du als Herausforderung, die du eigenverantwortlich löst

  • Du hast Lust, im internationalen Kontext zu arbeiten und gemeinsam mit Enpal zu wachsen

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit -Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost -29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

  • Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Legal Counsel, Product & Regulatory
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

We are excited to be growing our incredible London Legal team and are looking to hire 2 Legal Counsel with a strong regulatory background in financial services.

As Legal Counsel, you will work closely with all areas of the business and take a collaborative approach to solving complex legal challenges. You will be expected to advise on compliance with financial services and payments regulations, interact with regulators and assist in the implementation of broader regulatory projects and product launches across the Checkout.com group.

The successful candidate will be able to handle a busy workload with minimal supervision, demonstrating excellent critical judgment, quick thinking and agility. This is a great opportunity to work on a broad range of projects across multiple jurisdictions, learn new areas of law and play a key role in supporting the company’s rapid growth.

You will be joining an expanding team in one of Europe's most valuable fintechs. Our mission is to be a legal team that exceeds expectations across the board, providing pragmatic and commercially focused advice, finding creative solutions to manage risk and becoming trusted advisers to our colleagues in the business.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • This role is based in London at our global head office and sits within the regulatory vertical of our Legal department

  • Support relationships with regulators on license-related matters, including potential de novo applications

  • Review payments product structures, flows and terms to ensure compliance with legal requirements

  • Advise on payments regulatory matters, including compliance with payments laws and related regulations across our different jurisdictions

  • Advise on broader regulatory requirements applicable to payment services providers, including with respect to group regulatory change projects

  • Advise the business on market expansion, researching and evaluating new territories and applying for new licenses or expanding the scope of existing licenses

  • Advise key business functions on new regulatory developments impacting our operations, products and contractual commitments

  • Conduct research on various multi-jurisdictional legal issues

  • Support the company’s strategic projects and initiatives by providing creative, proactive and results-orientated advice

What We Are Looking For

  • Qualified solicitor/lawyer (3-7 PQE) with strong post-qualification experience either in-house or in private practice

  • Strong understanding of legal principles applicable to payments in the UK, including the payments ecosystem and payments regulatory and licensing strategy/execution, and to broader financial institutions

  • Previous FinTech, payments, software, e-commerce and/or bank experience is desirable but not essential

  • Experience working in a start up or other fast-paced and dynamic environment is desirable but not essential

  • Comfort with ambiguity, constant change, and a fast-paced culture

  • A practical, solutions-oriented focus to solving legal challenges

  • Experience working internationally and on a variety of cross-border matters

  • Excellent time management skills and experience managing a diverse workload and competing stakeholder demands

  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively as needed, flexing the approach as the matter requires

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate and explain complex legal issues clearly and concisely

  • Enthusiasm for new challenges and skilling up in different areas of law

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

descriptionHtml:
Logistiek Teamleider
32-40 uur

Ben jij een natuurlijke aanpakker die graag het overzicht houdt, collega's weet te motiveren en energie krijgt van een dynamische logistieke omgeving? Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer, werkt waar nodig zelf mee en weet collega's op een positieve manier te begeleiden, motiveren en ontwikkelen.

Bij BERG maken we buiten zijn nóg leuker met onze skelters, trampolines, speeltoestellen en ander kwalitatief buitenspeelgoed. Vanuit onze passie voor actief buitenspelen werken we iedere dag samen aan één doel: The outdoors is yours!

Create your future
Als Lead Warehouse ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operationele aansturing van een team van circa 15 Logistiek Medewerkers. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat de logistieke werkzaamheden volgens planning, werkinstructies, veiligheidsregels en kwaliteitsnormen worden uitgevoerd.

title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an engineer with experience in low-level systems programming and optimisation to join our growing ML team. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of Jane Street's global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction.

Your part here is optimising the performance of our models – both training and inference. We care about efficient large-scale training, low-latency inference in real-time systems and high-throughput inference in research. Part of this is improving straightforward CUDA, but the interesting part needs a whole-systems approach, including storage systems, networking and host- and GPU-level considerations. Zooming in, we also want to ensure our platform makes sense even at the lowest level – is all that throughput actually goodput? Does loading that vector from the L2 cache really take that long?

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in. 

There’s no fixed set of skills, but here are some of the things we’re looking for:

  • An understanding of modern ML techniques and toolsets
  • The experience and systems knowledge required to debug a training run’s performance end to end
  • Low-level GPU knowledge of PTX, SASS, warps, cooperative groups, Tensor Cores and the memory hierarchy
  • Debugging and optimisation experience using tools like CUDA GDB, NSight Systems, NSight Computesight-systems and nsight-compute
  • Library knowledge of Triton, CUTLASS, CUB, Thrust, cuDNN and cuBLAS
  • Intuition about the latency and throughput characteristics of CUDA graph launch, tensor core arithmetic, warp-level synchronization and asynchronous memory loads
  • Background in Infiniband, RoCE, GPUDirect, PXN, rail optimisation and NVLink, and how to use these networking technologies to link up GPU clusters
  • An understanding of the collective algorithms supporting distributed GPU training in NCCL or MPI
  • An inventive approach and the willingness to ask hard questions about whether we're taking the right approaches and using the right tools
  • Fluency in English

Why SetSales

What roles are available

You’ll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on your talent profile and interests, could entail responsibilities such as:

descriptionHtml:
Gestalte die Zukunft der größten Deals. Schreibe Wirtschaftsgeschichte.

Du willst nicht nur Zahlen modellieren – du willst mitentscheiden, ob ein multi-millionenschwerer Deal fliegt oder nicht? Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen: Du analysierst komplexe Transaktionen, identifizierst Hebel für bessere Margen, koordinierst mit Legal und Tax – und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse direkt dem Top-Management. Wer hier arbeitet, wächst schnell.

  • Finanzielle Modellierung & Analyse
    Du erstellst ganzheitliche Finanzmodelle – von Projektkosten und Kunden-Pricing über P&L-Rechnungen bis hin zu Bilanzen – und führst gezielte 360°-Analysen zur Identifikation, Quantifizierung und Adressierung von Risiken und Chancen für Klienten, Accenture und weitere Stakeholder durch.

    Du erstellst entscheidungsreife Finanzunterlagen für interne Freigabekomitees und präsentierst Finanzszenarien auf Augenhöhe mit dem C-Level – überzeugend, auf den Punkt und mit direktem Einfluss auf Verhandlungsführung und Vertragsgestaltung.

  • Strategische Steuerung & Risikoeskalation
    Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig, eskalierst proaktiv bei kritischen Deals und bringst konstruktive Vorschläge zur Transaktionsoptimierung ein – immer mit Blick auf das Gesamtbild.

  • Klienteninteraktion
    Als Teil des kommerziellen Teams wirkst du bei der Abstimmung kaufmännischer Punkte mit dem Klienten mit – etwa zu Preisannahmen, Vertragskonditionen oder Risikoverteilung – und unterstützt so die Verhandlungsführung des Teams.

Qualifikation

  • Masterstudium (oder gleichwertiger Abschluss), idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Accounting oder Wirtschaftsmathematik, sowie mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in vergleichbarer Rolle – z. B. in der Unternehmensberatung, M&A, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder im Konzernfinanzwesen, inklusive Verantwortung für komplexe Projekte.
  • Erfahrung in der direkten Klientenkommunikation und kommerziellen Verhandlungen – du fühlst dich sicher, wenn es darum geht, Preisargumente zu vertreten und Kompromisse auf Augenhöhe vorzutragen.
  • Herausragende Fähigkeiten im Finanzmodelling, insbesondere in Excel, sowie Vertrautheit mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot) zur Effizienzsteigerung in Analyse und Entscheidungsfindung.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Denkweise und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, kombiniert mit verhandlungssicheren Englischkenntnissen und Deutschkenntnissen auf muttersprachlichem Niveau oder C2.
  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams, souveränes C-Level Stakeholder Management sowie Eigenverantwortung, Neugier und Teamgeist – du gestaltest aktiv mit, statt nur umzusetzen.

The Security Libraries team owns the customer-side integrations behind Datadog’s run-time security products — App & API Protection, Workload Protection, and Code Security — shipping and maintaining security capabilities across seven open-source language libraries (.NET, Java, Go, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP) and a set of HTTP proxy integrations (Envoy, NGINX, and HAProxy), running inside thousands of production clusters worldwide.

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.

About the Job

Software Engineering Managers independently lead teams to deliver a variety of software integrated in to our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control or decision support. We expect Software Engineering Managers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership of a major system within an integrated product, and the team responsible for building and maintaining it. Software Engineering Managers contribute as a team lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

What You’ll Do

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

Technical skills

title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Wil jij werken in een innovatieve onderzoeksomgeving waar geavanceerde simulatoren en interoperabiliteit centraal staan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten!

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar;

  • Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging;

  • Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen;

  • Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context;

  • Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen;

  • Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties;

  • Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s;

  • Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken.

Nice to have:

  • Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs);

  • Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren;

  • Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen;

  • Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools;

  • Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4330,- en € 7000,- (bij fulltime dienstverband), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: Member of Technical Staff (Platform Leaning)
descriptionHtml:
About Tessl

AI is transforming how software is built, and at Tessl, we're building the infrastructure for what comes next.

We're developing a platform that enables engineering teams to build and run AI-powered software factories, where coding agents take on real development work, from picking up engineering tickets to implementing changes and creating pull requests.

By combining structured context, reusable agent skills, automated workflows and evaluations, we're making AI-powered development more reliable, repeatable and scalable, while keeping humans in control. We're tackling some of the biggest challenges in autonomous software development, from code quality and security to helping organisations confidently adopt AI agents at scale.

Founded by Guy Podjarny, previously founder of Snyk, Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup backed by over $100 million in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart.

Joining Tessl means helping define an entirely new category of technology, solving ambitious technical challenges and shaping the future of software development.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE

Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software.

This is a product engineering role with a platform twist. Most of your time, you'll do what every Tessl engineer does: design, prototype and ship product features end to end, collaborating closely with product, design and the wider engineering team in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment. What makes you different is that when the work goes below the application layer, you light up rather than back away: complex networking scenarios such as site-to-site VPN and private connectivity, multi-cloud and multi-region deployments, observability, and the machinery that makes Tessl straightforward to deploy, operate and support wherever it needs to run.

We expect you to be relentlessly AI native about it: instead of triaging alerts at 2 am, you'll build or deploy the agent that does it. Instead of reacting to scaling bottlenecks, you'll create systems that spot them before they happen. Deep expertise is the foundation, because you can't automate what you don't know, but your ambition should be to make agents do the bulk of the operational work, with you supervising and steering.

We're open on level for this role, from mid-level to senior: trajectory and appetite matter more to us than years.

What success looks like: Within your first year, you're shipping product features end to end like any Tessl engineer. When infrastructure work arises, from deployment architecture to networking to observability, you're the one who takes it on and lands it well, with support where you need it. Our deployment and operational practices are stronger because of you, agentic tooling handles a growing share of the toil, and the infrastructure work you touch is compliant by default, keeping our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 journey unblocked.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

No two days will be the same at Tessl! You'll have a high level of autonomy and be empowered to make decisions based on what you believe will help you deliver the most success. Here's an insight into just a few of the things you would be doing:

Product engineering (most of your time)

  • Design and implement new functionality end to end, from initial design and prototypes to fully scoped production implementations, reviewed with the product team

  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities to prove or disprove an idea, then develop a plan for a scalable implementation

  • Pair with designers and other engineers to make the experience intuitive and slick, and integrate third-party services so we can focus our cycles on Tessl's core capabilities

  • Gather requirements from customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguity into agreed plans, and deliver them

Platform & infrastructure

  • Lean into infrastructure work as it arises: our AWS estate (EKS/Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and our observability stack (Dash0/OpenTelemetry, Sentry, PostHog)

  • Contribute to the architecture & build of our more complex networking and deployment scenarios, such as private connectivity and multi-region setups

  • Improve developer experience and platform ergonomics so every engineer at Tessl ships faster

  • Partner with our Infosec team so that everything you build is compliant by default, contributing infrastructure controls and evidence towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2

AI-native automation

  • Build or deploy agentic tooling that picks up firing alerts and works through diagnostic steps autonomously, giving a human supervisor a detailed assessment with recommended actions

  • Build agents that keep our estate healthy without human toil: dependency upgrades that test and merge themselves, alerts that arrive pre-diagnosed, runbooks that execute instead of sitting in a wiki

  • Continuously spot repetitive manual work, across product, platform and on-call workflows, and convert it into agent-driven automation

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is as excited as we are to be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of AI and software development. We're committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Must-haves

  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer (TypeScript/Node preferred): you care about code modularity, structure and aesthetics, and you're equally comfortable contributing to a mature codebase with strict CI criteria or hacking up a quick prototype to prove an assumption

  • A genuine pull towards platform and infrastructure work, backed by hands-on experience: you've deployed and operated real systems (Kubernetes, cloud environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD), and when the chance came to go deeper, you took it, whether that was owning platform or DevOps work in a previous role or picking up the infrastructure tasks nobody else wanted

  • Solid systems and networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, VPCs, firewalls; you can reason and debug below the application layer with confidence

  • Demonstrated use of AI coding tools and agents to accelerate your own work, and excitement about experimenting with new AI approaches to transform how engineering is done

  • Comfortable with fast-paced, high-autonomy environments: you turn loose requirements into plans and shipped work without waiting to be told

Nice-to-haves

  • You self-host things for fun: a homelab, your own services, a Kubernetes cluster nobody asked you to run

  • Production AWS/EKS experience, or hands-on work with private connectivity, VPNs, or multi-region architectures

  • Experience producing infrastructure evidence for certifications such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2

  • You've thrived in an early-stage startup before

  • Have a cool project to show us (GitHub links welcome!)

The kind of person you are

  • You're a product engineer first: you measure infrastructure by what it lets the team ship, and you see platform work as making every engineer faster, never a domain to guard

  • You're calm under pressure, including when production is misbehaving and the answer is three layers down the stack

  • You think big about how AI changes the job: the best engineers automate themselves out of the repetitive loop and operate at the scale of a team

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change, and you grab a shovel when something needs doing outside your lane

  • You communicate clearly and bring people along: product, security, engineers and customers all need to trust your judgement

Application Process

Here's an outline of what you can expect during our interview process:

  1. Introductory Call with one of our engineering leaders. A relaxed chat to learn about your background, interests, and career goals. We'll also share more about the role, Tessl's vision, and answer any questions you have.

  2. Take-Home Exercise. You'll receive a practical challenge based on real scenarios you might tackle at Tessl: an opportunity to showcase your approach to problem-solving on your own schedule.

  3. On-site Technical Session. You'll pair with two of our lead engineers to build on your take-home exercise. This session simulates working together on real problems and allows us to explore your technical expertise more deeply.

  4. Culture Conversation with our People Lead. A two-way dialogue about our values, team dynamic, and your motivations. Feel free to ask about life at Tessl, growth opportunities, or anything else you're curious about.

  5. Leadership Discussion with Maurilio (Head of Engineering), and potentially also with Guy (CEO) or Dru (Head of Product). Our final stage focuses on strategic alignment and long-term vision. You'll learn more about Tessl's roadmap and how you could contribute to our mission.

Throughout the process, if you have any specific requirements or need adjustments, please let us know: we're happy to accommodate.

Life at Tessl

We want Tessl to be a place where you can do meaningful work, keep learning and enjoy being part of the team. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits designed to support you both inside and outside work.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity: Market-benchmarked salaries and EMI share options.

  • Time off: 25 days of annual leave, plus UK public holidays, and two paid volunteering days each year.

  • Private healthcare: Vitality medical insurance, including dental, optical and mental health support, with cover included for partners and dependants.

  • Pension: A 5% employer pension matched contribution through Smart Pension.

  • Life assurance: Company-paid life insurance with MetLife providing cover of four times your annual salary.

  • Family Leave: We offer enhanced Maternity, Parental and Adoption Leave from day one to support you and your growing family.

  • Learning and development: We support opportunities to continue developing your skills with a £1,000 per year to spend.

  • Commuting benefits: Financial support for eligible team members commuting from outside Greater London, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.

  • Summer & winter offsites: Twice a year, we bring the whole Tessl team together for a week-long offsite. It's a chance to step away from our usual routines, collaborate on big ideas, build stronger relationships and enjoy shared experiences together. And of course, we have a lot of fun along the way!

Our London HQ

Our office is in the heart of King's Cross, surrounded by London's growing AI and technology community.

We work together in person on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, giving us time to collaborate, exchange ideas and build relationships. You'll also enjoy catered lunches (Tuesday & Thursday), plenty of office snacks, regular team lunches and socials, plus a pet-friendly workplace.

How we work

Our operating principles shape how we collaborate and make decisions. We move quickly and learn by doing, build on ideas before challenging them, get stuck in wherever we can help, and give people real ownership. We encourage thoughtful debate, curiosity and a willingness to try things that haven't been done before. Read our five operating principles.

We're AI native

AI isn't just what we're building - it's central to how we work every day, across every function. We actively use AI to improve how we work, solve problems and challenge traditional ways of doing things.

You don't need to be an AI expert to thrive at Tessl, but you do need curiosity, an appetite for experimentation and a willingness to embrace new ways of working. We expect everyone to use AI regularly, invest time in learning how to get the most from it and keep experimenting when something doesn't work the first time, rather than defaulting to manual approaches.

We're also big believers in sharing what we learn. We encourage transparency about how we're using AI, what's working, what isn't and how we can help each other improve. Being AI native doesn't mean removing human judgement, it means using AI thoughtfully, while taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of our work.

We particularly welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in technology. If you're excited about the opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we'd still encourage you to apply.

If you need any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to make the process accessible and comfortable.

Come build with us

We're moving fast, experimenting boldly and figuring things out as we go. There's plenty to build, lots to learn and real opportunities to make your mark.

If you're excited by big ideas, enjoy getting stuck in and want to be part of something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Member of Technical Staff, Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Agon

Agon is building Europe’s defence AI lab. We develop the sovereign infrastructure and AI foundation models to train, test and evolve autonomous defence systems, in Europe and for Europe. At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. We work as a neutral partner to defence manufacturers and governments.

Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date. Our $70M Series A, at a $450M valuation, was led by Northzone alongside Lakestar, Lux Capital and XYZ, with backing from former Sequoia Capital head Roelof Botha. It was also the first joint investment by the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund and the National Security Strategic Investment Fund.

Between them, our founders have helped build one of the defining defence-tech companies of the last decade, and started an aerospace company from scratch. Around them is a founding team hand-picked from Europe’s best engineers, each at the top of their field, and brought together to build this. We’re scaling fast across our offices in London and Berlin.

The role

As a Member of Technical Staff on our Platform team, you’ll build the simulation engine at the core of the arena. It has to be fast enough to train autonomous systems at massive scale, and faithful enough that what they learn holds up in the real world.

You’ll work on the physics, numerical methods and high-performance systems that make that possible, from multi-platform scenarios to the infrastructure that runs them in parallel. We’re looking for people who build engines and solvers, not just use them.

This role is based in London or Berlin.

What you’ll do

  • Build the engine: design and implement core simulation systems, including physics, collision detection, numerical solvers and multi-platform scenarios.

  • Make it fast: optimise for throughput and scale with multithreading, GPUs and careful profiling, so AI agents can train across huge numbers of simulations.

  • Make it right: balance accuracy, determinism and performance, and help validate simulation results against real-world data.

  • Model the real world: work with domain experts to bring aircraft, sensors and other systems into the arena at the right fidelity.

  • Serve the AI: work closely with our AI team on interfaces, surrogate models and infrastructure that make learning in simulation fast and reliable.

  • Raise the bar: set engineering standards, review code and shape the architecture of a platform built to last.

What you’ll bring

  • Engine-building experience: you’ve built or significantly improved a simulator, physics engine or numerical solver.

  • Systems programming skills: expertise in C++ or Rust, plus Python.

  • Performance engineering: you’re at home with multithreading, GPU programming and profiling, and can make code dramatically faster.

  • Numerical depth: a strong grasp of numerical methods, and of the trade-offs between accuracy, determinism and performance.

  • Strong fundamentals: solid computer science foundations and best engineering practice.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI tools as a default part of how you build, and you know where they fail.

  • Ownership: you’re outcome focused, think problems through and see them to completion.

Nice to have

  • Experience with game or physics engines such as PhysX, Havok, Bullet or Jolt

  • Background in flight dynamics, vehicle simulation, sensor modelling or scientific computing

  • Experience with autonomous systems, robotics or sim-to-real validation

  • Experience with JAX, distributed systems or large-scale parallel simulation

  • Interest in defence, or experience in aerospace or defence

What we offer

We pay at the top of the market we compete in, and everyone is an owner.

  • Pay: salary at the 90th percentile of the companies we compete with, benchmarked by role, level and location.

  • Equity: every permanent employee holds options. New hires receive options worth their base salary, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff.

  • Cash and equity choice: trade some salary for more options, or some options for more cash.

  • Pension: 5% employer and 5% employee contributions on full base salary.

  • Hard problems: build a simulation platform from the ground up, at a scale and fidelity few teams attempt.

How we work

Our values shape how we work: All as One Company, Take Extreme Ownership, Low Ego, Be Bold, and Remember Who We Serve. We prefer clear written thinking to polished slides, and we hold a high bar.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you’re excited by this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still like to hear from you.

title: Meridial – Senior Research Software Engineer – Image Processing
descriptionHtml:
About Meridial

Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system.

Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).

The technical challenge

Our imaging platform records the activity of neurons and synapses in the living brain. The scientific value of these recordings depends on converting raw images into reliable, quantitative data.

This is a demanding image processing problem. Fluorescence signals are faint, noisy and spatially overlapping; residual tissue motion and other imaging artefacts must be corrected; in addition to conventional planar frames, data may be acquired from arbitrarily shaped 3D regions or several depths at once; properties vary between signal types and experimental configurations; and the same cells and synapses must be reliably matched across imaging sessions spanning weeks. You will build a software package that addresses these challenges in two modes: real-time processing and visualisation, with latencies of tens to hundreds of milliseconds, that inform experimental decisions at the microscope, and offline pipelines that deliver maximum accuracy for scientific analysis and serve as the benchmark for the real-time methods.

The impact of this work is direct and visible: your software will be used at the microscope as experiments unfold, and your pipelines will generate the data underpinning new insights into how neural circuits function and how they change in disease.


Key responsibilities

You will own Meridial’s image processing software end to end, starting from the interface with microscope control and acquisition all the way to processed results prepared for biological analysis. This is a role with a high degree of autonomy: you will make the main design and technology decisions, set priorities with the people who use the software, and work out what to build as requirements emerge.

Who you will work with

  • Experimental team. The neuroscientists running experiments are the main users of the real-time tools. You will work with them at the microscope, understand their problems and turn joint solutions into reliable tools.
  • Senior Software Engineer. Develops the microscope control and image acquisition software, mostly in Rust. Your real-time code exchanges data with that software but need not be part of it. Together, you will decide how the two systems connect.
  • Neuroscience Data Scientist. Owns Meridial’s database and the downstream scientific analysis. You will ensure processed results reach the database with a full record of how they were produced.
  • Reporting line. You will join the Computational Team and report to its Head once appointed, and to the Director of Experimental Research until then.

    • What you will do

  • Build robust pipelines for motion and artefact correction, segmentation of cells and synapses, separation of overlapping signals and extraction of activity over time, adapted to different signal types.
  • Register data from flexible 3D imaging modes to reference volumes, and build tools that find the same field of view and match cells and synapses across sessions, both live at the microscope and offline at high resolution.
  • Develop real-time versions of these methods that keep up with streaming data, including fast identification of cells as stimulation targets.
  • Build live visualisations and summary measures, such as rolling averages, response histograms and noise metrics, that help scientists steer experiments.
  • Define, with the Senior Software Engineer, the interface between acquisition and processing, with a focus on throughput and low latency.
  • Evaluate and adapt existing open-source tools, develop new methods where needed, and validate them against ground truth, using offline results as the benchmark for the real-time processing.
  • Optimise for speed and scale, using multi-threading, GPUs or compiled languages where needed, so that processing keeps up with large and growing datasets.
  • Write clean, tested and documented code, and set up version control, continuous integration and documentation practices for the codebase.
  • Use AI coding assistants to work efficiently, while keeping code correct and maintainable.
  • Plan and track work in Jira or another project management system, in short iterations with the experimental team.
  • Turn prototypes into reproducible tools that scientists can use and that can be released as open source.

    • The person we are looking for

    You are an experienced software engineer with a background in image analysis or computer vision. You enjoy hard technical problems and set high standards for correctness, performance and code quality. You like working directly with the people who use your software: understanding their problems, trying out ideas with them and turning the best into reliable tools.

    You enjoy building from scratch and are comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage organisation. As the main developer of our image processing software, you will work independently and shape how it evolves.

    Experience in any of these areas would help you hit the ground running, but none is required: real-time or streaming data processing, microscopy or scientific image analysis, statistics, or machine learning for image analysis. A background in biology, biophysics or neuroscience would also help.


    Essential experience
  • Experience with image analysis or computer vision, such as segmentation, motion correction, registration or denoising, including image quality measures like signal-to-noise ratio.
  • 5+ years of software development experience, in industry or research (for example, PhD or postdoctoral work where software was a main output).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with good engineering practice: Git, automated testing and well-documented code.
  • Experience with performance optimisation, such as multi-threading or GPU programming, and with a compiled language such as C/C++ or Rust (if not Rust, a willingness to learn it).
  • Experience building interactive, high-performance data visualisations.
  • Experience building data-intensive pipelines for large datasets, from requirements through to deployment.
  • Experience working directly with end users who are not developers, gathering requirements and turning feedback into improvements.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development.

    • Physical demands
  • Fine motor skills for operating computers and office/lab equipment
  • Ability to move light-to-moderately heavy items (typical lab supplies/equipment); may include occasional lifting/carrying with appropriate equipment (e.g., carts/dollies)

    • Position type / schedule
  • Start date: February 2027 or later.
  • Full-time.
  • Based in London, with an on-site presence of four days per week.

    • Additional information
  • Please send your CV.
  • We will ask for two references during the interview process.
  • Generous benefits will be communicated during interviews.
  • For exceptional candidates, Meridial will consider visa sponsorship and relocation support.

    • We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law or company policy. We strive for a diverse, healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibit harassment of any kind.

    We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
descriptionHtml:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.

•L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal.

Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet.


Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées.

Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D).

L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible.

title: Operational Safety Advisor
descriptionHtml:
At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

The role

We are looking for a pragmatic, field-oriented Operational Safety Advisor whose mission is to enable safe, efficient and repeatable deployments of autonomous industrial machines. Working within the Deployment team, you will help customers and Deployment Managers identify operational risks early, agree practical mitigations and remove blockers. Your role is to simplify how safety is addressed, not add bureaucracy, complexity or new approval gates.


Key responsibilities

Site visits and operational assessments

  • Visit customer sites to understand working practices, machine movements, pedestrian interfaces, traffic management, visibility and exclusion zones.

  • Identify operational risks early and work with customers and Deployment Managers to propose proportionate, practical actions that keep deployments moving safely.

  • Support early site feasibility (pre / post contract signing) and readiness discussions, using existing deployment milestones rather than creating additional approval stages.

Operational safety advisory

  • Advise customers on operational risk assessments, safe systems of work, emergency arrangements, access controls, training and supervision.

  • Recommend simple, workable operational mitigations and help customer HSE and site management teams implement them.

  • Escalate product-related or technical safety issues to Engineering rather than owning their design or approval.

Standards, checklists and continuous improvement

  • Continuously simplify Hive’s operational safety checklists, site assessment templates and practical advisory guidance; keep them risk-based, concise and reusable.

  • Record only the essential findings, decisions, actions and owners needed to support safe execution and clear handover.

  • Turn lessons learned into fewer recurring blockers, better standard practices and faster repeatable deployments.

Deployment collaboration

  • Work proactively with Deployment Managers and Commercial to resolve operational safety dependencies early, before they delay site mobilisation or go-live.

  • Support customer-led operational readiness and handover within the existing deployment process; do not establish a separate Hive operational-safety approval gate.

  • Communicate concerns clearly, propose solutions and escalate material risks promptly; enable decisions rather than becoming a bottleneck.

Essential experience and skills

  • Practical operational HSE / safety experience in industrial, construction, quarrying, ports, logistics or heavy-equipment environments.

  • Proven experience conducting site inspections and operational risk assessments and recommending workable controls.

  • Understanding of mobile machinery interfaces with people, vehicles and site operations.

  • Ability to produce short, actionable, risk-based checklists and guidance without unnecessary documentation.

  • Confident communication with site managers, operators, customer HSE teams and deployment personnel.

  • Willingness to travel frequently and work independently in active industrial environments.

Desirable

Experience with heavy mobile plant, remote operations or automation; familiarity with UK/EU workplace safety requirements and relevant industry qualifications (e.g. NEBOSH or IOSH).


Success in the first six months

  • A lean, risk-based operational safety assessment approach is embedded in existing deployment workflows without additional approval gates.

  • Operational risks and blockers are identified early, with practical mitigations, clear owners and timely resolution.

  • Deployment Managers have concise, reusable guidance that reduces rework and accelerates safe site mobilisation.

  • Lessons learned are converted into simpler standards and more predictable deployments across regions.

descriptionHtml:
Optical SSA / Image Processing Engineer

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview

London · Full time · On-site

As well as ranging with lasers, our stations track satellites optically. You'll build the image processing that finds, tracks and measures objects in our camera data.

What you'll do

  • Develop pipelines for detection, streak extraction and astrometry

  • Calibrate cameras and timing so that measurements are accurate and traceable

  • Build real-time processing to support closed-loop tracking

  • Validate results against catalogue orbits and our own laser data

  • Work with the optics and software teams on camera selection and integration

What you'll bring

  • A degree in physics, astronomy, computer science or similar

  • Image processing and computer vision in Python or C++

  • Astrometry and photometry experience, for example with astropy or Source Extractor

  • Knowledge of camera sensors: noise, calibration and time-stamping

Nice to have
