title: Partner Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Partner Solutions Engineer

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

With a global team based in our offices, and remote colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US, and the APAC region, Phrase offers an international environment built on collaboration, innovation, and shared purpose.

Partner Solutions Engineer is a new role in Solutions Engineering, built to help agencies make AI useful in their clients' global content workflows. You will lead the solutions side of partner-led deals from the first conversation to close, working alongside Partnerships, who lead on commercials. The people you meet are production and technology teams in agencies, language service providers and martech and AI platforms, who work in content operations and want answers quickly. You will report to the VP, Solutions Engineering, and work exclusively on partner-led deals, helping to shape how the role works as it grows.

This is a global role: we would ideally like you based in the UK or Western Europe and working on UK time, but we are flexible for the right person.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Lead the solutions side of partner-led opportunities from first conversation to close, while Partnerships leads on commercials

  • Find the business problem a partner and their client are trying to solve before showing the product, explain where Phrase fits and be clear about trade-offs

  • Turn Phrase's technical detail into a clear value case that a senior marketer would buy and an agency would pitch

  • Run demos and hands-on co-innovation sessions with partners using Phrase integrations across CMSs and DXPs, CRM and marketing platforms, creative tools and developer tools

  • Show how Phrase works inside AI assistants and agentic workflows through the Phrase MCP Server and Phrase Atlas, and help partners build on Phrase through our APIs

  • Work with Product to co-design differentiated integrations with partners, and bring what you hear from agencies and platforms into the roadmap so those integrations are adopted, stay in use and drive revenue

  • Run workshops that take a partner team from no knowledge of Phrase to confident in a single session, at partner offices, our events and theirs

  • Build working relationships with production, technology and practice leads inside partner organisations

  • Work alongside Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering and Product, and bring them in early for deep technical or build work

  • Share what you learn from partners with Product and Partnerships so that our integrations and partner programme keep improving

  • Present the whole Phrase Language Intelligence Platform: projects, vendors and workflows in Phrase TMS with Phrase Orchestrator automating the steps in between; brand terms and tone of voice across markets; developer access through our APIs, Phrase Strings and the Phrase MCP Server; and transcription, subtitling and dubbing in Phrase Studio

What you need:

  • At least three years in solutions consulting, solutions engineering or similar pre-sales in martech (CMS, DXP, marketing automation or content platform), or leading technology conversations at an agency

  • Deep experience in at least one CMS, DXP, content or marketing platform, and the ability to map a client's stack and explain the choices to agency and marketing teams

  • High emotional intelligence and conversational skill, so that one-to-one and group meetings feel fluid with you in them, and the habit of asking great questions and reading the room as the conversation moves

  • The ability to walk into an agency meeting with little or no customer context and still make it a great conversation, as ambiguity and last-minute briefings are normal in this work

  • The ability to lead a room: whiteboard a session, ask good questions about the business problem, and frame technical detail as outcomes a senior marketer cares about

  • Confidence running live demos and adapting them to the people in the room

  • An understanding of how agencies and holding companies staff, sell and deliver work for their clients, and how generative AI is changing that work

  • Working knowledge of APIs and webhooks, the ability to sketch a workable integration and explain the trade-offs to non-technical people, and an understanding of where AI agents and MCP fit

  • Clear, friendly written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for partner meetings and events, sometimes across time zones

  • Experience in localisation, transcreation or language technology (desirable). We are just as open to people from martech, or from agency and martech, who pick up new technology quickly and want to learn the language side with us

  • Experience at a headless CMS or content platform, in an agency technology role, or at or closely with a holding company's production arm, a systems integrator or a language service provider (desirable)

  • Hands-on experience with an MCP client or with building on LLM APIs (desirable)

  • A second language, or experience speaking at events or running training sessions (desirable)

Our current tech stack in this role:

  • Phrase TMS

  • Phrase Orchestrator

  • Phrase Strings

  • Phrase Studio

  • Phrase MCP Server

  • Phrase Atlas

  • Phrase APIs and webhooks

  • Phrase integrations with CMSs and DXPs, CRM and marketing platforms, creative tools and developer tools

What you'll get:

  • Work experience in a successful and growing global SaaS company

  • Be part of an international team in Europe, APAC, and the Americas

  • Expert colleagues in their field who are determined to build the best localization platform on the market, creating a world where language never limits opportunity

  • An agile work environment, where it is encouraged to take smart risks

  • Take part in a culture full of trust, support and loyalty, where respectful and open feedback is valued, and diversity is fully embraced

  • A positive, open-minded, and innovative atmosphere

  • Support in your professional development and personal career goals

What's on top:

  • 4 Company holidays additional to your regular holidays (1 day per quarter where the entire company is off to celebrate our achievements).

  • In addition, the company also provides employees with a Christmas break to allow you to spend time with family and friends without use of your vacation allocation.

  • Your birthday is off because it is important to celebrate you as well.

  • 2 Giveback days where you can support the local community, volunteer, and/or participate in charity events and activities.

  • Professional and extensive onboarding.

  • Enterprise Claude Licence

  • Additional local benefits depending on the entity you're hired at, just ask your Talent Acquisition Partner

Phrase is committed to ensuring equal pay for equal work and work of equal value between women and men. Our aim is that our workforce will be truly representative of all sections of society and that each worker feels respected and able to give their best. The job requirements and salary range for this job have been established through a gender-neutral job evaluation and classification process. This process objectively assesses the skills, responsibility, effort and working conditions required for each job. This systematic approach ensures fair pay regardless of who performs the work. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their sex, race or ethnicity, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, gender identity or age. We value and welcome different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds as we believe that these differences make our team even stronger on our mission of opening the door to global business by giving everybody access to the content they need in the language they speak.

title: Partnerships Manager, AI & Frontier Labs
descriptionHtml:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Frontier AI labs and biotechs work with Adaptyv to close that loop, and many of these relationships grow into long-term partnerships.

You run these partnerships day to day, from the first project through delivery and renewal, and you make sure each partner gets more value from Adaptyv over time.

What You'll Do

  • Run partner projects. You scope experiments and benchmarks with partner scientists and AI researchers, and you keep projects on track with our lab and engineering teams.

  • Grow each partnership. You find the next project, the larger campaign or the new team inside the same partner, and you help shape the terms.

  • Bring the partner’s voice back. You tell the lab and product what partners need next.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in biology and ML. You can discuss protein engineering and wet-lab data, and you understand why AI labs need experimental data for training and benchmarking.

  • Partnership or account experience. You have managed technical collaborations or accounts with AI labs, research platforms, biotech or pharma R&D.

  • Credible with scientists. Partners expect a peer, so a scientific background is a strong signal.

  • High agency. You see what a partnership needs and act on it without a playbook.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools every day for research, preparation and follow-up, and you check what they produce.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Performance Marketer (m/w/d) - Meta Ads × AI × Creative Strategy | E-Commerce, Online Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Die meisten Performance Marketer können eines von dreien. Wir suchen jemanden, der alle drei verbindet.

Erstens: Performance. Du führst Meta-Ads-Accounts für hochpreisigen E-Commerce - Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, lange Kaufentscheidungen, komplexe Customer Journeys. Du steuerst nach Geschäftszahlen (CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER), nicht nach Plattform-ROAS. Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Wenn du verstehst, warum das richtig sein kann, bist du hier richtig.

Zweitens: AI - richtig eingesetzt. Wir sind eine AI-native Agentur. Das heißt bei uns: eigene MCP-Anbindung an die Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits und Anomalie-Erkennung, selbstgebaute Skills für Angle-Entwicklung und Skript-Bau. Diese Werkzeuge sollst du nicht bedienen wie ein Formular, sondern führen wie ein Instrument: AI übernimmt das Wie (Analysen strukturieren, Varianten bauen, Daten durchkämmen), die Hypothese - das Was - bleibt deine. Wer jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, produziert denselben Output, den jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell auch bekommt. Beides scheidet aus.

Drittens: Creative Strategy. Bei High-AOV entscheidet das Creative, nicht der Kampagnen-Setup-Trick. Du musst keine Creatives produzieren, aber du musst sie lesen können: Warum gewinnt dieser Winner? Welches Segment, welche Kaufhürde, welcher Beweis fehlt im Funnel? Du entwickelst mit dem Creative-Team Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → Angle), verstehst, warum ein kalter Markt andere Hooks braucht als ein heißer, und liest Creative-Performance jenseits von Hook Rate und Thumbstop.

Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio und dem Anspruch, in unserer Nische die Beste in Deutschland zu sein. Unsere Kunden kaufen Urteilsvermögen, kein Button-Pushing: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und nicht nur Anzeigen ins System tippen.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst Accounts end-to-end: Audit → Hypothese → Test-Plan → Skalierung → Reporting.
  • Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers und inkrementellen KPIs; du verstehst warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht.
  • Du nutzt unseren AI-Stack als Standard-Werkzeug. Account-Audits, Breakdown-Analysen und Anomalie-Erkennung laufen AI-gestützt; du lieferst die Fragestellung, prüfst den Output und triffst die Entscheidung.
  • Du dekodierst Creative-Performance: Du erkennst, warum ein Winner gewinnt (Hook, Mechanismus, Einwandbehandlung, Proof), und übersetzt das in die nächste Test-Hypothese.
  • Du bringst eigene Angle- und Set-Piece-Hypothesen in die Creative-Planung ein: Welches Segment ist unterversorgt, welche Kaufhürde unbeantwortet, welches Stück Customer Journey fehlt.
  • Du sagst Kunden die harte Wahrheit, wenn der Bottleneck das Offer, die Landingpage oder das Produkt ist und nicht die Ads. Und du lieferst dazu immer einen Alternativweg.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Führen von Meta-Ads-Accounts mit relevantem Budget
  • Du arbeitest täglich und tief mit AI: eigene Prompts und Workflows, Erfahrung mit LLM-gestützter Analyse. Du kannst konkret zeigen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
  • Du kannst eine fremde Winning-Ad auseinandernehmen und erklären, warum sie funktioniert. Nicht "gutes Video", sondern Zielgruppe, Mechanismus, Beweisführung.
  • Du kennst die Grundlogik von Awareness- und Sophistication-Stufen (Schwartz) oder Vergleichbares aus der Praxis: verschiedene Bewusstseinsstufen brauchen verschiedene Botschaften.
  • Du denkst in Geschäftszahlen und verstehst ROAS ≠ Deckungsbeitrag
  • Du hast die Geduld für lange Journeys, die Disziplin, einem System zu folgen, und bist konfrontationsfähig gegenüber Kunden.

Benefits

  • Eine Rolle am Schnittpunkt von Performance, AI und Creative - mit Werkzeugen, die wir selbst bauen statt einkaufen.
  • Ein kleines, hochwertiges Kundenportfolio statt Fließband. Jede deiner Entscheidungen bewegt echtes Budget und echtes Geschäft.
  • Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt.
  • Kompetitiver Gehalt basierend auf deinem Erfahrungslevel
  • Eine lockere Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und jeder Menge Spaß, ohne dass die Professionalität verloren geht.
  • Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work sind bei uns keine Fremdwörter.
  • Ausstattung mit den neusten Apple-Produkten.
  • Nette, professionelle und sorgfältig ausgesuchte Kunden - die dein Leben definitiv NICHT zur Hölle machen. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden auf Augenhöhe.

So läuft die Bewerbung:

  1. Kurzbewerbung - Im Anschluss an die Profilsichtung: Ein paar Rückfragen per E-Mail oder Telefon.
  2. 2 x Gespräche - 1x mit Geschäftsführer & 1x mit einem Team-Member. Überprüfung der fachlichen und persönlichen Eignung.
  3. Eine kompakte Probearbeit an einem realen Szenario. AI-Einsatz ist dabei ausdrücklich erlaubt und erwünscht - uns interessiert, wo du sie einsetzt und wo bewusst nicht.

Du erkennst dich wieder? Dann bewirb dich.

title: Post-doctorant·e en UnStrain : révéler les tensions de mobilité par apprentissage de représentations - CDD de 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  1. Développer des modèles génératifs et d'apprentissage de représentations intégrant flux de mobilité, réseaux de transport, occupation des sols et données sociodémographiques dans un espace latent commun, afin d'identifier des tensions de mobilité interprétables et d'évaluer des interventions susceptibles de les réduire.

  2. Vérifier la cohérence des tensions détectées avec des indicateurs établis de déséquilibres territoriaux (précarité liée à la mobilité, déserts de transport collectif, déserts alimentaires, déséquilibre emplois-logements).

  3. Évaluer les apports de la méthode par rapport aux indicateurs fondés sur des définitions a priori (p. ex. seuils d'accessibilité ou de disponibilité de l'offre), en identifiant des configurations multifactorielles latentes dans plusieurs sources de données.

Activités

  • Acquérir, nettoyer, aligner et combiner les flux de mobilité, les réseaux de transport, les données d'occupation des sols et les données sociodémographiques.

  • Concevoir des représentations de données et des chaînes de prétraitement pour des sources de données spatiales hétérogènes.

  • Implémenter et entraîner des modèles génératifs et d'apprentissage de représentations.

  • Construire des représentations vectorielles des unités spatiales et développer des méthodes pour extraire et interpréter les tensions de mobilité latentes.

  • Analyser les relations entre la demande de mobilité, l’occupation des sols, l’offre de transport et la mobilité observée.

  • Comparer les tensions détectées à des indicateurs établis : précarité liée à la mobilité, déserts de transport collectif, déserts alimentaires et déséquilibre emplois-logements.

  • Évaluer des configurations multifactorielles complexes non captées par les indicateurs prédéfinis existants.

  • Concevoir et évaluer des scénarios d'intervention sur les transports visant à réduire les tensions de mobilité détectées.

  • Programmer les expériences, analyser les résultats et assurer la reproductibilité de la chaîne de calcul.

  • Présenter et publier les résultats, et collaborer avec les partenaires de Mobidec ainsi qu'avec les acteurs industriels et institutionnels concernés.


Formation

  • Doctorat obtenu ou thèse en cours d'achèvement.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables

  • Excellentes compétences en modélisation mathématique et en analyse

  • Bonnes compétences en programmation

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables

  • Expérience en apprentissage profond et en apprentissage de représentations

  • Expérience en science des données spatiales.

Capacités et aptitudes

  • Rigueur, méthode de gestion de projets

  • Aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux, esprit d’écoute et de coopération

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe

  • Respect strict des obligations de confidentialité au regard des données utilisées

Indications de rémunération:

  • Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable): 35.400 - 38.000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public).

Informations complémentaires et candidature

  • Date limite de candidature : 16 octobre 2026

  • Nature du contrat : CDD de 18 mois

  • Catégorie et métier du poste (usage interne): II - P, Post-doctorant·e ou A (fonction publique)

  • Poste ouvert aux métiers de niveau immédiatement inférieur (usage interne)

  • Localisation du poste: Palaiseau (91)

  • Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidats en situation de handicap

  • Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et/ou aux contractuels

  • Conditions de travail : 44 jours de congés, télétravail possible, restaurant et cafétéria sur site, accessibilité en transport en commun (avec participation de l'employeur) ou proche des axes routiers, association du personnel et association sportive sur le campus

Merci de transmettre les documents suivants. Les candidatures incomplètes ou dépassant les limites indiquées seront automatiquement écartées :

  • CV (2 pages max).

  • Un document expliquant, en 5 lignes max, pourquoi votre profil correspond le mieux au poste, à l'aide d'éléments factuels, précis et non génériques.

  • Un document présentant jusqu'à 3 de vos meilleures publications. Pour chacune : auteurs, titre, lieu de publication et année ; classement du lieu (revue : quartile ScimagoJR, indice SJR et H-index ; conférence : ERA CORE ; si le lieu n'est pas classé, expliquer pourquoi il est de haut niveau) ; votre contribution (2 lignes max) ; et pourquoi la publication est importante, démontre votre excellence et/ou est liée au sujet du postdoctorat.

  • Toutes les notes obtenues dans les enseignements de niveau licence (BSc) et master (MSc). L'envoi de votre classement est facultatif, mais constitue un atout important.

title: Principal AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

Key Responsibilities

•    Technical strategy and architecture. Define the AI/ML architecture and technical roadmap across the portfolio. Identify shared capabilities, establish clear interfaces, and guide build-versus-buy decisions while respecting product-specific requirements.

•    Predictive ML and optimization. Lead advances in prediction, targeting, ranking, bidding, pacing, and personalization. Guide feature development, training, calibration, and serving, addressing sparse signals, delayed outcomes, and changing data distributions.

•    Agentic frameworks and agents. Design reusable orchestration, tool integration, retrieval, state and memory, and multi-agent coordination. Build workflows for campaign planning, insights, recommendations, and execution, with explicit permissions, human approval where needed, and recoverable failure handling.

•    Portfolio integration. Partner with Predict, Agentic Frameworks, Email DSP/SSP, and agentic teams to connect models, data, and services through well-defined APIs and shared evaluation practices. Turn successful patterns into reusable components and practical migration paths.

•    Production engineering. Own critical designs and implementations across data pipelines, training, deployment, and inference. Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices for reproducibility, versioning, automated testing, observability, and safe rollouts and rollbacks.

•    Evaluation and business impact. Define offline benchmarks and online experiments tied to advertiser outcomes. Evaluate prediction quality, calibration, agent task completion, tool accuracy, latency, and cost; use A/B testing and incrementality methods where appropriate.

•    Reliability and responsible AI. Set standards for service performance, drift detection, data quality, and incident response. Build privacy-aware data access, auditability, and protection against prompt injection, data leakage, and unintended agent actions.

•    Technical leadership. Partner with engineering, data science, product, and business leaders to turn ambiguous needs into deliverable plans. Lead design and code reviews, mentor senior engineers, and resolve technical decisions across teams.

Required Qualifications

•    12+ years of relevant software engineering and applied ML experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including substantial ownership of production ML systems and technical leadership across multiple teams.

•    Deep expertise in predictive ML for ranking, recommendation, classification, or optimization, with strong foundations in statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, and the full model lifecycle.

•    Hands-on experience delivering LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and operational monitoring.

•    Proven ability to architect distributed, high-throughput, low-latency systems and make sound trade-offs across model quality, infrastructure cost, and operational complexity.

•    Strong Python skills and proficiency in Java, Go, or a comparable backend language; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, SQL, and large-scale data or streaming systems such as Spark and Kafka.

•    Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, containerization, CI/CD, model serving, and production observability; familiarity with relational, NoSQL, caching, and retrieval systems.

•    Ability to influence without direct authority, communicate architectural decisions clearly, mentor experienced engineers, and translate business objectives into measurable technical outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

•    AdTech experience across DSPs, SSPs, real-time bidding, audience modeling, identity, attribution, or measurement; relevant experience in recommendation systems or marketplaces is also valued.

•    Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, contextual bandits, constrained optimization, or online learning in production.

•    Experience with privacy-aware identity and audience systems, email advertising, or integrating ML capabilities across multiple products.

•    Experience optimizing model and LLM inference, selecting and adapting models, or building reusable ML and agent platforms adopted by multiple teams.

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Principal Product Manager

JOOR | Product Management

Founded in 2010, JOOR now services more than 14,000 brands and over 600,000 buyers across 150 countries, processing an incredible $1.7B in wholesale transaction volume each month. Backed by Macquarie Group, Battery Ventures, Canaan Partners & ITOCHU, JOOR is a Series D start-up that provides the world's most recognized brands and retailers with a digital wholesale management platform that transforms the way these businesses work.

 

With a CEO recently named a Glossy 50 "Changemaker in the Fashion Industry" and inducted into Forbes' "50 Over 50" 2022 class, JOOR is attracting top talent to drive market dominance. With our team of 150+ experts, we maintain an established global presence with employees in key markets in North America, Europe and APAC.

About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape the future of wholesale commerce.

This is an opportunity to work on meaningful product challenges at the intersection of B2B commerce, data, and emerging technologies, including AI, on a platform connecting brands and retailers around the world.

You'll play a key role in defining how our platform evolves to better serve brands and retailers, from simplifying complex workflows to unlocking new opportunities for growth and efficiency.

As a senior individual contributor, you'll have significant ownership over your product area, from identifying the right problems to solve through delivering solutions and measuring their impact. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders to make thoughtful tradeoffs, build alignment, and deliver outcomes that matter to both our customers and JOOR.

We're looking for a thoughtful, commercially minded product leader who combines strong product instincts with a collaborative approach and a passion for solving meaningful customer problems.

What You'll Do

  • Shape product strategy. Identify opportunities to improve how brands and retailers conduct wholesale business, and translate those opportunities into a clear product direction and roadmap.

  • Lead meaningful product initiatives. Own the product lifecycle from discovery and strategy through development, launch, and ongoing optimization, partnering with Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, and customer-facing teams to deliver successful outcomes.

  • Champion customer understanding. Work directly with customers and cross-functional teams to uncover unmet needs, understand complex workflows, and identify opportunities to deliver greater value.

  • Turn insights into action. Combine quantitative and qualitative research to challenge assumptions, develop hypotheses, evaluate solutions, and make informed product decisions.

  • Drive measurable impact. Define success through customer and business outcomes, using data and insights to inform decisions and continuously improve the product experience.

  • Partner across disciplines. Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design to develop intuitive, scalable solutions, navigate technical tradeoffs, and balance new product development with platform reliability and modernization.

  • Build alignment through storytelling. Communicate product vision, strategy, decisions, and results in ways that inspire confidence and create shared understanding across the organization.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, ideally with complex B2B SaaS, commerce, retail technology, or marketplace platforms.

  • Proven track record of independently leading product initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify high-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make informed tradeoffs across competing priorities.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex challenges, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.

  • Demonstrated experience using customer research, product analytics, and market insights to inform product strategy and decisions.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with an understanding of how product investments contribute to customer value, retention, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.

  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Design to develop and deliver thoughtful, scalable product solutions.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership, build alignment, and make decisions in complex environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate product vision, strategy, recommendations, and results clearly and persuasively.

*You will be UK-based, working with flexible hours between 9am–8pm GMT, Monday to Thursday. For example, on two days a week you might start at 11am GMT and finish at 8pm GMT (including a 1 hour break). Working patterns will be agreed with your manager to support project commitments and collaboration across our global team. Whilst most work takes place during standard business hours, flexibility will be required to support colleagues, clients, and projects across different time zones.

Why JOOR

At JOOR, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex, meaningful challenges with real-world impact, helping evolve an established platform while exploring new possibilities in commerce, data, and AI.

You'll join a collaborative, globally distributed team with substantial ownership over your product area, the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, and the autonomy to turn ideas into meaningful customer and business impact.

title: Product Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're expanding access to affordable credit by launching credit products that make a real difference to customers. We move quickly, often with leading fintech, consumer and e-commerce companies, so that we can offer affordable credit at the right point in the customer journey. We work in a highly regulated environment, so our products have to work end to end from day one: technically, operationally and commercially.

 

As a Product Associate, you'll work across product, data and commercials. You'll dig into how our products perform, from funnel conversion to loan-level unit economics, and turn what you find into ideas for how we scale, improve margins and grow. You'll work hands-on with data and code, alongside Product Managers, Engineering, Credit and Operations. You'll help decide where the product goes next, as well as how we ship it.

 

This role is for top-tier STEM or Economics graduates who think like analysts, build like engineers and care about the P&L like owners, and who want to progress to Product Manager at a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech.

 

What you'll be doing

 

Product analytics & insight

  • Own analysis of product performance across the full funnel: traffic, applications, approvals, conversion, originations, repayment and credit outcomes

  • Build and maintain the dashboards, metrics and data models that Product, Credit and Operations rely on

  • Form sharp hypotheses, design experiments (journey changes, pricing, A/B tests) and measure the impact rigorously

  • Get to the root cause of anomalies quickly, whether the cause is in the data, the code or the customer journey

Unit economics & commercial thinking

  • Model the economics of each product: acquisition cost, approval and take-up rates, pricing, funding cost, expected loss, servicing cost and lifetime value

  • Put numbers on the trade-offs behind product decisions, such as wider approval versus higher losses, or partner revenue share versus volume

  • Track contribution margin and cohort profitability by product, channel and partner, and show where we make or lose money

Growth & product strategy

  • Come up with ideas for scaling and growing from where we are today (new segments, channels, products and pricing) and estimate what each one is worth

  • Look across our products and partnerships for places where they reinforce each other: cross-sell, top-ups, repeat lending, shared customers and shared data

  • Help evaluate new partner opportunities and build the business case, covering volume, economics, integration effort and risk

  • Turn the strongest ideas into clear proposals and see them through to launch

Building & shipping

  • Use AI coding tools to build and ship product end to end, across both front-end and back-end, from quick prototypes to features that go live

  • Build internal tools, automations and data workflows that remove manual work and help the team move faster

  • Be proficient with our analytics stack: build dashboards in AWS QuickSight and track funnels, events and experiments in PostHog

  • Use SQL and Python every day to pull, model and analyse data

  • Learn how our APIs, decisioning flows and data pipelines work, and work directly with engineers on specs, testing and release validation

  • Support Product Managers with discovery, delivery and partner onboarding

Launch readiness & operations

  • Define success criteria for each launch and the metrics that show whether it's working

  • Design test scenarios, including edge cases and failure modes, and test the end-to-end customer journey before release

  • Work closely with QA to make sure production releases are stable

  • Monitor production performance after release, and pick up and triage related bugs with engineering

  • Make sure new products and journeys work at launch for customer support, collections and complaints teams

  • Use operational data to spot recurring issues, fix them at the source and make sure they're closed out, not just discussed

Who you are

  • A top-tier STEM or Economics graduate (computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, economics or similar)

  • 0–2 years of experience, including internships, placements or early-career roles with real responsibility

  • Strongly analytical and confident with SQL and Python, able to go from raw data to a clear recommendation

  • Able to build with AI. You use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to ship working front-end and back-end code, and you've built things, whether side projects, hackathons, internal tools or production apps

  • Hands-on with analytics tools such as AWS QuickSight, PostHog or similar BI and product analytics platforms

  • Commercially minded. You naturally ask how something makes money, and you enjoy modelling unit economics, pricing and P&L

  • Strong product sense. You have opinions on the products you use, why they work and how they could grow

  • A structured problem-solver who can break down messy, real-world problems

  • A clear communicator who can walk an engineer through a model and make a recommendation to leadership

Nice to have: an interest in consumer credit, lending, payments or fintech; experience with experimentation and statistics.

How you work (and what we value)

  • You think like an owner, of both the customer outcome and the commercial outcome

  • You'd rather build a quick prototype or run the numbers than debate in the abstract

  • You follow through until problems are actually solved

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't wait for perfect instructions

  • You speak up when something doesn't make sense, and you help fix it

  • You put in extra effort at key moments, such as launches and live incidents, knowing that's where the real learning happens

Progression & growth

This role is a stepping stone to Product Management, with a clear progression path. As a Product Associate, you'll be expected to:

  • Build deep knowledge of our products, data and commercials

  • Consistently own problems end to end and deliver measurable business and customer impact

  • Show strong judgement, data-driven thinking and stakeholder management

High performers will progress to Junior Product Manager as they begin to:

  • Own a product area or metric independently, including its commercial performance

  • Lead defined workstreams within launches or partner integrations

  • Originate growth ideas that make it onto the roadmap and deliver results

Progression is based on impact and ownership, not time served.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company: equity

  • Hybrid working, with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days' holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month's paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together: set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Product Design Manager
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.

This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.

You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.

More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.

🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:


Lead and develop the team

  • Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

  • Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

  • Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

  • Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.

Raise the design bar

  • Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

  • Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

  • Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

Own the whole product experience

  • Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

  • Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.

Make design a real partner

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

  • Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.

How much of this is hands-on?

Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes.

You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. This is not a first management role.

  • 🧭 Running a team well: You've run effective 1:1s, evidence-based performance reviews and difficult feedback conversations, including with people who weren't performing. You've built or improved a career progression framework for designers, and you're comfortable with the administrative side of managing a team rather than treating it as overhead.

  • 📈 Growing people: You coach and mentor, you run critique that changes the work, and you can point to specific designers who got measurably better or grew in scope while reporting to you.

  • 🎨 Design taste and judgment: Your own craft is strong enough that designers trust your read on quality, you can articulate what separates adequate design from excellent design, and you'll step into the work directly when the situation calls for it.

  • 🎯 Hiring: You've hired designers consistently well, you know where good design talent is and how to attract it, and you can tell the difference quickly.

  • 🤖 AI fluency: You use AI tools hands-on in your own work and in how your team designs, and you have an informed view on designing AI-enabled products. AI agents are the product here, so this one is not optional.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical products: You've managed design teams in B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow automation or similarly technical products.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You don't need to write code, but genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath (APIs, webhooks, data structures, how workflows actually execute) earns you credibility with engineers here.

  • 👩‍💻 Designing for developers: You've designed products for developers, technical operators or other sophisticated users.

  • 🔭 Systems view: You can step back from individual projects to spot patterns and UX problems across a broader product experience.

  • 🤝 Influence without authority: You bring Product and Engineering peers with you through reasoning rather than positional authority.

  • 📊 Scaling teams: You've grown a design team through a period of rapid company growth.

  • 🌍 Distributed teams: You've managed designers in remote-first or highly distributed organisations.

  • 🔓 Open source: You've worked on open-source or community-driven products.

  • 🌱 Inclusive hiring: You've meaningfully broadened the diversity of a design team through how you hire.

Our hiring process

We'll tell you the whole shape of it upfront, and there's very little homework.

  1. Screening call with our recruiter. 45 minutes, no prep.

  2. Leading designers with the hiring manager, 75 minutes. You'll present for 20 minutes on a team you built, grew or turned around. Reuse existing material; it shouldn't take more than two or three hours. We don't need case studies of your own design work.

  3. Live critique and coaching, 60 minutes. We'll send you a real piece of n8n design work 24 hours ahead. You'll critique it, then have a coaching conversation with the designer who made it. No preparation beyond reading it and trying the product.

  4. Conversation with our VP of Product, and a culture call with Jan, our CEO. 45 minutes each, same day where we can.

  5. Meet two or three of the designers you'd be managing. Not scored; it's for you as much as for us.

We'll also ask for two references, one of them a former direct report. A portfolio is welcome if you have one, though we know not every design manager keeps theirs current.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead design for a product that hundreds of thousands of builders use to automate real work, sitting right where developer tools, AI agents and no-code interaction models meet. The design problems are genuinely hard and largely unsolved.

You're inheriting an established team with strong designers, not building from zero, and there's real room to shape how the team coaches, critiques, grows and works with Product and Engineering, rather than inheriting a rigid design organisation. You'll stay close enough to the craft to influence quality directly, while your main job is making the designers around you better.

You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, at the point where n8n is scaling from a beloved open-source project into a major B2B platform. Design's contribution to product thinking is established here, and has a long way still to run.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You will own products from the first conversation about a problem to the moment customers use them, and keep improving them after launch. That means figuring out what matters, cutting the scope to something useful, designing the experience and API, building across the stack, and taking responsibility for how it works in production.

You will own clearing products for Global Banks and Financial Institutions such as big Banks in Mexiko, fintechs in Nigeria or Central Banks in Southeast Asia. This could be anything across accounts, payments, treasury, credit, FX, multi-currency, our public APIs or the dashboard. You will own products and features end to end, meaning from working with a customer to shipping something to have impact.

We expect you to combine incredible bias to AI with great technical taste and hard work. Own problems, build products, ship value. At all times, you are responsible for the code you write, so you must be able to write, understand and debug code. Fast implementation only matters when the product solves the right problem and works reliably.

This is a demanding role with substantial ownership. You will learn unfamiliar domains quickly, make decisions with incomplete information and put sustained effort into getting difficult things over the line. You will have a lot of say about how you design features and how our product looks like.

Your First Six Months

  • Weeks 1-2: Ship one big feature to a customer with taste.

  • Months 1-3: Launch one new product to customers.

  • Months 4-6: Own and iteratively improve one product.

  • Months 7-12: Own and launch new products. Build an enablement system for agents around launching the products you own.

 

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You see an awkward workflow and start figuring out how to make it better. You can show us something you took from an idea to a working product, and explain the decisions you made.

  • You learn unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask precise questions, find the underlying constraints and change your mind when the evidence changes.

  • You care a LOT about product experience: API naming, sensible defaults, loading states, clear errors and what happens when something fails.

  • You use agents to attempt more ambitious work. You can show how you steer them, catch their mistakes and verify the result.

  • You move quickly and work hard. When a project gets difficult, you narrow the problem, seek help where needed and keep ownership until it works.

  • You can choose the smallest useful solution and still insist on correctness, security and a good user experience.

  • You want responsibility that grows with your ability. Your strongest evidence might come from a startup, a job, open-source work or something you built independently.

This is not for you if:

  • You need others to get your stuff done.

  • You do not enjoy talking to customers.

  • You vibe code stuff without adding quality gates and correctness checks.

  • You treat product decisions as someone else's responsibility.

  • You are not able to pick up new complex domains quickly.

  • You do not enjoy working long hours.

Hard Requirements

Must Haves:

  • At least one working product or substantial feature you personally built and can discuss in depth. Commercial, independent and open-source work all count; confidential work can be discussed without sharing private code.

  • Hands-on use of coding agents, including the ability to review their output and identify incorrect or unsafe behavior.

  • Based in Berlin or open to relocate.

Strong preference:

  • Experience shipping a product with real users and improving it from feedback.

  • Evidence of unusually strong independent work: a useful side project, meaningful open-source contributions, a company you built or substantial ownership in a small team.

  • Experience with APIs, payments or financial products. Banking experience is useful, but not required.

  • There is no minimum number of years of experience or degree requirement. We assess demonstrated ability and scope of ownership.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €70,000-€100,000 + equity and benefits.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we’re building the trust layer for how the world’s most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We’re turning the function that has always said “no” into infrastructure that says “yes, and here’s how.”

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we’re only at the beginning. The product you’ll help build is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we’ve already earned the trust of leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, NatWest, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise £2.6m in funding, and we’re now scaling fast. We’re building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product engineering role for someone who has shipped real features and wants to take on more ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers and the founders on product slices from spec to production. Over time you’ll own them end-to-end. Here’s the kind of work you’ll contribute to:

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. It was built with Monzo as the design partner and is public on the Chrome Web Store.

  • A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, and the action runs.

  • The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

  • Integrations that reach into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com, and Frame.io for video.

  • A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day and tell us quickly when something’s wrong. That tight feedback loop is one of the best things about the job, and it’s a fast way to grow.

What you’ll do

  • Ship product features from spec to production. Most of the work is across the full stack, and integration work where needed. You’ll start with guidance and take on bigger slices as you grow.

  • Build the surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, and the moments where model output meets human judgement.

  • Work on features where AI is in the critical path. The model is genuinely part of the product, not bolted on.

  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first few weeks. We deploy continuously, so you’ll feel the pace immediately.

  • Bring your perspective to what we build and how we build it. We want to hear when something doesn’t make sense.

  • Learn from senior engineers through code review, pairing and design discussions, and help raise the bar yourself.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven delivery. Building production web applications, with features you’ve shipped that real users depend on.

  • Growing ownership. You can take a well-scoped feature and run with it. You know when to ask for input and when to unblock yourself. You want to grow towards owning larger, more ambiguous pieces of work.

  • Product sense. You care about the user experience, notice when something feels off, and aren’t afraid to say so. You’re learning to balance polish against shipping at pace.

  • Collaboration. You communicate clearly with engineers, designers and founders, ask good questions when something is underspecified, and are receptive to feedback.

  • AI literacy. You use modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents) day to day. You treat them as collaborators, check their output critically, and are curious about where they help and where they get in the way.

Technical skills

  • Solid TypeScript and React, with working experience on the backend.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in, building products where AI is in the critical path.

  • Familiarity with modern web tooling, including Node and Postgres.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono or Drizzle.

  • Exposure to regulated industries such as fintech, healthtech or legaltech.

The Stack

React, TypeScript and Tailwind on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • Professional development budget

Kaluza est la plateforme d’intelligence énergétique qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que tu apportes
