descriptionHtml:
The role is 2-3 days a week hybrid at the office near which you’re based in London, Bath or Edinburgh.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Product manager to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our firm management problem space. You’ll take responsibility for how firms onboard with Seccl, manage their businesses and deal with performing compliance checks on end investors.

You’ll work as part of a cross-functional team, collaborating and partnering closely with engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, and our risk and compliance team to drive meaningful outcomes for our clients and their end users.

Working alongside the product leadership, you’ll define the long-term vision for your product, establish metrics, and use that to frame progress. Your role involves deeply understanding market dynamics, identifying pain points and opportunities, and translating these insights into demonstrable customer value.

With your Senior engineering manager, you’ll lead your squad through discovery, shaping, development, and delivery. Balancing strategic thinking with execution to shape the future of our platform. You’ll work closely with our customer and operation teams to gather insights and requirements, validate solutions, and problem solve while using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions.

You’ll work at the heart of your squad, prioritising and maintaining a consistent view across your team of what you should be building and why. You’ll balance competing priorities and technical initiatives against your own strategic view, aligning the resultant roadmap with risk and compliance to ensure a balance of product improvement, innovation and regulatory integrity.

What you’ll own...

You’ll be responsible for building with your squad, developing a broader strategic direction and coordinating with Product leadership in a domain that’s centred around how Seccl’s customers set-up and operate. You’ll parse information in your domain and develop that into a roadmap with associated discovery and shaping.

These are some of the main problem spaces that you’ll be working on:

  • Firm onboarding, set-up and branding: Ensuring that firms can start making the most of Seccl’s products. That starts early in the launch process and carries through to how companies with billions of pounds under management can run their businesses on our platform effectively.

  • KYC, AML and sanction screening: Working closely with our Risk team and customers to deliver products and workflows that keep all parties compliant and assured. As a regulated entity and organisation that cares about the longevity of our business, this is foundational.

  • Operational Products: Solving problems for ops users as they manage how end investors interact with our processes. Ensuring that Seccl can continue to scale smoothly.

  • Technical touch points: Improving how Seccl’s webhooks communicate events and how our technical documentation facilitates integration and feature adoption.

  • Lead discovery, shaping and delivery with your squad engineering manager, aligning teams on what to build and why

This role’s for you if...

  • You’ve worked in a Product role and understand how to turn problems into useful products in a B2B2C space

  • You’re a builder who cares about what existing and future customers actually need

  • You’re curious and empathetic, and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand problems and test solutions

  • You can balance competing priorities, make pragmatic trade-offs and explain your reasoning clearly

  • You partner effectively with engineering, operations, customers and risk or compliance stakeholders

  • You’re comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of a scaling business

  • You have experience in fintech, particularly in an early-stage or scaling business, and with regulated products.

  • Desired: You have a passion and track record in improving end user experience while maintaining flawless fraud-management regulatory compliance

Who you are...

  • A builder: The thing that you want to do is build what our customers, both existing and future, want to use. All the things that you do and how you approach the day-to-day are orientated around this.

  • Curious and empathetic: The best way to build things that people want to use is to understand the nature of the problems that afflict them. You’re someone who is both fascinated by those problems and can gather the data that defines and clarifies them.

  • Has experience in fintech and regulated environments: Ideally, you’ve worked in a company that will give you a head-start in understanding how to exceed at Seccl. That means a fintech, most likely at an early or scale stage – or you were part of the company at those stages. Bonus points for having worked on a product that’s regulated.

  • Able to handle scaling: Seccl is growing quickly and that means there’s a lot of context to understand and a growing world of possibilities to explore. That means engaging in trade-offs, pragmatically choosing between committing your team to work that holds an equally compelling argument. You’re able to articulate what assumptions you’re making and guide people through your reasoning.

  • Product or product-adjacent: You’ve worked in Product, or in a role that’s adjacent. Understanding the expectations of the role and the patterns that drive success will be key in getting you up-to-speed quickly.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You want a fixed brief: this domain is evolving, and you’ll be expected to question and shape its boundaries

  • You prefer delivery without discovery: understanding the problem and validating solutions are central to this role

  • You want to avoid regulatory complexity: compliance and customer outcomes need to work together

  • You prefer priorities to be decided for you: you’ll need to make and communicate trade-offs

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

💰 An annual salary between £65 000 and £80 000 reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days each year

🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

📖 Annual learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • Talent screen – 30 min with the Talent partner to explore your experience and fit to the role

  • First round – 45 min skill based interview with the Group product manager

  • Case study round – 60 min presentation with a Senior engineering manager and Group product manager

  • Bar raiser – 45 min with two Seccl culture champions focused on cultural alignment

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Our mission is clear: we're here to create a world where everything operates at its very best, ensuring that every employee receives the support they need to live life to the fullest, both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Product Manager, you will own the outcomes of something new at Ben: agents that do benefits admin work for HR and reward teams. Today an admin running a payroll cycle or sending files to benefit providers spends days in spreadsheets and email threads, and one wrong line shows up in someone's pay. Your job is to give them that time back, and you'll be measured on whether it happens: hours saved, errors avoided, customers live, and how much work the agent completes without anyone stepping in.

Ben already runs benefits for hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries, which gives a new product real data and real configuration to work with from the start. You'll lead a squad of engineers and a designer from the first problem to the first customers live, and you'll make the calls on what gets built.

Things you will be working on…

  • Build what Ben does next: decide where agents can take on benefits admin work, starting with payroll and provider files, and grow it from the first customers into a product every Ben customer uses.

  • Make the agent safe to trust with real work: define what good output looks like for payroll and provider files, write the eval cases for each new job with engineering, and decide what the agent does on its own and what needs an admin's approval.

  • Set the direction for the squad: you decide what the squad works on and why. When design and engineering pull in different directions, you make the call and explain it.

  • Get the first customers live: work directly with early customers and the implementation team to deploy the agent, fix what breaks, and decide what becomes product.

  • Turn one-off requests into product: when a customer needs something custom, decide whether it should become a feature every customer gets.

  • Make benefits run themselves: sit with HR and reward teams, read their support conversations and call recordings, and break each job into the steps, rules, and edge cases an agent needs to run it on its own.

  • Prove the time saved: set the metrics that show whether admin time actually drops, and report them to the leadership team.

  • Ship with confidence: use AI tools to prototype flows, tune prompts, and ship changes yourself. The evals and guardrails are already in place, so you can back your own judgement and get work in front of customers quickly.

You will love this role if you have…

  • Taken a product from problem to customers: you've taken at least one product or major feature from the first problem to customers using it, as a product manager or through a route like solutions, implementation, or founding a company. You put an early version in front of customers before it was polished, and you can tell us the number it moved and what you chose not to ship.

  • Worked a hard problem out from first principles: You've broken down a problem nobody around you had solved, worked out how it actually worked, and built your answer from there. A background in engineering, maths, or science often shows up here, and we'll look at how you think whatever your route.

  • Built for complex environments: you've built products with lots of rules, edge cases, and connected systems, where a wrong answer costs someone money, such as eligibility, pricing, payroll, insurance, payments, or compliance. Not essential, but it will put you ahead.

  • Built something with LLMs: you've built an LLM feature, agent, or workflow and dealt with how it fails. Shipped to customers is best. An internal tool or a serious side project counts if you can show us the failures you found and how you decided what good enough meant. Show us one and walk us through how you put it together. Not essential, but it will put you ahead.

  • Worked closely with engineers on integrations: you can talk through APIs, data models, and how a product connects to other systems like payroll. Not essential, but it will put you ahead.

  • Changed how other people work: you've made a product call that changed how a team or your customers worked, brought them with you when they pushed back, and can tell us how it played out.

  • Gone all in on AI: AI is how you work by default. You pull your own data, prototype flows, and draft specs with AI tools, you try new models the week they land, and you've changed a decision because of what that work showed you.

Why join us?

  • Something big to own: You'll own a whole area of the product, with the scope that usually comes at a more senior level elsewhere, and you'll decide what goes in the first version.

  • Scale from day one: Ben already runs benefits for hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries, at companies like Mondelez and Octopus Energy. What you build reaches admins at global businesses from the start, and Ben is Series B, backed by Atomico and Mercia.

  • Close to the decisions: You'll work directly with the Head of Product and the leadership team on where the product goes next.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It’s important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to our benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package.

We’ve built an offering that provides a selection of benefits across 5 key pillars: health & wellbeing, family, lifestyle, finance and social. This means you have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, along with the full offering here.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

About the role

  • Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

  • Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

  • Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

  • Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

title: Product Performance & Go-to-Market Internship
descriptionHtml:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)

🎯 Le Rôle

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire Product Performance & Go-to-Market pour accompagner directement la personne en charge de la Performance produit, du Go-to-market, du Product Ops et de la stratégie au sein de l’équipe Produit.

Ce rôle transverse a pour mission d’éclairer les décisions produit par la donnée et de porter les sujets de l’équipe jusqu’au marché : analyse de la performance et des données produit, automatisation IA de la collecte d’insights, coordination des lancements avec le Marketing et analyse du marché.

Ce stage te permettra d’évoluer dans un environnement fintech réglementé, d’acquérir une expérience concrète en Product Operations, en analyse de la performance produit et en automatisation IA, et de contribuer à l’ensemble du pilotage du Produit : dashboards et analyses de performance, insights go-to-market, préparation des revues et synthèses pour le leadership.

Le cœur de la mission est orienté Product Ops et Go-to-Market, avec une forte composante data et IA : tu interviendras aussi bien sur le pilotage interne du Produit, chiffres à l’appui, que sur la coordination des lancements et l’analyse du marché. Tu pourras également contribuer à la veille stratégique, notamment réglementaire (AML-R, eIDAS 2) et concurrentielle, afin de nourrir la réflexion de l’équipe Produit sur 2027.

🧩 Les Responsabilités

Rattaché(e) directement à la personne en charge de la performance produit, du go-to-market, du Product Ops et de la stratégie, tu contribueras à plusieurs aspects du pilotage du Produit :

📊 Performance et données produit

  • Construire et maintenir les dashboards de performance produit (usage, adoption, qualité de service) : collecte des données auprès des squads, du Marketing et de la Data, fiabilisation des sources, mise à jour mensuelle.

  • Analyser les données produit et en tirer des lectures actionnables : évolution des indicateurs, écarts par rapport aux objectifs, adoption des fonctionnalités, retours utilisateurs ; proposer des recommandations aux PM et au leadership.

  • Mettre en place des automatisations IA pour récupérer et consolider les insights go-to-market internes (retours Sales, Support, Customer Success, tickets) et les rendre exploitables par l’équipe Produit.

🗂️ Pilotage produit et rituels

  • Aider à centraliser et qualifier les insights et product requests avant leur analyse et leur priorisation.

  • Contribuer à préparer les supports des revues de roadmap et des synthèses trimestrielles à destination du leadership.

  • Participer aux rituels de l’équipe Produit : comptes rendus, suivi des actions, mise à jour des outils (Notion, Jira).

🚀 Go-to-Market et veille

  • Participer à la coordination des lancements avec le Product Marketing Manager : kits de lancement, communication interne, supports pour les équipes Sales et Support.

  • Contribuer aux analyses de marché et benchmarks concurrentiels pour alimenter la roadmap et le positionnement.

  • Aider au suivi de l’adoption des fonctionnalités après mise en production et remonter les retours aux PM.

  • Réaliser des notes de veille réglementaire et concurrentielle, et des benchmarks ponctuels.


👤 Le profil recherché

  • Étudiant(e) en fin de cycle (Bac+4/5) en école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce ou université, avec une spécialisation en IA, data, product management, stratégie ou gestion de projet digital.

  • Pratique avancée de l’IA : capacité à mobiliser un assistant (ChatGPT, Claude ou équivalent) pour analyser des données, produire des synthèses et automatiser des tâches récurrentes ; appétence pour les agents et les automatisations no-code (Make, n8n ou équivalent).

  • À l’aise avec Notion et Jira.

  • Bonne capacité de structuration et de synthèse : savoir transformer des informations éparses en une page claire.

  • Rigueur et sens de l’organisation : capable de tenir des routines récurrentes de façon autonome.

  • Capacité à travailler en mode agile et à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires.

  • Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles en français et en anglais (équivalent B2/C1 minimum).

  • Bonnes compétences en communication et en organisation.

  • Intérêt pour le paiement et la réglementation financière (KYC, AML).

descriptionHtml:
Wir sind Smart City System, ein innovatives KMU, das sich auf nachhaltige Mobilitätslösungen spezialisiert hat. Wir machen Parkflächen schrankenlos. Kameras erfassen das Kennzeichen bei der Ein- und Ausfahrt, bezahlt wird digital, kontrolliert wird über unsere Software. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2017 ist unser Team auf 43 engagierte Mitarbeiter:innen gewachsen. Gemeinsam haben wir bereits über 94.500 Parkflächen in der DACH-Region sowie in Italien und Polen erfolgreich digitalisiert.

Was uns auszeichnet? Wir bieten eine ganzheitliche IT-Infrastruktur - von individuell entwickelter Hardware bis hin zu leistungsstarker Software.

Unsere Vision: Parken neu denken und eine nachhaltige Mobilität Wirklichkeit werden lassen.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest das Freeflow-Portfolio: die ANPR-Kamera, die Info-Displays Focus und Signature, die LED-Anzeigen und Leitsysteme, den Parkautomaten und unsere zentrale Kundensoftware ParkAgent.

  • Du baust die Roadmap und priorisierst nach Kundennutzen, Umsatz und Aufwand. Dabei bringst du die langen Zyklen der Hardware mit den kurzen Release-Zyklen der Software zusammen.

  • Du holst dir regelmäßig vom Vertrieb ab, wo Deals am Produkt scheitern und was Kunden nach dem Start vermissen, und machst daraus Entscheidungen für die Roadmap.

  • Du gehst zu Kunden, auf Parkflächen und unterstützt bei Supportfällen. Beim Flächenbesitzer mit zehn Dauerparkern genauso wie am Flughafen mit unterschiedlichen Kontingenten.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen, mit denen unsere Hardware-, Firmware- und Softwareentwicklung arbeiten kann, und wägst mit ihr Funktion, Kosten und Zeit gegeneinander ab.

  • Du steuerst den Lebenszyklus der Geräte: neue Generationen, Komponentenwechsel, Firmware-Updates im Feld und Abkündigungen.

  • Du verantwortest die Integrationen mit Handyparken-Apps wie EasyPark und Parkster, mit Automatenanbietern, Enforcement und Halternachverfolgung und entscheidest, welche Partner wir als Nächstes anbinden.

  • Du erarbeitest mit dem Go-to-Market Lead Preise und Pakete, unterstützt den Vertrieb bei Ausschreibungen und bereitest Produkteinführungen mit Marketing und Customer Success vor.

Du berichtest an unseren Go-to-Market Lead Freeflow, der den Bereich mit Vertrieb, Projekt- und Produktmanagement führt. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr dafür, dass unser Produkt bestmöglich zu Flächenbesitzern und Parkraumbewirtschaftern passt. Bei der Umsetzung arbeitest du eng mit unserem Head of TechDev und der Entwicklung zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, davon einen guten Teil mit vernetzter Hardware im Feld plus Software. Wenn du bisher nur Apps oder reine SaaS-Produkte verantwortet hast, passt diese Stelle nicht.

  • Ein technisches Studium, etwa Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder einen vergleichbaren Werdegang.

  • Genug Software-Verständnis, um mit Entwickler:innen über APIs, Datenmodelle und Architektur zu diskutieren und Aufwände realistisch einzuschätzen.

  • Erfahrung damit, was Hardware anders macht: Stücklisten, Lieferzeiten, Komponentenabkündigungen und ein Gerät an einem Standort, das man nicht einfach neu ausrollt.

  • Die Bereitschaft, Prioritäten zu setzen und sie gegenüber Vertrieb, Kunden und Geschäftsführung zu vertreten, auch wenn nicht alle zufrieden sind.

  • Ideal ist Erfahrung mit Kennzeichenerfassung (ANPR/LPR), Videoanalyse oder Parktechnologie. Fehlt dir das, der Rest passt aber, bewirb dich trotzdem. Das Fachwissen bekommst du bei uns.

Benefits

  • Wir sind zwar kein Start-up mehr, sondern können uns stolz als KMU bezeichnen, den ursprünglichen Spirit haben wir aber längst nicht verloren. Du machst bei uns den Unterschied und hast die Möglichkeit dich in deiner Kreativität voll zu entfalten und deine Eigeninitiative aufleben zu lassen.

  • Eine hybride Arbeitswelt mit mobilem Arbeiten und zugleich kreativem Austausch im Office. Du entscheidest was zu dir am besten passt. Zudem kannst du dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel einteilen.

  • Ob Halloween Party, Stadt Rallye oder Schafe hüten, bei unseren zahlreichen Teamevents ist für jeden etwas dabei. Ohne unser Team funktioniert nichts.

  • Mit unseren Corporate-Benefits hast du die Möglichkeit bei vielen Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Branchen Rabatte zu erhalten.

  • Um dich im Alter zu unterstützen bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Ob Windows oder Mac, du entscheidest mit welchem Equipment du ausgestattet werden möchtest.

  • Mit Probonio hast du die Wahl: das Deutschlandticket oder ein monatliches Budget von 50 Euro, das du flexibel einsetzt, sei es für Gutscheine oder für den Urban Sports Club.

  • Du liebst Hunde? Wir auch! Deshalb kannst du deinen 4-Beiner gerne mit ins Office nehmen.

  • It's Time for Yoga! Einmal pro Woche kannst du bei unserer Office-Yoga-Session abschalten, durchatmen und neue Energie tanken - direkt im Büro und gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Produkte, die du anfassen kannst: Kameras, Displays und Automaten aus eigener Entwicklung und über 3.000 Geräte im Feld, deren Daten zeigen, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du hast bei (fast) allen Punkten ein Häkchen gesetzt? Prima!

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen

Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhängige Vergütung motivieren – und der seinen Erfolg selbst mitgestalten will.

Zeig uns, wie du Menschen gewinnst

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein konkretes Beispiel: Wie hast du passende Menschen erreicht, ihr Interesse geweckt und daraus ein Ergebnis entwickelt? Das kann eine Besetzung sein oder – bei deinem Quereinstieg – ein passendes Beispiel aus Vertrieb oder Marketing. Ein Satz dazu reicht für den ersten Schritt. Alles Weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam im Call. Bitte ohne vertrauliche Personen- oder Kundendaten.

Benefits

This step will take around 60 mins.

4. Final Interview

You made it to the very last stage! Here we already strive to cooperate with you and give you an opportunity to meet our leadership team during this informal talk. This step will take around 30 mins.

Thank you for considering the opportunity to be a part of our growing journey. We look forward to the possibility of working together and achieving great things.

Role Description

gravity9 is expanding its Forward Deployed Engineering team to build production agentic AI systems for enterprise clients, in partnership with leading frontier-model providers. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics.

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in the client's environment, from discovery, through architecture and build, to production and handover. This is end-to-end agent engineering, not proofs of concept and not advisory work. Two flavours of engagement:

  • Internal enterprise use cases, such as reconciliation and KYC workflows in financial services, clinical and claims workflows in healthcare, operations and supply-chain workflows in logistics.

  • Product- and customer-facing agents, more greenfield, often exploratory, built into the client's own product.

Engagements are typically a team of engineers over a few months, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client's team including architects, DevOps and QA.

  • Embed with the client. Work hand-in-hand inside the client's environment, codebase and cloud tenancy, often in a hybrid team alongside their engineers. You are visible to the client from day one.

  • Design and build production agentic AI systems. Multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval, planning and routing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state and checkpointing, guardrails, failure handling and recovery.

  • Do the unglamorous data work. A large share of every engagement is data engineering: ingestion, flattening deeply nested structures, extracting content from unstructured documents, classification, summarisation, tagging, enrichment, indexing. Models reason over data, bad data beats a good model every time.

  • Own evaluation and accuracy. Establish a baseline eval dataset at the start of the engagement, automate grading, and track groundedness, faithfulness and retrieval quality per tool, not just at the agent level. Be ready to defend accuracy numbers to a sceptical enterprise stakeholder.

  • Engineer for cost and latency. Model selection and routing (cheaper, faster models for non-reasoning steps; frontier models where reasoning genuinely earns it), prompt and context budgeting, caching. Cost is a non-negotiable metric on every engagement.

  • Ship it properly. Observability and tracing, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring the client can actually operate, security and compliance review.

  • Transfer knowledge deliberately. We don't run a long-term support business. Every engagement is designed so the client owns and can extend the system after we leave. You architect with their team in the room, pair with their engineers, and hand over working monitoring and documentation.


Technical skills

Essential

  • Programming: Strong Python (async, typing, testing, packaging). Working competence in TypeScript / Node is a plus.

  • LLM application engineering: Hands-on production experience with frontier models: prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling, streaming, token and context-window management.

  • Agentic architecture: Built and shipped multi-agent or agentic workflows, planner/router patterns, supervisor and sub-agent designs, ReAct-style loops, state and checkpointing, retries and interrupts, human-in-the-loop review gates.

  • Frameworks: At least one of: Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent orchestration framework, plus the judgement to know when to use none of them.

  • RAG and retrieval: Chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, citation and provenance, natural-language-to-query translation.

  • Data platforms: NoSQL databases such as MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search) or a strong equivalent, plus SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for agent retrieval, not just for OLTP.

  • Data engineering: Building ingestion and enrichment pipelines over messy structured and unstructured sources, documents, PDFs, object storage.

  • Evaluation: Building eval harnesses and eval datasets, LLM-as-judge with its limits understood, regression testing of prompts and agents, metric selection per use case.

  • Cloud: Production delivery on AWS (incl. Bedrock), Azure or GCP, containers, serverless, networking basics, secrets management, IAM.

  • Engineering discipline: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform or equivalent), observability.

Strong advantage

  • Anthropic certification (Claude Developer / Anthropic-issued credential), an explicit advantage at shortlisting.

  • Anthropic Agent SDK production experience, a significant bonus.

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol): building servers and clients, tool exposure, auth patterns.

  • Claude Code as an autonomous SDLC agent: sub-agents, hooks, custom skills, agent marketplaces, context sharing across a team.

  • LLM observability and tracing tooling (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize, Braintrust or similar).

  • Regulated-environment delivery: HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, FCA/PRA, PII handling, data residency, guardrails and red-teaming.

  • Graph or taxonomy-based knowledge representation alongside vector retrieval.

  • Kafka / streaming, Databricks, or comparable large-scale data platform experience.

Nice to have

  • Voice and multimodal agents; evaluation of non-text outputs.

  • FinOps for AI workloads; unit-economics modelling for agent systems.

  • Open-source contribution to the agent / LLM ecosystem, or conference speaking.

  • Prior experience as an FDE, solutions architect, or delivery consultant at a frontier-model, data platform, or infrastructure vendor.

Soft skills

An FDE is an engineer who is safe in front of a client. We screen as hard on this section as on the technical one.

  • Client presence and credibility. Can hold a technical conversation with a client architect and a business conversation with their CTO or head of operations in the same hour, and be trusted by both. Can present, whiteboard, and answer hard questions without deflecting.

  • Translation. Turns a business problem described by non-technical people such as a clinician, campaign manager or supply-chain planner into a technical design, and explains the technical design back in their language.

  • Ego-free collaboration in a supporting role. On some engagements the tech lead will come from the client or a partner, not from us. You need to contribute strongly, disagree well, and take direction without friction. Brilliant-but-territorial doesn't work here.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield. Engagements often start before the requirements, the data access, or sometimes the problem statement are settled. You make progress anyway, and you make the ambiguity visible rather than hiding it.

  • Bias to production. Instinctively asks "how does this get deployed, monitored and maintained?" rather than stopping at a working notebook.

  • Teaching instinct. Actively enjoys upskilling the client's engineers, because self-sufficiency at handover is the definition of success, not follow-on billing.

  • Ownership and pace. Short engagements, small teams, no layers to hide behind. You unblock yourself, chase the access request, and follow the thread to the answer.

  • Commercial awareness. Understands that scope, cost and the client's willingness to pay are part of the engineering problem, and contributes to scoping and estimating honestly.

  • Resilience and adaptability. New client, new domain, new stack every few months; occasional travel; occasionally a sceptical stakeholder who has been told AI is coming for their job. You stay steady and constructive.

  • Written communication. Clear design docs, decision records, handover material and status updates in English. Much of this is asynchronous and cross-timezone.

  • Genuine curiosity about the field. This ecosystem changes monthly. We want people who are already reading, building side projects and forming opinions — not waiting for training to be scheduled for them.

While this is a fully remote position, physical residence in the UK is required.

Experience profile

  • FDE (mid): 3+ years software engineering, 1+ years hands-on LLM / agentic work with at least one system live in production. Client-facing exposure.

  • Senior FDE: 5+ years engineering, 2+ years AI or agentic AI, has owned the architecture of at least one production agent system end-to-end and led a client conversation about it.

  • Lead FDE: 7+ years, has led delivery teams of 3–7 people, can act as engagement tech lead, contributes to pre-sales and estimation, and can mentor a growing FDE bench.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days — owning a meaningful component of a client-facing agent system, including its evals, and trusted in front of the client.

  • 6 months — designing agent architectures independently, leading a workstream, and running the handover and knowledge-transfer track.

  • 12 months — a reference point for others on the team, contributing to reusable assets, pre-sales and interviewing.

What we offer

  • Support for vendor certifications and access to partner training programmes.

  • Company-wide AI tooling as part of how we work day to day.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Productions
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

  • Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

  • Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

  • Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements

  • Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

  • Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

  • Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

  • Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus:

  • Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

  • Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

title: People Partner GTM
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of our teams, hubs, and workflows is growing quickly. Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, organisational design, performance, and day-to-day people guidance.

You'll be the dedicated People Partner for our entire Revenue organisation across North America and LATAM, working closely with the Revenue leadership team to understand their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs deeply. You'll meet proactively with leads and teams, unblock people issues, and help architect the organisation ahead of scale, with Employee Relations and employment counsel on hand when cases need them.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can context-switch quickly, advise with confidence, build trust across functions, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.

You will

  • Act as the dedicated People Partner for Revenue across North America and LATAM, owning the people agenda for the organisation end to end.

  • Partner deeply with the Revenue leadership team to improve team health, performance, talent density, and organizational clarity.

  • Run proactive 1:1 sessions with leads, surfacing issues early and guiding leads through People challenges and change.

  • Lead organisational design for Revenue as it scales, advising on spans and layers, team structures, staffing needs, capability gaps, and succession planning.

  • Support key People programs (performance reviews, engagement, recognition, and lead enablement) for the Revenue org.

  • Collaborate with Employee Relations and employment counsel on investigations, complex performance cases, and early-stage ER issues, escalating at the right time.

  • Identify patterns across teams and regions and turn them into insights, frameworks, or new People initiatives that help us scale smoothly.

  • Partner closely with the Revenue People Partner for International to compare themes and surface them upwards to our CRO.

  • Partner with People Ops & Compliance teams to support terminations, mobility, local requirements, and compliance-heavy workflows across North America and LATAM.

Requirements

  • Experience supporting senior leaders and teams through the full range of people topics: performance, relations, coaching, growth, restructuring, and organizational design.

  • Hands-on organizational design experience, including spans and layers, team structures, and succession planning.

  • Experience guiding leaders and teams through change, such as restructures, team moves, or new ways of working.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness.

  • Comfortable working alongside Employee Relations and employment counsel on sensitive cases.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable owning both strategic partnership and hands-on execution, as the dedicated People Partner for North America and LATAM.

Experience partnering with teams in North America and LATAM, or an understanding of how People practices and employment norms differ across those regions, is a plus.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in on the East Coast USA

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer - Rust (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
🤓 About Luminovo

At Luminovo, we’re building the infrastructure that turns the electronics supply chain into something software can read and act on. Our customers use it to quote PCBAs faster, find cost savings and act on risks in their supply chain.

We serve 300+ customers, from Europe’s largest EMS to category-leading OEMs, with around 100 Luminerds across Munich, Berlin, New York and Austin. We’re backed by Chalfen Ventures, Cherry Ventures and General Catalyst. With data centers and robotics driving demand for electronics, someone needs to manage that supply chain, and they’ll need good software to do it. (Here’s why we care so much about electronics.)

🚀 Your role

Team Core is our platform team. Its job is to make all our other engineering teams more productive and to improve our codebase and infrastructure as a whole. You’ll:

  • Keep our DevOps setup and CI/CD pipelines fast and reliable

  • Build tools every team needs (e.g. interface for building permissions)

  • Act as an in-house Rust expert: our backend is a Rust monolith, and Team Core helps the other teams use good Rust patterns and architecture

  • Be responsible for the Developer Experience (DX).

  • Help our engineers use agents more productively

Other details

  • Location: remote-first, within two hours of CET. We prefer Munich > Berlin > Germany > Europe.

  • Tech stack: Rust, TypeScript + React, Postgres, Clickhouse, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux

  • 🇺🇸 Some of the work in this role falls under US export control regulations (ITAR), so you must be a US citizen. You’ll need to be based in Europe, and if you’re currently in the US, we’ll support your relocation to Germany.

🖲️ Our tech stack

We always try to use the best tools available for the job. Don't worry, we don't need you to be familiar with all of these:

  • Main monolith is written in Rust (using actix-web as our web framework), deployed on Kubernetes

  • React and Typescript for frontend

  • PostgreSQL for persisting our data

  • Redis for caching and queues

  • Flux for GitOps

  • Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring and observability

  • garden-io for developing on Kubernetes

  • Azure and Cloudflare for cloud computing

🤓 Whom you’ll be working with

  • Timon, one of our Founders

  • Alex and Tomas, two of our Staff Engineers

  • Inga, Senior Software Engineer

⚡️ Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

title: Software Engineer: Core
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.


The Team

The Core Team sits at the heart of Constructor, shaping Constructor’s in-house search engine, where user requests meet customer catalogs and Constructor’s learnings. We build and operate the foundational systems that power every request flowing through the platform, enabling fast, reliable, and intelligent interactions at massive scale.

Our systems handle billions of requests daily with exceptional uptime, and we take pride in delivering a highly scalable, resilient, and globally distributed platform. As part of the Core team, you will help design, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure and services that underpin the entire product, ensuring performance, stability, and reliability across the globe.


Requirements

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong foundation in computer science, including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design.

  • Have experience building and scaling high-traffic, high-availability backend systems.

  • Have experience designing and operating backend infrastructure, including deployment automation, capacity planning, and observability.

  • Are comfortable working across different layers of the stack, from performance-critical code to production operations.

  • Enjoy learning new technologies and tools in a fast-moving, large-scale environment.

  • Collaborate effectively and contribute to a positive, ownership-driven team culture.

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages: Rust, C++, Python

  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS

  • CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions

  • Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana


Benefits

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

  • 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • 📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

  • 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Compensation

The base salary for this role starts at $80K+ USD for Mid-level and $90K+ USD for Senior. Your starting salary will depend on your experience, skills, and the level we align on during the interview process.

 

🎯 Experience level: We actively recruitMid-level Engineersand above to support high productivity in our remote-first environment. We are not currently hiring for entry-level or Junior Engineer positions.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Strategic Account Executive, you will own a portfolio of our largest most strategic customers and prospects in Germany, helping them get the most value from GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll break into net new enterprise accounts and expand GitLab’s footprint within existing customers, using a consultative approach to understand their business needs and guide successful adoption and expansion of GitLab. You’ll work closely with pre- and post-sales teams and strategic channel partners to drive full-cycle sales, from prospecting and qualification through rollout, usage, and long-term growth, while acting as the voice of your customers by feeding their feedback and product ideas into GitLab’s public issue tracker.

  • Manage and support GitLab’s Strategic account/(s)
  • Manage the end to end sales process through engagement of appropriate resources such as Solutions Architects, Customer Success Managers, Professional Services, Marketing, Executives, Partners, and the Channel.
  • Leverage solution selling expertise to respond efficiently to customer needs and identify business potential in order to build a strategic, long-term partnership with your customers.
  • Has a deep understanding of the customer, including an understanding of their performance metrics and develops plans in anticipation of the customer’s business strategies and goals.
  • Expand knowledge of industry as well as the competitive posture of the company
  • Contribute to root cause analysis on wins/losses.
  • Communicate lessons learned to the team, including account managers, the marketing team, and the technical team
  • Provide account leadership and direction in the pre- and post-sales process
  • Conduct sales activities including prospecting and developing opportunities in Strategic accounts
  • Ensure the successful rollout and adoption of GitLab products through strong account management activities and coordination with pre-and-post sales engineering and support resources
  • Utilize a consultative approach, discuss business issues with prospect and develop a formal quote, a written sales proposal or a formal sales presentation addressing their business needs.
  • Develop an account plan to sell to customers based on their business needs.

Requirements

  • Experience selling into highly complex organizations
  • Demonstrated consistent results and overachievement of quota
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to C-Level executives.
  • Experience with solutions selling and positioning value to customers based on their needs.
  • Deep understanding of with Git, Software Development Tools, Application Lifecycle Management
  • You share our values, and work in accordance with those values.
  • Ability to use GitLab
  • Ability to travel if needed and comply with the company’s travel policy

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave
