descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Germany.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. 

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities 
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers. 
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap

What makes you a great fit:
  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product 
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors
  • Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope
  • Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation
  • Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 99,945 - EUR 119,934. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

  • Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

  • Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

  • Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the opportunity at Beamery

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Beamery's Data Foundry end to end. The Data Foundry is our proprietary data platform, powering existing and emerging product lines including our Talent CRM and Workforce Suite. Through this, we provide data-as-a-service to customers through channels such as MCP/API. This is an emerging commercial channel. Its core capabilities span the data models, taxonomies and integrations that underpin talent and workforce decisions across our platform.

The Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry will treat data both as infrastructure embedded within our products and as a product that customers buy in its own right. Beyond internal embedding and direct commercial sales, the platform is open — customers and partners can build on top of it through MCP and API access. You will work with product leadership to set the strategy, agree what the platform provides internally, decide what becomes customer-facing, and define how the platform opens up for customer and partner innovation.

You will work at the centre of the platform, creating a balance between two essential initiatives. On one side, you serve the Talent CRM and Workforce Suite product managers as your customers, agreeing the data contracts they build on. On the other, you partner with the data science, data engineering and integrations engineering leads to turn those needs into delivery.

What you will be doing

Ownership and strategy

  • Own the Data Foundry vision, strategy and roadmap, framing each item as a bet with a clear driver, aligned to overall strategic objectives

  • Ensure alignment of Data Foundry strategy to Beamery's AI strategy, reflecting the shift from providing AI assistants to providing AI access through MCP and API channels.

  • Decide what Data Foundry provides as internal infrastructure and what is packaged and sold as a customer-facing product.

  • Make and defend build versus buy decisions across integrations, analytics, AI and taxonomy capabilities.

Discovery and commercial impact

  • Discover and validate what external customers want from data-as-a-service, and partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive adoption with clear GTM and enablement plans

  • Build the case for Data Foundry as a new commercial channel, defining and proving the standalone commercial model alongside its role as platform foundation, quantify the value it unlocks for specific customers and deals, and measure success against value and usage metrics.

Partnership and delivery

  • Lead your team to deliver solutions our customers can’t imagine working without and that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Agree and maintain the data contracts with the CRM and Workforce Suite product managers, treating them as internal customers with real commitments.

  • Prioritise across data science, data engineering and integrations engineering, translating tribe needs into a clear and deliverable plan.

Communication & alignment

  • Communicate transparently and create alignment between peers and leadership on priorities, trade offs and progress

  • Manage customer and sales expectations through well managed structured cadences

Data governance and trust

  • Own how workforce data is governed, secured and access-controlled as it is exposed through APIs and MCP, meeting or exceeding enterprise privacy and compliance expectations.

  • Ensure the outputs of Data Foundry's models are measurable and explainable, so customers and internal teams can trust and act on the results.

What we are looking for

  • A product manager with a minimum 6 years experience in complex technical, data or AI products, a significant portion of which should be in enterprise B2B SaaS.

  • Strong grasp of data platforms, APIs and integrations, comfortable making architecture-adjacent decisions while collaborating with and holding priorities with engineering and data science leads.

  • Experience handling sensitive or regulated data, with a clear view of governance, security and privacy.

  • An analytical thinker who uses data to find opportunities, confidently prioritise and measure success, balancing between competing tribe roadmaps and internal customers.

  • Commercially fluent, experience with 0-1 product stages, shaping early product with new go to market motions, able to connect product decisions to revenue, cost and customer ROI.

  • A clear communicator who builds trust across product, data science and engineering, and who is comfortable taking a position and explaining the reasoning.

  • Experienced owning and delivering AI capabilities, with a keen interest in how AI is reshaping the talent and workforce space, and in giving customers trusted, explainable access to their data.

Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. descriptionHtml:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It’s a role with real ownership, where your decisions matter and you can see their impact directly in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

  • You work with the relevant team members to ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • You will have ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

  • You have ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • You bring several years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

  • You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

This role is based in our Munich or Nuremberg office, with at least 3 days per week on site.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.

  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.

  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

title: Senior Product Manager, Retail
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us define and build purpose-built, highly differentiated shopping experiences across our growing portfolio of Retail categories.


What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Retail Categories team. Retail only wins category by category; a single, generic shopping experience cannot do justice to the unique ways people buy apparel, auto parts, or home improvement goods. This role owns the end-to-end category shopping experience for a defined portfolio, transforming broad customer promises into shipped surfaces and distinct emotional hooks that drive habitual buying behavior.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define Category Strategy: Formulate the category experience strategy and decide which categories and bets to invest in first, sequencing for maximum growth and impact.

  • Execute Signature Product Bets: Translate each category's promise into concrete, testable product bets—such as personal-shopper features using doorstep returns for Apparel or fitment-accurate part lookup for Auto Parts—and ship them end to end.

  • Optimise Category Surfaces: Own the category merchandising and storefront surfaces that differentiate one vertical from another while maintaining a cohesive and intuitive Retail experience.

  • Leverage Platform Capabilities: Partner with shared platform infrastructure (such as doorstep returns or fulfillment) to build bespoke category experiences without rebuilding core infrastructure.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with BD, Sales, Catalog, and Search teams to ensure category surfaces are powered by accurate data and align cleanly with merchant relationships.

  • Measure Impact: Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and directly move the needle on conversion and repeat purchases.


What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Proven Consumer Product Experience: Demonstrated success in product management on consumer-facing products, ideally within e-commerce, marketplaces, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Track Record of 0-to-1 Innovation: Proven ability to ship brand-new or highly differentiated shopping experiences, navigating ambiguity to break broad opportunities into focused, testable bets.

  • Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact.

  • Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy.

  • Customer-Obsessed Product Instinct: A natural intuition for customer behaviour, understanding what makes a shopping experience feel right and how to design the emotional hook that drives retention.

Nice to Have

  • Specialised Retail Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with merchandising, category management, product detail pages (PDP), or specialised shopping flows.

  • Data Structure Familiarity: Experience working alongside Catalog or Search product areas to power front-end surfaces with complex item data.


Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale

    Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast

    Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership

    Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders

    High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create

    Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Regional Marketing Lead - DACH
descriptionHtml:
SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Regional Marketing Lead to own pipeline and ARR growth across DACH.

This is not a traditional field marketing role centred around an events calendar. We’re looking for someone who thinks like a regional growth owner — someone who can connect inbound and outbound campaigns into one engine, understand the full regional marketing mix, and make smart decisions about where to invest budget based on what actually drives pipeline and revenue.

Location: Germany — hybrid or remote

What you will own

Regional pipeline & growth

  • Own the DACH marketing strategy with a clear focus on pipeline generation, revenue influence and ARR growth.

  • Build and run connected inbound and outbound campaigns rather than treating them as separate motions.

  • Own the regional outbound engine, partnering closely with SDR/BDR teams on targeting, messaging, sequences and campaign plays.

  • Build inbound programs across content, nurture, SEO and paid channels to generate and warm demand.

  • Partner with Sales to define and continuously refine target accounts based on ICP fit, intent, engagement and pipeline potential.

  • Use account, intent, firmographic and technographic data to prioritise where to focus.

  • Test new approaches such as multi-threading, trigger-based outreach and intent-led campaigns.

  • Continuously optimise messaging, channels and campaigns based on conversion and pipeline performance.

DACH strategy & budget ownership

  • Act as the regional marketing owner for DACH, bringing local market insight, buyer behaviour and competitive understanding into the wider marketing strategy.

  • Own the DACH marketing budget and decide where investment will have the greatest impact.

  • Move budget towards the channels and activities that are working, rather than defaulting to established ways of working.

  • Use events strategically — including industry events, executive roundtables and customer gatherings — as part of a broader growth strategy, rather than as the strategy itself.

  • Partner with Growth Marketing on paid programs across LinkedIn, retargeting, search and other relevant channels.

  • Work with Customer Marketing and Customer Success to turn DACH customers into references, advocates and case studies that support both new-logo and expansion opportunities.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work closely with Sales and SDR/BDR leadership to align marketing activity with commercial priorities.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Demand Generation to localise global campaigns and messaging for DACH.

  • Work with RevOps to ensure campaign performance, pipeline and revenue data are visible and actionable.

Analytics & optimisation

  • Own reporting across regional pipeline generation, account engagement, conversion and marketing-sourced/influenced revenue.

  • Set regional targets and forecast performance against them.

  • Regularly review performance with Sales and Marketing leadership, clearly identifying where to double down, change direction or stop investing.

  • Take a test-and-learn approach: run structured experiments, measure the results and scale what works.

What you will bring

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, demand generation, growth marketing or a similar role, with proven experience across both inbound and outbound campaigns.

  • A strong track record of generating measurable pipeline and revenue impact, not simply delivering marketing activity.

  • Experience owning a regional go-to-market strategy and turning market insight into a clear plan.

  • Confidence managing and allocating a marketing budget, including making decisions about where to increase or reduce investment based on performance.

  • Strong understanding of B2B buyer journeys, demand generation and the relationship between Marketing, SDR/BDR and Sales.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to understand funnel performance and make commercial decisions.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing and Demand Generation.

  • The confidence to present strategy, performance and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity or another complex B2B sales environment is preferred.

  • A deep understanding of the DACH market, including local buyer behaviour and business culture.

  • Fluent German and English

AI fluency

AI is part of how we work at SoSafe, and we expect everyone to be comfortable using AI to improve how they work. tools and confidence experimenting with them to make your work faster and better.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ABM concepts such as account tiering, account-level personalisation and intent-based targeting.

  • Experience marketing into cybersecurity, public sector or other regulated industries in DACH.


What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

You will partner with the EMEA Central Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, Berlin, Munich, or Hamburg, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.

What Will You Do?

  • Serve as the EMEA Central Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.
  • Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.
  • Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. title: Senior Security Engineer - SecOps
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

Mozilla is looking for an Incident Responder to monitor and mitigate attacks across Mozilla’s products and services. In this position, you will be a part of a flexible team responsible for handling security incidents. As such, you’ll need to have years of practical security experience and knowledge of the state of the art for detecting and responding to attacks. You’ll be someone Mozillians across the company depend on and trust to respond quickly and effectively in a crunch, with the outstanding communication and collaboration skills needed to work in partnership with diverse stakeholders. Most importantly, you will become a critical member of the team responsible for ensuring the integrity of Mozilla’s products and for keeping Mozilla’s users safe, within a company dedicated to building a more secure internet.

What you'll do:
  • Identify and respond to security incidents on a global scale.
  • Act as an incident commander to drive incidents through the entire response lifecycle.
  • Design and maintain a portfolio of security alerts, automated actions, playbooks and escalation workflows in support of a high-performing 24/7 incident response capability.
  • Conduct threat hunting activities, anticipate future threats, and maintain forward-thinking strategies for tools/technology/processes that combat sophisticated threat actors.
  • Research threat intelligence reports, triage and manage resulting workflows.
  • Partner with key stakeholders and communicate effectively to maintain a continuously improving feedback loop of preparation, identification, analysis, containment, and post mortem activities.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.
What you'll bring:
  • 5+ years of demonstrated ability managing security incidents at a global scale and/or experience working in Security Operations Centers (SOC), Product Security Incident Response Teams (PSIRT), and Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRT).
  • Expertise with security information and event management (SIEM) systems (eg. ELK, Google BigQuery, Splunk, etc.). Splunk proficiency is preferred.
  • Expertise with endpoint detection and investigation. Hands-on experience with leading EDR tools and demonstrated ability to leverage endpoint telemetry to find root cause.
  • Expertise with security orchestration and automation (SOAR) platforms such as Tines or Splunk SOAR.
  • Superb communication and leadership capacity; ability to partner effectively with diverse company stakeholders.
  • Real-world experience in software development and/or engineering operations for consumer products and services; B.S. in a technology-focused field is helpful.
  • Practical experience working with cloud technologies (eg. Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Heroku, Microsoft Azure, etc.).
Competencies:
  • Ownership and Accountability
  • Autonomy
  • High Level of Integrity
  • Clear Communication
  • Creative Problem Solver
  • Passionate about Security

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

title: Senior Social Commerce Strategist (Permanent)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior Social Commerce Strategist needed to join our Global Social Commerce Team on a permanent basis.

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Social Commerce Strategist to join our Global Social Commerce Team. This is a senior role for someone who thinks like an operator as much as a strategist: you will own the strategic and commercial thinking behind how some of the world’s biggest brands build, launch, trade and scale on social – with TikTok Shop at the centre – and you will be accountable for the quality of that thinking in front of senior clients. 

You will translate client business objectives into social commerce strategies that hold up commercially: channel economics that work, forecasts that are defensible, measurement that proves incrementality, and operating models that can be exported market to market. You will be the connective tissue between strategy, creative, media, data and platform partners – and the person clients call when they need a point of view on where social commerce goes next. 

You will also lead people: line-managing a small team of strategists, setting the standard for the craft, and raising the commercial literacy of everyone around you. Depth across the social platforms and their commerce ecosystems – TikTok Shop above all, alongside Meta, YouTube and emerging AI-led discovery – is essential. 

What you’ll be doing: 

Commercial strategy & value creation 

Channel Economics & Business Case: Build and own the commercial case for social commerce investment – channel P&L modelling, unit economics (COGS, commission, fulfilment, returns, promotional depth), contribution margin and payback – so recommendations are grounded in what actually makes money for the client. 

Trading & Forecasting: Set and pressure-test the numbers behind the plan: GMV, AOV, conversion, basket and attach rate, CAC, ROAS/MER and repeat rate. Build forecasts and scenario models across always-on trading, LIVE, affiliate and peak moments, and diagnose performance against them. 

Investment & Mix Strategy: Advise clients on where budget works hardest across paid, organic, affiliate/creator and platform tooling (GMV Max, Spark Ads, retail media), making the trade-offs explicit – including what to stop doing. 

Margin & Pricing Discipline: Protect client margin as volume scales – promotional architecture, discount dependency, bundling and pack strategy, and repeat-purchase mechanics. 

Strategic leadership 

Channel & Category Strategy: Develop social commerce strategies aligned to client business objectives and category dynamics – defining role of channel, audience and demand strategy, portfolio and SKU selection, and the route from discovery to conversion. 

Operating Model & Market Expansion: Design the operating model that makes the strategy deliverable – crawl/walk/run sequencing, roles and responsibilities across client, agency and platform partners, governance, and blueprints that export into new markets rather than being rebuilt each time. 

Launch & Commerce Readiness: Own the go-to-market gate: fulfilment and 3PL models, dispatch SLAs, customer service, returns and Shop Health – ensuring commercial ambition is matched by operational readiness. 

Paid & Organic Integration: Build strategies that unify paid, organic, creator and affiliate activity into a single commercial system rather than parallel channels with separate objectives. 

Content & Creator Strategy: Work with client editorial, creative and marketing teams to define content-to-cart strategies, creator and affiliate programmes (including commission architecture and creator economics), and LIVE formats that convert. 

Platform & Ecosystem Expertise: Maintain authoritative depth across TikTok Shop, Meta, YouTube and emerging social and AI-led commerce surfaces – including partner ecosystems, betas and platform roadmaps – and translate it into first-mover advantage for clients. 

Client & business leadership 

Senior Client Counsel: Act as trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders up to Marketing Director, Commercial Director and GM level – as credible in a commercial conversation as a creative one, and able to disagree well when the data says so. 

Scoping & Commercial Shaping of Work: Interrogate and shape briefs, define scope and approach, input into resourcing, estimates and statements of work, and ensure what we sell is what we can brilliantly deliver. 

Growth & New Business: Identify and shape opportunities to extend the work – new markets, brands and workstreams – and bring senior strategic firepower to pitches, RFPs and capability sessions. 

Presentation & Persuasion: Build and deliver arguments that land in the room – clear narrative, sharp commercial framing, and the confidence to present to senior executives and defend the recommendation. 

Thought Leadership: Develop points of view, frameworks and IP that position VML as the leading end-to-end social commerce partner, and represent the agency externally with clients, platforms and at industry events. 

Team & delivery leadership 

People Leadership: Line-manage and develop a small team of strategists – setting objectives, coaching, reviewing work, and raising the commercial literacy and craft standard across the team. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead multi-discipline pods across creative, media, data, technology and delivery, ensuring social commerce strategy is integrated with the wider marketing and commerce agenda. 

Delivery Accountability: Lead projects end to end – on time, on budget and to the standard we want to be judged by – managing dependencies, risk and scope in a fast-moving environment. 

Client Location Work: Willingness to work at client locations and travel to key markets as the work requires. 

What we want from you: 

  • Substantial experience in social, digital or commerce strategy – typically 7+ years, with meaningful time spent on social commerce specifically, agency or brand side. 
  • Genuine commercial fluency: comfortable building and defending a channel P&L, unit economics and a forecast, and as confident in a model as in a deck. 
  • Demonstrable experience setting KPIs and being held to them – you have owned the performance of a channel or programme, not just the plan for it. 
  • Deep, current expertise across social platforms and their commerce ecosystems, with hands-on TikTok Shop experience (Seller Centre, Affiliate Centre, GMV Max, LIVE, Shop Health) strongly preferred, alongside Meta. 
  • Experience designing operating models and launching or scaling a social commerce programme, ideally across more than one market. 
  • Experience line-managing or formally mentoring strategists, and raising the standard of a team rather than only your own output. 
  • Track record with global brands and senior client stakeholders, leading workstreams independently and owning relationships at a senior level. 
  • Experience in consumer packaged goods or a related sector (personal care, household, food & beverage) is highly desirable – including the realities of regulatory constraints, retailer relationships, brand reputation and margin pressure. 
  • Strong measurement and analytical instincts: able to interrogate data, find the story, and be honest about what a number does and does not prove. 
  • Excellent presentation and written communication skills, making complex commercial and technical concepts land with non-specialist audiences. 
  • Proven ability to digest, interpret and respond to briefs at pace, and to bring structure to ambiguity. 
  • Consultative, pragmatic and creative – sees challenges as opportunities and brings solutions, not just analysis. 
  • Customer-first mindset, with the maturity, judgement and initiative expected of a senior member of the team. 
  • Degree qualified, ideally in Marketing, Business, Economics, Communications or a related field (subject specific is not essential). 
  • Passionate about social, commerce and the possibilities of reinventing how people discover and buy. 

If you know this, even better: 

  • Experience with retail media and marketplace channels (Amazon, Tesco and other grocers) and how they coexist with social commerce. 
  • Experience with social listening and analytics platforms (Sprinklr, Brandwatch, NetBase Quid, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics). 
  • Experience with social advertising and commerce platforms (TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GMV Max) and affiliate or creator management tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of ecommerce and fulfilment infrastructure – Shopify, Commercetools, 3PL models and the operational realities behind them. 
  • Experience with influencer and creator marketing, including commercial models and contracting. 
  • Understanding of search, SEO and emerging AI-led discovery and agentic commerce. 
  • Experience with structured test-and-learn programmes, A/B testing and optimisation. 
  • Multi-market or multi-language experience across EMEA. 
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a senior team. 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only:
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

How we use AI in the recruitment process:
 
To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact  the outcome of the interview process" 

At  WPP Enterprise Solutions

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernisation, connecting strategy directly to execution.  

Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX, work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. We have received distinction as a leader in Commerce Services and CX Strategy Consulting by the Forrester Wave™  

To find out more, visit enterprisesolutions.wpp.com and follow us on LinkedIn. 

WPP Enterprise Solutions is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. descriptionHtml:
About Octopus Electroverse

We’re making electric vehicle ownership as smart and as simple as possible, by building the giant, virtual charging platform of the future.

In just five years, Octopus Electroverse has grown to become one of the largest eMobility players globally, with over 1,400,000 connected electric vehicle chargers and a customer ecosystem spanning web, iOS, Android, CarPlay, Android Auto & Automotive OS, and more.

But it’s just the start: we’re busy expanding internationally, working with more automotive and tech partners, building exciting new features at scale, and creating the integrated charging experiences of the future. We are working to make public EV charging simple across multiple customer bases, including whitelabel app users, EV business fleets, new international markets and our flagship consumer offering.

Electroverse is a multifunctional team made up of product, development, commercial, operations, marketing, partnerships teams, and more - all focused together on making Octopus the go-to name in EV charging. And we’re looking for smart individuals with an interest in the space who can help us make it happen.

About the role

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about code, curious, and eager to learn. You’ll be working alongside the backend team that provides services for our Electroverse ecosystem in the electric vehicle and electrification space with focus on helping develop the core functionality of our business. As our business grows, we’re looking to build commercial stability whilst ensuring robust, transparent and competitive pricing for our customers. You’ll help us develop discounting solutions, monitor financial patterns, and consistently and reliably deliver value.

We’re open to the level you’re applying on, if you don’t feel like a Senior Engineer yet, but you tick all the boxes, we’ll definitely consider your application.

Our project is establishing itself as the leading e-mobility provider solution within the industry and we want to take it to the next level. This means we're working on big features which will give you the chance to have a huge impact and, given our ambitions in the electrification space, influence how the back-end scales to meet new challenges and create a wider ecosystem.

Overall, you'll work with a small, high-energy project team to bring the product to life - an exciting opportunity to work like a start-up within a rapidly scaling EnTech business.


What you'll do

  • Help us improve the core product by developing and improving our pricing and discount mechanisms.

  • Help improving the accuracy of our financial reporting and payment success rates across our existing and potential payment providers

  • Expand existing charging subscription offering to add flexibility and scalability

  • Work within a small specialized team to enable multiple cross functional product areas and delivery best quality for our customers

  • Support the Operations team in resolving payments related customer issues, and the Financial team in building accurate reporting systems


    • What you'll need

  • 3+ years software experience, preferably with Django or similar Python frameworks

  • Experience with monitoring and debugging applications and infrastructure

  • Experience maintaining asynchronous processing systems (AMQP, Celery)

  • An ability to discuss vision and features within a team and propose creative solutions

  • Knowledge of common security practices

  • Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous deployment

  • An ability to write robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Proficient understanding of Git


    • It would be great if you have

  • Experience with subscriptions and recurring payments

  • Experience with billing and invoicing flows

  • Experience working on commercials, pricing and tax within an international context

  • Experience with KYC/KYB products and flows

    • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! descriptionHtml:
ConnectWise is an industry and Global leading software company with over 3,000 colleagues in North America, EMEA and APAC. As a community-driven software company dedicated to the success of technology solution providers, our suite helps over 45,000 of our partners manage their businesses better, sell more efficiently, automate service delivery, and remotely control technology so they can consistently deliver amazing customer experiences.

Our company is powered by our connections, our colleagues, and our community. And, we accept all kinds.

Game-changers, innovators, culture-lovers—and humankind.

We see you and value you for your unique contributions. Our inclusive, positive culture lays the foundation to ensure every colleague is valued for their perspectives and skills, giving you the choice of how YOU make a difference.

Curious? Read this opportunity to learn how YOU can make a difference at ConnectWise!

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer 

Job Function: Engineering Position 

Type: Full-Time 

Job Family: Software Engineering 

Team: AI Agents 

Location: United Kingdom 

General Summary 

The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, building and operating the software that powers AI agents across the ConnectWise platform. Working within the AI Agents team, this role applies strong software engineering fundamentals to integrate large language models, tools and data into reliable, secure and scalable production services that deliver thoughtful experiences for our partners. This role works in partnership with ML engineers, product managers and platform teams to bring agentic capabilities from prototype to production. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities 

  • Designs, develops, tests and maintains backend services and APIs that power AI agents and LLM-based features. 
  • Builds agent capabilities such as tool and function calling, workflow orchestration, memory and context management, and integrations with internal and third-party systems. 
  • Implements retrieval-augmented generation components, including data ingestion, embeddings, vector search and prompt pipelines. 
  • Contributes to evaluation, testing and observability of agents, including automated tests, eval harnesses, logging, tracing and monitoring. 
  • Ensures production readiness of services through performance tuning, reliability engineering, security and cost optimization. 
  • Participates in design reviews and code reviews, and upholds engineering best practices and standards. 
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into well-scoped technical deliverables. 
  • Mentors junior engineers and shares knowledge across the team. 
  • Researches new tools, frameworks and techniques in the AI agent space and documents findings. 

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities Required 

  • Ability to work independently on features and projects with limited supervision. 
  • Strong programming skills in Python, working knowledge of another language (e.g. TypeScript, Java, Go or C#) is a plus. 
  • Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented and service-oriented design, and testing. 
  • Experience building RESTful or gRPC APIs and microservices, with frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask or similar. 
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock) and agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or similar. 
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases and prompt engineering; awareness of protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus. 
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Proficient in SQL and comfortable working with relational and NoSQL data stores. 
  • Knowledge of at least one cloud platform (e.g. AWS or Azure) and its relevant services. 
  • Proficiency in version control systems such as Git. 
  • Ability to break down and communicate technical concepts clearly to audiences of varying technical understanding. 

Educational/Vocational/Previous Experience Recommendations 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. 
  • 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience. 
  • Experience building and shipping production software on cloud computing platforms. 
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications or AI agents is strongly preferred. 
  • Experience deploying, monitoring and iterating services in production. 

Working Conditions 

  • Onsite/Hybrid/Remote depending on location 
  • 0-10% travel may be required

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

Solutions Architects are vital members of our project teams, often serving as the initial technical point of contact for our customers and key technical stakeholders for a successful deployment of Celonis. To ensure our customers achieve value, you will drive the technical setup required to leverage the full range of Celonis features and functionalities, including process mining, execution management, process automation, Action Flow, and task mining.

Given the unique nature of every customer environment, you will be the key liaison for translating the customer's technical requirements to ensure successful deployment on the clients infrastructure and successful integrations with their source systems. Furthermore, you will lead discussions on user management and authentication, acting as a technical partner to remove any technical barriers to user adoption.

The work you’ll do:

  • On Celonis side you are the key technical stakeholder for a successful technical delivery and onboarding of Celonis for enterprise clients.
  • Lead technical discussions to analyze customer architecture, recommend optimal solutions, and facilitate deployment, managing expectations amidst technical constraints.
  • Remove technical obstacles to maximize Celonis user adoption, clarifying technical risks and necessary tradeoffs.
  • Promote reusability by choosing between dedicated customer solutions and broader platform enhancements in collaboration with Celonis product development.
  • Establish real-time data integrations between customer systems and Celonis via APIs and internal tools.
  • Guide customers on authentication, user/group management, and provisioning best practices. Thus, removing all technical barriers to drive user adoption of Celonis.

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven experience of 5+ years, with at least 3 years in deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes.
  • Advanced knowledge with at least one specific Kubernetes distribution (Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, RedHat OpenShift, etc.).
  • Eligibility for UK Security Check (SC) clearance is required; existing clearance is a strong advantage.
  • Very good understanding of best practices in deploying, scaling, and maintaining highly available, secure and resilient containerized applications on Kubernetes, ensuring efficient resource utilization and operational stability. 
  • Proven experience implementing infrastructure as code (IaC, e.g. with Terraform) is required; Helm or Kustomize experience is strongly preferred. Fluency with additional tools such as ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, etc., is a plus.
  • Experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) would be a plus.
  • Experience in industry with experience to work on Python, SQL, data pipelines & ETL processes for large volumes of data is a plus.
  • Knowledgeable about security and compliance topics for enterprise applications.Solid experience with project management, outstanding customer-centric & proven experience working with customers.
  • A solution-oriented professional that enjoys deep technical discussions as much as transferring your technical knowledge into understandable terms to a broader audience

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

  • Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

  • Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

descriptionHtml:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. Senior SRE - Networks

Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity.  Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously!

We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better.

  • Mentor team members on the complexities of global routing, especially in an anycast-heavy environment.

  • Experience in the protocols and practices that make up the fabric of the global internet, including TCP/IP, BGP, Anycast and DNS.

  • Experience in Automation and coding using languages like Python, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Tier 1 Internet service providers, Internet exchanges and cloud providers.

  • Ability to analyze internet traffic patterns across multiple dimensions using flow-based tools.

  • Experience working with alerting, monitoring and visibility tools (such as Graphite/Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk).

  • Knowledge across cloud hosting solutions (i.e., GCP, AWS and Azure).

  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI / CD pipelines (ie. Git, Jenkins, Ansible).

  • Understanding of Linux/Unix systems administration and network stack optimisation.

  • Adept at knowledge sharing and creating comprehensive documentation to empower teams.

  • Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives to optimize automation tooling and the network.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

  • Experience writing production-level code using VCL or GO

  • Experience in network telemetry including instrumenting infrastructure and collecting, processing, storing and analyzing data

  • Experience working with geographically dispersed teams: previous remote work preferred

Work Hours: 

  • This position will require you to work during scheduled hours from 0800 - 1700.

  • This position will require you to be available during core business hours. 

  • It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager. 

This position has one opening and can be hired in the following locations:

  • London (Hybrid)

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

About the team

The Enterprise Business team partners with some of the most sophisticated and high-potential businesses in the world, helping them leverage Airwallex’s products to scale globally. You’ll combine deep technical understanding of APIs and payment flows with strong stakeholder management skills – from hands‑on engineers through to senior commercial leaders.

  • Evidence of a commercial mindset – comfortable partnering with sales and account management teams to identify and shape upsell and cross‑sell opportunities.
