title: Technicien Qualité Production (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Le travail en équipe, l’épanouissement personnel et professionnel au travail sont des valeurs importantes pour vous ?

Vous êtes à la recherche de sens et de challenges professionnels ?

Rejoignez-nous !

JACIR - société du groupe COFINAIR qui regroupe 4 sites production en France, en Allemagne et en Italie, 290 personnes pour 70M€ CA – se positionne aujourd’hui comme le partenaire incontournable Européen en proposant des technologies innovantes de refroidissement évaporatif respectueuses de l’environnement : design, fabrication, commercialisation, services dédiés aux tours de refroidissement et refroidisseurs adiabatiques pour l’industrie et le tertiaire.

Son expansion amène JACIR à recruter pour son site de Martin Eglise :

Vos missions

Missions :

Le Technicien Qualité Production veille à la conformité des produits fabriqués et au respect des exigences qualité tout au long du processus de production.

Présent sur le terrain, il accompagne les équipes dans le suivi de la qualité, identifie les éventuelles non-conformités et contribue à la mise en place d’actions correctives afin de garantir la conformité des produits et l’amélioration continue des processus.

  • Vérifier la bonne application des plans, dossiers de fabrication, gammes, procédures et instructions de travail.
  • Contrôler la qualité des produits tout au long du processus de production.
  • Identifier, signaler et traiter les non-conformités internes.
  • Participer à l’analyse des causes et à la définition des actions correctives et préventives.
  • Identifier les dérives de process et proposer les actions correctives adaptées.
  • Sensibiliser et accompagner les opérateurs aux exigences et bonnes pratiques qualité.
  • Participer aux réunions quotidiennes de production.
  • Valider les autorisations de libération des produits.
  • Réaliser des audits de poste et des audits de processus en production.
  • Suivre la mise en œuvre des actions définies et vérifier leur efficacité.
  • Alerter en cas de dérive ou de risque pouvant affecter la conformité des produits.
  • Participer, lorsque nécessaire, aux échanges avec les fournisseurs, sous-traitants et clients.

Vos compétences

Vos atouts :

  • Formation Bac +2/3 dans le domaine de la qualité (BTS/DUT Qualité, Licence Professionnelle Qualité ou équivalent).
  • Une expérience de 2 à 5 ans dans un environnement industriel, idéalement dans le secteur de la métallurgie.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes et techniques de résolution de problèmes.
  • La maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel est nécessaire pour évoluer dans un groupe européen.

Avantages

Nous vous offrons :

Un programme de formation à nos produits et services et sensibilisation à nos procédures QSE sera mis en place.

Rejoindre un groupe industriel européen en croissance.

Conditions et avantages sociaux suivants : Mutuelle Santé / Prévoyance prise en charge 70% par l’employeur

CSE (Chèques cadeaux, chèques vacances, évènements collectifs)

Intéressement aux résultats collectifs

RTT + jours offerts

Participation aux frais de transport

Charte Télétravail en place

Prise de poste : Dès que possible

Vous intégrerez une entreprise attachée à une culture QHSE forte, où chaque collaborateur est acteur de la sécurité, de la qualité et du respect de l’environnement.

JACIR s'engage à garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous nos candidats en valorisant la diversité et l'inclusion. Nous nous efforçons de recruter des talents variés qui enrichissent notre équipe et favorisent un environnement de travail respectueux et collaboratif.

title: Technischer Projektleiter TGA (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

title: Treasury Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Role

Taptap Send is seeking a highly organised and motivated individual to join our Treasury Operations team and help us grow our business. In this role, you will report to the Director of Payments and touch all aspects of Taptap Send's payment operations, with an initial focus on stablecoin funding, working directly with our teams and partners across the world.

You'll own the full life cycle of payments, including creating, tracking and confirming crediting of funds, as well as troubleshooting payment issues across our growing Stablecoin operations. You'll also be involved in funding forecasts to ensure that our partners are well funded at all times.

You'll work directly with our trading team as well as collaborating with the wider team that spans the globe ( London, Abidjan, Lagos, Nairobi, Paris and New York, to name a few places), ensuring that Taptap Send is effectively supported in its growth and customer ambitions! There is plenty of room for professional progression and personal growth within our friendly and ever-growing Taptap community.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively managing treasury operations, initially for stablecoins, to ensure our accounts are funded and payments can be processed seamlessly

  • Working closely with partners to ensure that funding timelines are being delivered on time

  • Troubleshooting to find root causes of payment issues and working with internal and external partners to resolve

  • Assisting with onboarding new banks and trading partners for stablecoin, working closely with our business development team

  • Providing out-of-hours coverage when required

Requirements

  • Have at least 1 years’ experience, ideally in a payments or funding role and/or working with stablecoins

  • Are passionate about our mission and eager to do what needs to be done to achieve it

  • Are enthusiastic about treasury operations, solving unique problems, and optimizing processes

  • Enjoy challenges, are resourceful and think outside the box to find creative ways to tackle problems

  • Love working in teams and building meaningful relationships with key stakeholders

  • Don’t hesitate to place a call to promptly resolve issues or persevere to get a result

  • Have great organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a fast-paced startup environment where no two days are the same

  • Have proven analytical skills (Excel); SQL a plus

  • Are proficient in English

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

 

Taptap Values

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

 

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Vehicle Integration Technician
descriptionHtml:
At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade.

Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now.

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it.

 

About the Role

The Vehicle Integration Technician builds, installs, tests, and repairs the hardware used to retrofit industrial vehicles with Hive autonomy systems.

The technician works closely with integration engineers and helps turn first-of-kind engineering designs into safe, repeatable installations.

  • Ability to read electrical schematics and mechanical drawings.

  • Experience using multimeters, power supplies, hand tools, and standard workshop equipment.

  • Basic understanding of CAN wiring and vehicle electrical systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and workmanship.

title: Venture Development Intern
descriptionHtml:

Internship, 3–6 months · Full-time

About FastLeap Partners

FastLeap Partners is a company builder and investment firm headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with portfolio companies mainly operating in Germany. It is backed by a small group of entrepreneurs and family offices from Germany and Switzerland with successful entrepreneurial track records. The firm has launched several ventures in sectors including HR, FinTech and EdTech – all cash-flow-driven and built with AI as their core foundation from day one.

About the internship

FastLeap Partners launches and scales several companies in parallel, from the first validation of a business model to an operating company with its own team. As a Venture Development Intern, you work at both ends of this process: you assess which new business models FastLeap Partners should pursue and launch next, and you help our portfolio companies tackle critical operational bottlenecks that constrain their growth.

You work as the right hand of the founder of FastLeap Partners and collaborate closely with the founders and teams of our portfolio companies. From day one, you are given a high degree of responsibility. You will take ownership of projects with a direct impact on the business success of FastLeap Partners and its portfolio companies.

Your responsibilities

Evaluating new business models

  • Validate business models through market research and customer development, including conversations with potential customers and partners.

  • Develop business cases and translate your findings into a clear recommendation: pursue, adapt or discontinue.

  • Build the talent pipeline: help assemble founding teams for new ventures and identify and engage early employees for the portfolio.

Supporting our portfolio companies

  • Take on critical operational projects across the ventures – from coordinating sales campaigns and product launches to sourcing and evaluating potential partners and drafting customer contracts.

  • Keep track of open items across the ventures and follow up with the teams until they are resolved.

  • Design and implement AI-driven tools and workflows that automate recurring processes and allow the ventures to scale without adding complexity.

Who you are

  • A clear communicator. You write and speak clearly and precisely, and you present your results convincingly to founders and the leadership team.

  • Structured. You maintain an overview of several topics at once and reliably drive open items to resolution.

  • Focused on execution. You recognize what matters most at any given time and see it through to completion.

  • Curious and grounded. You ask the right questions, learn quickly and seek to understand a business before forming an opinion.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools as an integral part of your daily work and continuously look for ways to work more effectively with them.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field, ideally in an advanced semester.

  • First experience in fast-paced environments close to the center of an ambitious organization, for example through internships in startups, venture capital, consulting, banking or private equity, or through a project you founded yourself. What you have done matters much more to us than any single logo or pedigree.

  • Ideally, you have already contributed early at a startup or high-growth company, with results you can point to.

  • High-agency: you take initiative instead of waiting for instructions, take ownership of problems that nobody has been assigned to yet, and find a way forward when there is no established playbook.

  • Strong analytical skills and confident in working with spreadsheets and presentations.

  • A genuine interest in building companies and the ambition to grow with FastLeap, ideally up to founding a venture of your own.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Available full-time for at least three months, ideally longer.

What we offer

  • Entrepreneurship: Real responsibility from your first week and the opportunity to help launch and scale AI-native businesses.

  • Learning: Direct involvement in the operations of a company builder with several ventures live across industries and a pipeline of new ones.

  • Top-tier network: Work alongside and learn from an experienced team of serial founders. Connect with top-tier operators, investors and angels, including several unicorn founders.

  • Compensation: A highly attractive internship salary.

  • Remote: Fully remote (incl. budget to rent your own working space), with regular in-person meetings with the management team and occasional travel to the ventures.

  • Next step: The prospect of a full-time role at FastLeap or a leadership position in one of its portfolio companies.

Our process consists of a first call, a short practical case and a final conversation with the leadership team, and can be completed within one week. We look forward to your application.

title: Video Producer / Editor
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As our Video Producer / Editor, you bring Vesoma's humanoid robots and the work behind them to life on screen.  You turn product demonstrations and technical progress into films with exceptional craft: technically credible, visually distinctive, and immediately understandable. Your work helps industrial customers see real capability, while building trust, recognition and desirability with a much broader global audience.

You lead video production end-to-end across our robot labs and representative work environments, from planning and set building to lighting to shooting, editing and final delivery. Working hands-on alongside our engineers and in close partnership with marketing, design, product and commercial, you capture our robots performing useful, real-world tasks. Creating world-class content from product videos, customer demos and social content to events, sales material and investor communications.

Key responsibilities

Creative Production

  • Own video production end-to-end, from treatments and shot planning through camera, lighting and audio to editing, motion graphics, colour, sound and final delivery.

  • Develop story, concepts, scripts, storyboards and visual treatments in close collaboration with marketing, design and product, bringing strong filmmaking judgement to scene composition, lens, light, palette, style and framing within Vesoma’s brand strategy and visual system.

  • Work hands-on in our robot labs and test areas alongside engineers, capturing product progress as it happens while maintaining a consistently high production bar.

Product Demonstrations

  • Work with product, commercial and engineering to turn customer use cases and robot capabilities into clear, credible demonstrations.

  • Help shape representative customer and demo environments with product, design, engineering and production partners, from layouts, fixtures and backdrops to lighting and scene setup.

  • Ensure everything we show accurately reflects the robot’s capabilities and the technical work behind them, while building trust with industrial customers and a broader global audience.

Content, Channels & Operations

  • Work closely with the management team, marketing, design, product and engineering teams to align content priorities, quality standards and stakeholder expectations.

  • Brief and manage agencies, freelancers, set builders and specialist crew when needed

  • Create product videos, customer demos, founder interviews & press materials, test footage, social content, event and trade-show material, sales assets, investor updates and employer-brand content.

  • Adapt content for different audiences and channels, from customer-facing films to LinkedIn, press materials, YouTube and other public platforms.

  • Build and maintain a secure, well-organised and searchable footage library across Munich and Limassol.

Your profile

We are looking for a hands-on filmmaker with exceptional visual judgement, strong technical curiosity and the ability to make complex technology clear, credible and compelling.

Experience

  • 5+ years of professional video production, filmmaking and/or editing experience.

  • A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating exceptional craft, ideally across technology, product, automotive, consumer electronics, industrial or similarly demanding work.

  • Demonstrated ownership of productions from pre-production and filming through post-production and final delivery.

Core skills

  • Production: Strong camera, lighting and audio skills, from fast-moving lab shoots to controlled product and studio setups.

  • Post-production: Advanced editing in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with strong motion graphics, colour and sound capabilities.

  • Storytelling: Strong instincts for story, pacing and structure, with the ability to turn technical progress and real product capability into films people understand and remember.

  • Visual judgement: A sharp eye for composition, movement, light and detail, and the filmmaking judgement to contribute confidently to concepts, storyboards and visual treatments.

  • Technical collaboration: Comfortable working hands-on with engineers, robots and unfinished hardware, while collaborating closely across marketing, design, product and commercial.

  • Execution: Able to manage and navigate quickly between multiple productions from brief, scripts, storyboard and shot lists all the way to shoot logistics & final delivery without lowering the quality bar.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience filming robotics, automotive, consumer electronics, hardware or  industrial technology.

  • Still photography, 3D animation or product visualisation skills in Blender, Cinema 4D or similar.

  • Experience with drone & gimbal, sets, physical environments or product-demo productions.

  • Fluency with modern AI tools across image, video, audio and post-production.

  • German language skills (for Munich)

Mindset

You move at startup speed and care equally about craft and technical truth. You earn trust with highly technical teams, think deeply about customers and audiences, and combine strong creative judgement with hands-on execution. You see the story in a test run, bring order to a messy production environment, and make the robot look its best without overstating what it can do.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Visual Designer (Events, Print & Campaign)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

About the role

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own how Omnea shows up in the physical world and across marketing campaigns. You'll lead design for events, print and traditional media, and presentations, and support Marketing with graphic design for campaigns, content and paid ads.

Omnea now runs roughly one event every three days, across London, New York and beyond. You'll bring it in-house, raise the quality bar and build the foundations (templates, asset libraries, print specs) so every event doesn't start from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Founding Visual Designer, who owns digital (website, animations, product assets), building on a brand direction that's already set. Together you'll keep the brand consistent everywhere, from a product launch page to a booth at an industry summit, and help it evolve as we grow, pushing it into new formats, spaces and campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll take briefs from Marketing and Events, shape them, push back where needed, and see them through to production.

What you'll do

Events

  • Design event assets end to end: booths, roll-ups, signage, badges, invites, menus, stage visuals and merchandise.

  • Partner with the Events team on our own events (like our Annual Summit in New York), industry conferences and customer dinners.

  • Build and maintain an event asset library and templates, including a self-serve starter kit so colleagues running smaller events stay on brand without a designer.

Print and traditional media

  • Design print collateral and out-of-home or traditional media placements.

  • Prepare print-ready files and work with printers and suppliers on production, quality and deadlines.

Marketing and campaign design

  • Create graphic design for campaigns, paid ads, social and content, working closely with Marketing and Product Marketing.

  • Support product launches with campaign assets, in partnership with the digital Visual Designer.

  • Help Marketing self-serve by growing our brand asset bank and templates.

Presentations

  • Design high-impact decks for events, keynotes, webinars, sales and leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve our slide templates so teams can build on-brand decks themselves.

  • Turn rough content into clear, well-structured presentations.

Brand

  • Apply and extend our new brand system across print and physical formats.

  • Raise the quality bar on customer-facing content, including guidelines for photography and filming at events.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the brand system inside out, you've shipped your first event assets, and you've mapped what currently goes to contractors.

  • First 90 days: events and print run through you, not contractors. There's a working event template library and a print spec/supplier list the team trusts.

  • First 6 months: colleagues self-serve the basics (starter kit, slide templates), and you spend your time on the moments that matter most.

Who you'll work with

  • Events: our Events team in London and New York.

  • Marketing and Product Marketing: a growing PMM team plus content, customer advocacy and growth.

  • Design: our Founding Visual Designer and the Design Director.

  • Leadership: occasional high-visibility requests (keynotes, board and leadership decks).

What we're looking for

  • Around 5 years in graphic or visual design, ideally in a B2B or in-house brand team. If you're close to that and your work speaks for itself, apply anyway.

  • A portfolio with real, produced events, print and campaign work, not only screens.

  • Strong typography, layout and colour, and confidence working within a brand system while pushing it forward.

  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with printers and suppliers.

  • Comfortable juggling several briefs at once, pushing back on scope and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Confident in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).

  • Strong presentation design in Google Slides and Figma Slides.

Nice to have

  • Basic motion design for event screens and social.

  • Experience art directing photography or video.

How we hire

  1. Portfolio review by our design team.

  2. Intro call with Talent Team (about 30 mins).

  3. Design deep-dive: walk us through 2 to 3 produced projects.

  4. Meet the team: Marketing and Events stakeholders.

We keep it quick and tell you where you stand at each stage.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

descriptionHtml:
🌟 VO2 GROUP : Leader français indépendant en conseil Tech et Digital

Entre conseil stratégique et réalisation technologique, nous cultivons un esprit "boutique" : de l'excellence, de l'humain et une forte culture de l'innovation.

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants.

🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate

Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès :

✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation

✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨

🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership

Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine)

Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce

🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable"

Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟

45 % de femmes au sein de nos équipes

Campagne primée TopCom en 2024

📜 Certifications et Prix

Salesforce Impact Partner 2024

Cybervadis 2025

Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company

🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________

📋 Description du poste

En tant que Product Owner Clienteling, vous interviendrez auprès d'une grande Maison de luxe internationale sur l'évolution d'une application reposant sur l'écosystème Salesforce.

Véritable interface entre les équipes métier et techniques, vous accompagnerez la division dans la conception et l'amélioration de ses outils de clienteling, dans un environnement agile et international.

🎯 Responsabilités & Tâches clés

Votre quotidien s'articulera autour de quatre grands piliers :

1. Recueil des besoins & Recommandations Produit

  • Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins des équipes métier Retail et Digital.

  • Identifier les axes d'amélioration des parcours clients et des outils de clienteling.

  • Proposer des solutions fonctionnelles adaptées aux enjeux métier et aux usages en boutique.

2. Conception fonctionnelle & Gestion du Backlog

  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, User Stories et critères d'acceptation.

  • Formaliser les parcours utilisateurs, règles de gestion et besoins d'intégration entre les outils.

  • Alimenter, prioriser et affiner le backlog en collaboration avec l'Application Manager.

  • Contribuer à la conception des maquettes et prototypes.

3. Suivi des développements & Méthodologie Agile

  • Assurer l'interface fonctionnelle entre les équipes métier et les développeurs iOS et Salesforce.

  • Participer aux cérémonies Agile (Daily, Sprint Planning, Refinement, Sprint Review).

  • Suivre l'avancement des développements et accompagner les arbitrages fonctionnels.

4. Recette, Déploiement & Accompagnement du changement

  • Préparer et participer aux phases de recette fonctionnelle et aux tests utilisateurs (UAT).

  • Suivre les anomalies et valider la conformité des fonctionnalités livrées.

  • Accompagner les déploiements internationaux et l'adoption des nouvelles fonctionnalités.

  • Produire les supports utilisateurs et assurer la communication auprès des équipes métier.

👤 Profil recherché

Pour réussir sur ce poste, nous recherchons un profil doté d'une forte expertise fonctionnelle, d'une bonne connaissance du luxe et du clienteling, ainsi que d'une excellente capacité à interagir avec les équipes métier.

  • Formation & Expérience : Vous justifiez idéalement de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Business Analyst, Proxy Product Owner ou Product Owner sur des projets digitaux.

  • Expertise Métier : Vous possédez une expérience dans le secteur du luxe et une bonne maîtrise des enjeux de clienteling, CRM, Retail et omnicanalité.

  • Compétences Fonctionnelles : Vous maîtrisez le recueil des besoins, la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles, les User Stories et la gestion de backlog. Une connaissance de Salesforce est appréciée.

  • Gestion de projet & Agilité : Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement Agile/Scrum et maîtrisez Jira. Une expérience sur des applications mobiles ou des projets internationaux constitue un atout.

  • Soft Skills : Autonome, diplomate et force de proposition, vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité d'analyse, votre sens du service et votre aisance dans la communication avec des interlocuteurs métier exigeants.

  • Langues : Anglais courant indispensable, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, dans un environnement international.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi et à transformer l'expérience transactionnelle de nos clients ? 👉 Postulez dès maintenant ! 📩 Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, et notre programme de diversité et d’inclusion vise à faire de VO2 Group un lieu de travail idéal pour des talents variés.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

descriptionHtml:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Wir machen keinen Social-Media-Content von der Stange. Wir erzählen Geschichten, Persönlichkeiten und Momente dort, wo sie gesehen werden: auf YouTube Shorts, Instagram und TikTok.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Short-Form nicht nur schaut, sondern versteht. Jemanden, der in den ersten zwei Sekunden eine Hook setzt, im Rhythmus schneidet und weiß, warum ein Reel durch die Decke geht – und ein anderes nicht.

Als Werkstudent:in Content Creation bei Miss Germany Studios schneidest du Short-Form-Content aus unserer YouTube-Serie und Produktionen – und aus Ideen, die du selbst mitbringst. Und wenn es passt, stehst du auch mal selbst vor der Kamera.

Was du bei uns machst:

  • Schnitt: Du schneidest Shorts, Reels und TikToks – schnell, plattformgerecht und mit starkem Hook. Aus langen YouTube-Folgen, Event-Material und Behind-the-Scenes machst du Clips, die für sich allein funktionieren.

  • Trends & Formate: Du weißt, was auf den Plattformen gerade läuft, und bringst eigene Formatideen ein.

  • Vor der Kamera: Du drehst (dich) auch mal selbst.

  • Learnings: Du schaust dir an, was performt, und lässt das in die nächsten Videos einfließen.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

  • Du lebst Short-Form. Du scrollst nicht einfach – du analysierst ganz automatisch, warum dich ein Video nach zwei Sekunden hat.

  • Du kannst schneiden. Premiere Pro oder CapCut – Hauptsache, du bist schnell und hast ein Gefühl für Timing, Pacing und Sound.

  • Du bringst Social-Erfahrung mit. Idealerweise hast du schon Social-Media-Kanäle betreut oder eigenen Content veröffentlicht – für ein Unternehmen, eine Agentur oder deinen eigenen Kanal.

  • Du hast Creator-Energie. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern kommst mit Ideen.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

  • Du studierst. Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben und kannst ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche bei uns arbeiten.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

descriptionHtml:

Du kennst jeden TikTok-Trend, bevor er viral geht? Du schneidest Reels im Schlaf, ob in CapCut oder mit KI-Tools, und hast Lust, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen? Dann suchen wir genau dich: als Werkstudent:in oder Praktikant:in "Social Media & Content Creation (m/w/d)" in Remote.

Das bringst du mit

Muss:

  • Du weißt, was einen guten Hook ausmacht, und schreibst kurze Texte, die hängen bleiben.

    • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit KI-Video- oder Voice-Tools
    • Interesse an Gründung, Startups oder Legal-Tech

Warum mit uns durchstarten?

  • Deine Formate, dein Impact: Du verantwortest von Anfang an eigene Formate und siehst die Ergebnisse direkt auf unseren Kanälen.

  • Vor und hinter der Kamera: Du wirst ein Gesicht der Marke und baust dir ein Portfolio mit echter Reichweite auf.

  • Studium first: Als Werkstudent:in planen wir deine Stunden um deinen Semesterplan herum.

Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt bei EUR 15–20/ Stunde je nach Erfahrung. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 20 Stunden. Start ab Sofort.
